e: DC takes a familiar oppression-and-police-brutality setup and packages it as a surprisingly effective commercial entertainer. The performances, cinematography and especially the classical-music-infused BGM made the violence land far better for me than I expected.
v: Not my kind of brutal oppression movie, but DC's commercial touch + that crazy classical BGM combo worked for me 😄
body:
I generally stay away from the overly cooked Tamil-flavoured oppression & brutality stories…..but couldn’t control myself with all the FOMO created by the feedback from those who watched it. So much so that I had to ditch Srinu, my regular Partner in Crime for watching such movies!!!! 😜

And do I have any regret or guilt about ditching him…..absolutely not 😉 But can’t deny the fact that I would have enjoyed it even more in his company!!! Don’t worry Srinu, we will compensate with Toxicity 😉😂

Coming back to the movie….unlike the epics of Kabali or Kaala, DC is a proper oppression and fight-against-police-brutality movie, but packed into a proper commercial entertainer which somehow still feels realistic. And that’s largely because of the extraordinary effort from all the actors, cinematographer and music director 🙏

Special mention to the BGM 🤯 I feel Animal started the trend of using old songs to elevate the audience experience of a scene, which Dhurandhar bettered by using vintage & contrasting songs as BGM for violent scenes. But DC took it one step further by using classical music to elevate the emotions during violence 🫡 What a combination!!!

Initially, I was surprised to know that this movie wasn’t doing that well with the Tamil audience but clicked really well with the Telugu audience?? After watching it, I understood why.

Tamil movie lovers still cherish those raw, grounded and realistic oppression movies, whereas this one is packaged commercially. That may not have worked as much for them…..but for audiences like me, that commercial packaging is exactly what made it click 😄

e: The scale, locations, CGI and performances are unquestionably richer this time, but the magic that made Kantara work for me is missing. I kept seeing a commercially upgraded spectacle when I was hoping for a deeper dive into the folklore and origins behind the legend.
v: Looks Vaaaaav on screen... but that Kantara magic never really hit me this time 😪 Too Much Quality with No Clarity!
body:
DISCLAIMER: Don’t worry, I’m not on some secret mission to hate or hype this movie. This is just what I honestly felt after watching it, NO FAN CLUB, NO HATE CLUB. Just me and my opinion.

When I first watched #Kantara, I didn’t had any expectations and I was completely blown away with the approach of blending folk-fare and terrific Visuals and Acting into a very simple and common story of a Land Dispute.

Coming to Kantara: Chapter 1, Obviously I had the expectations from the previous movie….

On the Positive Side….This time the budget has been hiked and you can see the grandeur on the big screen with the story being setup in Kings era. The Locations looked more realistic than previous part. The CGI work was more perfect than the previous part. The Cast had more familiar faces this time and everyone did an excellent job. 

For Kantara, I remember how I was going bonkers about how Rishab Shetty had Written, Directed and Acted in the movie…..This time also  he did all by himself. Unfortunately what worked for me in #Kantara didn’t work for me in #KantaraChapter1 

My Eyes were in treat of the Visual Spectacle on the Screen, but somehow that was not creating the much needed impact on my other senses 😪 And all I could think of this as a Commercially Upgraded Version to encash the craze of #Kantara

BGM, I felt was again a Rehash Version of Kantara which failed to create much impact this time….Acting wise though Rishab Shetty was Good as usual, But this Time I always knew How his Hand and Leg moments would be and how his Facial Expressions would change whenever he is possessed. So it was as if I am watching same Kantara performance again so the Vaaaaaaaaav feeling was missing this time. 

Special Shout Out to Gulshan Devaiah who was excellent as King Kulashekara who was the only reason I didn’t think of walking out of this film with disappointment 🫡 

Also if not for the individual performances by Rukmini and Jayram, there was no scope in the story (except in climax) to elevate their characters because the movie was only and only focused on elevating Rishab

When the Sequel is named as Chapter, 1, I was expecting Rishab Shetty to dive deep into his Region’s Folklore and give us the origin story of Panjurli, Guliga, Bhoota Kola and finally how Kantara was formed……but instead he focused on exploring the story of tribal leader Berme played by Rishab himself…..

while Kantara’s execution revolved about the Land dispute and how Guliga protects Panjurli’s land and promise….with Rishab Shetty’s character moulding itself into the story flow perfectly. But in Chapter, 1 it’s all Commercial aspect of Raise and Fall and Raise of Berme and the actual story going for a toss!!!!

on a final note….. Kantara : Chapter 1 is Too Much Quality with No Clarity

e: The story is below average and neutral viewers may not get the same high, but Sujeeth knows exactly what kind of film he is making. A handful of adrenaline-pumping PK moments, powered by Thaman’s terrific BGM, are enough to turn OG into a proper fan celebration.
v: Story-wise nothing great... but Sujeeth + Thaman woke up the PK fan in me and gave him a proper feast 😄
body:
It’s truly a Pawan Kalyan film, made for the fans, by the fans, and dedicated to the fans!

The bigger the fan, the stronger the trance this movie creates. Fans will definitely watch it multiple times to relive the high.

For neutral audiences, the movie might feel like average commercial content, similar to films like Jailer, Leo, Pathaan, or Good Bad Ugly.

About the content: it follows the regular commercial gangster format, with stylish scenes and terrific background music from Thaman 🙏. The story itself is below average and can test patience. The much-hyped Saaho connection also didn’t fit in well.

Still, I admire Sujeeth’s effort. He had to work with very limited dates from Pawan, who has always relied more on his screen charisma than acting range. Within these limits, Sujeeth managed to create 4-5 adrenaline-pumping scenes that drove fans crazy, making them forget the flaws. Thaman’s music elevated the film into a treat for fans. He is the real HERO of this movie, can’t even dare to imagine this movie without his BGM 🙏🙏

Neutral viewers may not enjoy it as much as fans. My real frustration, however, is with self-proclaimed reviewers who criticize every movie without understanding its intent. This film was always promoted as a cult fan movie, not a national-award-level story. Expecting otherwise is just unfair and shows how big an IDIOT you are.

Note: OG was always packaged as a cult fan movie. And though I usually watch films as a neutral movie lover, Sujeeth succeeded in waking up the long-forgotten PK fan in me, and satisfied him to the core!

e: MIRAI gets a lot right with its mythology-meets-commercial-cinema idea, impressive CGI, production values and committed performances. But the hero, villain and Ashoka’s hidden-books mythology deserved far more depth; what could have been an epic multipart franchise feels rushed into one film.
v: Very good movie for sure... but with this setup it could have been something EPIC. For me, a golden franchise opportunity missed 😢
body:
Let me make this clear, This is Not a Cult Classic Movie but a VERY GOOD movie with proper mix of Fiction & Mythology along with Commercial Elements!!! A good movie on how an Underdog turned into Super Hero with a touch of Puranas!!! 

Wait a Minute….why do I have a déjà vu of reviewing Hanu-Man!! Teja Sajja should have done at least a movie or two before committing to MIRAI, just to give audience a fare chance to enjoy this movie without having comparisons with Hanu-Man!!!

Content wise the film had a lot to explore on arch of Villain and the arch of Hero and their final clash… which had full potential of going into a multipart movie with grand climax. But somewhere I felt the director rushed into making it a single part movie of the story. When the normal commercial movies like Devara and Kingdom have forcefully dragged their story to make it a two part film, I am totally disappointed in Karthik who Writer and Director of the movie for lacking the vision to work a bit more on the depth of the content and make it informative about Ashoka’s 9 Hidden books and its contents and also establish the Villain and Hero’s character arch’s properly instead he rushed to finish the movie in single part thus giving a scope to dissatisfaction with few loose ends

Execution of CGI is the saving grace of this movie along with Top Notch Production Values….There are few scenes which give us a vibe of watching High Budget Movies and the Team should be specially appreciated for it.

 BGM was very Good and highlight the CGI scenes to give Goosebumps for sure.

Acting wise Teja Sajja was perfect as an Underdog turned Super Hero but as I mentioned he already played similar character in Hanu-Man with the only difference being Village person vs a Street Smart City Boy in this movie.

Manchu Manoj was perfect for this role and he did justice. I only feel bad for him as the Story writers didn’t put extra effort to dive more into his character building which would have made him into one of the most memorable Villain roles in Indian Movies (similar to Thanos)

Shriya Saran as Ambika was a Fresh Casting and she did complete justice to her role….Except for Hindi Drusyam where she played a normal House Wife character, I don’t think she had any author backed roles to showcase her acting skills and Man she did impress me a lot 😍

On Final Note….This movie had all in it to become an EPIC Multipart Franchise more than a  Bahubali or KGF only to be ruined by some lazy efforts of the Story Writer and Screenplay department 😡 As a Normal Audience You can either Like this movie to the core or feel a Good Movie as a one time watch, but as a Filmbuff I could easily see a Golden opportunity Missed 😢

e: Little Hearts avoids both the loud youth-film template and the overly poetic love-story route. Its simple writing, likeable performances and honest climax made it a nostalgic, light-hearted watch that may not demand a big screen, but absolutely deserves your time.
v: Simple, cute and genuinely feel-good ❤️ Nothing fancy, just a light teenage love story that took me straight back to college days.
body:
A wholesome family entertainer that captures teenage love in a fun, light-hearted way. It’s sure to take you on a nostalgic trip back to your carefree college days, filled with laughter and feel-good moments!!!!

Kudos to Director and Writer Sai Marthand for presenting the story so realistically that you feel connected to every scene. As the movie went on, I was curious about how he would handle the climax, would he take the typical cinematic route of how they will convince their parents to accept their kids’ love or will he go completely off beat and if so, how would that fit into the film’s realistic and feel good tone? But hats off to him for delivering the climax in such a simple and honest way. It may feel a bit abrupt for regular moviegoers, but that’s exactly how life works 🙏

The lead pair of Mouli and Shivani Nagaram looked cute onscreen and they did a fantastic job, Its not only them all the Friends Gang along with seasoned Rajeev, Anitha, Kanchi, Satya did full justice to their roles.

Usually, teenage love stories are shown in two ways : one like Boyz or Bus Stop, filled with bold scenes and cuss words to attract youth, and the other like Bommarilu or Kotha Bangaru Lokam, which are more poetic and cinematic, aiming to be timeless classics. But here, the director chose a different path keeping it light-hearted and family-friendly, while still getting his message across and thats where I got totally impressed.

Having Said that, Not everyone may like it to watch on Big Screen as this movie doesn’t offer you any Cinematic Experience or Ultimate Content or Star Cast which would be a must watch on Big Screen….But you will never Regret it watching on Big Screen as you can some wonderful light hearted moments. 

If you are not willing to watch it on Big Screen, then you should not miss it on OTT. This movie could have been talk of the town on OTT but kudos to the team especially those who handled Promotions for releasing this among some medium movies and yet creating a buzz to create enough enthu to the audience to come and watch in theatres, but believe me you will not regret watching it on Big screen.

e: COOLIE worked better for me once I stopped expecting another LCU event or a conventional Rajinikanth vehicle. Soubin Shahir is the real acting star, Anirudh powers nearly every elevation, but the final 30 minutes and some wasted cameos drag down an otherwise enjoyable film.
v: I liked COOLIE... till that last 30 mins happened 🫩 Soubin + Anirudh were the real stars for me. Rest needs a BIG forgiving heart 😇
body:
I Liked this movie barring the last 30 mins….I think it’s the over expectations on Loki as a Director and the anticipation of this being blended into LCU which has led to disappointing reviews.

Also to be fair enough….its not a Rajnikanth’s typical movie where he takes the center stage to be frank this is Soubin Shahir’s movie where Rajini did an impactful extended cameo 😉 Man what a Performer he his 🫡 With his acting abilities he simply outshined all other so called commercial starlets. If we actually watxh the movie from perspective of Soubin being the key role you will absolutely love this movie 🫡

 Nagarjuna was good in parts….He looked stunning in his Dapper Ultra Kool look as a Villan and totally owned few scenes with his swag!!! But unfortunately apart from being Stylish he doesn’t have much character to play in this movie and also the climax parts where he supposed to utter few dialogues he completely messed up. Credit to my Friend Srinivas coming up with gem of a Line “Nagarjuna Voice lo evadinanna Bhayapetalli ani Warning isthunte, Vinevadikki mathram ento veedu bhayapaduthu matladuthunatuntundi” 

Amir Khan’s character was a total waste and even not necessary for this movie and just to fit him in the movie has been dragged by another 15 mins 🫩 and did he made an impact? NO he looked completely buffoonery. Unfortunately the comparison with Rolex from Vikram makes his scene more awful  🤢

Rajnikanth was at his general best and may be its been decades where he tried to play a role where he is not so powerful and tend to make mistakes and he did a good job to fit in.

Shruthi Hassan was Okayish….and I will not talk about Upendra’s presence as I feel that Loki has totally failed to utilise Uppi’s talent. Still waiting for some Director (apart from Upendra himself) who can unleash the Actor within him 🫩

Anirudh is the only star for this Movie for his BGM to elevate each and every character….Cant imagine to watch this movie without BGM 🫡

Overall, You would like the movie if you just be a saint enough (like me) to leave all your expectations from Loki’s past movies, all your expectations from the Huge Starcast and have a BIG SUITABLE HEART to let go the horrible last 30 mins 😉

e: WAR2 delivers the familiar YRF spy template without surprising me much. NTR deserves credit for taking on a role opposite Hrithik, but the writing wastes his emotional strengths and turns the clash into another body-flexing exercise where Hrithik naturally owns the screen.
v: Exactly what I expected from YRF spy universe. Not bad, not great either 😄 NTR tried, Hrithik owned the screen... and yes, make him James Bond already 🙏
body:
knowing the History of YRF Spy Franchise, I know exactly what to expect from this kind of movie and I can say I was NOT DISAPPOINTED though neither I had a feeling of watching a very good movie.

No matter how it was promoted in Telugu, we always knew that Hrithik aka Kabir is the hero of WAR Franchise and any other actor no matter how big or small he is would be sidelined as the story progress and thats what exactly happened in War 2 as well and I have no complaints….as I got a chance to see NTR as an Artist rather than a Hero, am I totally impressed with that?? is debatable and you would know why….

if we look at YRF spy verse movies, Pathan and Tiger3 movies….we can see how SRK and Salman have done cameos in each others movies and conveniently avoided either Hrithik’s Cameo in their Movies nor did a Cameo in his movie as they known that Hrithik with his Greek God Looks and Swag can simply steal the Limelight….

and thats where exactly I am too impressed with NTR taking up the challenge to get casted opposite Hrithik, but was let down by some poor story arch as the director failed to use NTR’s emotional acting power to balance out Hrithik’s Charisma but instead choose the same old template of Body flexing between both of them and where Hrithik clearly dominated NTR effortlessly … but all that would be a problem for some hardcore fans who see NTR as a Hero, but they fail to understand that he is the Villain of this movie and if you accept that fact you can enjoy the movie just like any other Spy movie.

Though I wanted to watch the movie in Hindi version, but had to watch in Telugu after Chimtu (Naga Vamsi) anna’s speech as he literally blackmailed TFI yuvatha to get numbers higher than Hindi!!! Thats another mistake I made as I felt that watching movie in Hindi would have made my experience more better as the Telugu dubbing was of poor quality considering the fact that NTR acted in it ☹️

YRF should give a proper gap to spy movies and start looking for new ideas as their recent spy movies are following the same repeated pattern time and again….they are only focussing on Hero and Villan combinations and Guest Appearances!!!

I strictly believe that Hrithik should be the next James Bond and would like to start a petition for that 🙏

e: Hari Hara Veera Mallu was a painful theatrical experience for me: a fundamentally awkward story, visibly poor VFX, years of production baggage and a trailer that appears to have contained nearly all the best material. My wife tried to stop this review... but even hunger couldn’t save it 😢😂
v: Sorry KANNAPA. Sorry ADIPURUSH. I found a new No.1 khalakhandam 🙏😂 HHVM somehow survived every warning sign just to punish us in theatres.
body:
though I have seen this First Day First show…I was forced to not share my experience by none other than my wife (who is a HARDCORE POWER STAR Fan) of dire consequences at home 😢 Fearing of Hunger of not getting food I was holding back my post only to realise that “Hum Khana nahi brathak saktha but Review post petakunda nahi brathak saktha Hum!!!”

To start with I would like to sincerely apologise to Manchu Vishnu anna and Om Rauth for trolling them  for their respective khalakhandas #KANNAPA & #ADIPURUSH…..this movie beats all of them to take the No 1 Spot 🙏. 

Some Movies are never meant to be made and even Nature tries to warn you by creating delays due to Pandemics, Director Changes, Financial Issues, Hero getting busy in a different career path….but if the Producer is adamant about investing, completing and releasing the movie then he is not a Human being with normal Gunde definitely GUNDE lo GUNNAPUM dhiginode cheyagaladu!!! Just to reiterate I said GUNDE and I really mean it…meeru vere arthalu tesukovadu 🙏

Storyline wise how the hell you can have a Heroic Ending for a Commercial Film when select your Villain as Arungazeb? There is no way you can show that Hero Killed Him…and that too you wanted the hero to steal Kohinoor? I think Krish has understood this flaw in story after shooting some parts and quietly left the project!!!!  The project should have been shelved right at that point….but I don’t know who was adamant to complete this Project!!!

and the Eureka Moment was when in last few moths CHAT GPT and GROk has started generating basic images and videos by prompts….so they used the Trail Version of them 🙏 (the graphics look literally of the quality generated by free AI tools) and to address the story flaw they came up with a brilliant idea of changing remaining storyline to a lame adaption of Pawan’s Santhana stance in his Political stand. 

And when they said Jyothi Krishna is the second Director who completed the pending portions…did they mean that he is the one who gave PROMPTS to CHAT GPT to generate those graphics 🫡

It was literally Pain in Eyes (again I said 👀 ) to watch the Poor Quality VFX on a Quality INOX screen 🫩

Though every one of had least expectations on this movie….forget about the result, we were not sure about it even releasing 🤷 at that time the Trailer gave me a feel that probably it may not be as bad as what I was thinking….but sadly I came to know that the Trailer had all the best scenes of the whole movie and THATS IT!!!!

In a way I guess that this movie is a sweet revenge of Pawan Kalyan to his Fans as they constantly complaint of him not doing straight movies!! Now no one will dare to complain 😂 FINGERS CROSSED for OG!!!!

e: THAMMUDU has the bones of a commercial emotional drama, but the painfully linear narration drains the masala, tension and emotion out of it. The cinematography is excellent and Laya’s comeback is welcome, but the writing left Srinu and me wondering why we ignored all warning signs.
v: Emotional movie without emotions 🙏😪 Srinu and I went in out of curiosity and came out wondering why neither of us had the sense to say NO 😂
body:
Before going into my experience of the movie….let me take the opportunity to introduce you to Srinu, my Partner in Crime for Watching Movies and together we witnessed many Epics and Disasters for the past 15 odd years 🙏

While we were stepping into the AMB to watch this movie, Srinu asked me a question : Poorna, did you realise that this is the first time we are watching Nithin’s movie on a First Day!!! Can you care to explain why are we doing this?

and my answer was : I don’t know Srinu, for me even the trailer of the movie looked pretty ordinary but have seen few so called Honest Interviews and Interactions between Dil Raju and Nithin which raised curiosity in me and also the fact that this movie got A certificate which they claim justify the content of the movie raised curiosity in me to watch this movie on First day itself!!!!

And after watching this movie and while stepping out of AMB, I asked Srinu a question : Srinu, naakante siggu ledhu prathi movie ki edo oka reason chepi tempt avutha…..neekana budhi undakarla?? vadhu Poorna ani chepachu ga!!!!

and as usual Srinu never answers or reacts….he simply tried to cover up his pain with a smile on his face 🙏

Srinu and Me seriously tried to search for a Psychiatrist near by AMB to get checked if we both lost sensitivity in our hearts along the sense of reacting emotionally because we were watching a movie which had so many emotional scenes but still we both were not feeling any bit of it? 

But later realised that it the unique ability of the Director Sriram Venu to Direct an Emotional Movie without Emotions in it 😪 

We have seen so many occasions where the so called Hollywood & OTT Movie Watchers (Self proclaimed intellectuals) complaining that Tollywood is killing interesting stories by commercialising the movie by adding unwanted Comedy, Elevations and Masala!!! 

Especially they have criticised Sreeram Venu for making an out and out commercial movie MCA with Nani….and this movie and screenplay would be a slipper-shot answer to them, as they would also be begging the director to add some masala into this otherwise very Linear and non engaging storytelling. Fun Fact : He used the almost same MCA plot to make this movie without adding any commercial formula 😂 thus giving a proper tribute to MCA!!! and the irony is Nani was supposed to play Nithin’s character but somehow he escaped 😳

Story wise the movie had full scope to be a proper commercial mass masala movie….but unfortunately for som unknown reason the Director choose to narrate this in Non Commercial Format 🙄 and please don’t be of the opinion that he could be an Off Beat Director. He is the one who directed Nani’s MCA 😂 . The very thought of Directing a Potentially Commercial Story in a Very much Non Commercial Narration should fetch Oscar for the whole Team 🫡. The very fact that the director couldn’t clearly establish if Varsha is a Lover or Good Friend of Nithin shows how confused he was!! The way he assumed that showing Heroine as Love interest of Hero is Routine commercial and hence tried to convey her as his Friend to give an Off Beat movie vibes but ended up calling her as his COMPANION (which I am yet to decode) shows how confused he was to project a simple relation 🤔

I feel pity for Nithin, as majority of his recent movies though having a potential of being Hit at-least on paper couldn’t give him proper success due to mishandling of the subject by the Directors. While his Robinhood flopped with over usage of commercial elements Thammudu completely lacks them 🫩. Hope he soon finds a way to balance Content with commercial elements.

Also Saurabh Sachdeva (Animal fame) is being over used by Tollywood directors…his acting and expressions which looked unique and gelled well in Animal are looking too loud and over the top in other films especially when they give him

unique behaviour without properly utilising it later 

I personally feel that Laya was overrated during her times and being a Telugu Heroine only helped her and she used to choose her characters wisely to give that impression of her being an excellent artist, and thats why No one of us literally missed her when she took break from acting!!! But for a change….her comeback into movies is the only matter of interest in this whole movie 🙏

 The Cinematography is of Top Notch and blended well with the excellent visuals of the Forest locations which brings down my biggest question ever? Why did Manchu anna choose New Zealand  Resort type Forest’s over these beautiful rustic Forest shown in this movie to shoot Kannapa 🤔🤔

Also while I was wondering why this Movie got A certificate?? My Friend, Living Legend Srinu enlightened me saying that its because the censor board wanted to save as many lives as possible from getting depressed of not getting emotional after watching an emotional movie 🙏

e: KANNAPA’s core devotional material could have worked as a short, focused film, but the bloated runtime, weak VFX, strange diction, over-the-top presentation and unintentionally funny first half made it a torturous experience for me. Prabhas is the rare relief.
v: Three hours of torture for a story that needed maybe 30-45 mins 😭😂 Prabhas finally arrives like a saviour, not just for Kannappa... for us too 🙏
body:
its a almost a 20 mins Prabhas film in which Manchu Vishnu did a Lengthy Cameo for 3 hrs 3 mins out of which he gave his Career best performance for 3 mintues (still mediocre or average performance compared to many other actors in Tollywood) 

The Film starts with almost 5 minutes Song giving us insights about SRIKALAHASTI temple and in 10 min pre and post interval scenes we will be shown the past relationship between Lord Shiva and Kannapa and in the last 3 minutes we would be shown what we have been waiting for the last 3 hrs, i.e why Kannapa is considered one of the greatest Shiva Bhakt.

This could have been a nice 30, 45 mins Film with proper impact and screenplay but unfortunately the Director has chosen this to be made at a length of 3 hrs 3 mins of never ending saga 🙏 But in the defence of the Director Mukesh Kumar Singh, he never had an experience of directing a Movie and all his experience is from TV serials and he made perfect justice to his experience by making this movie a never ending saga with very mediocre or Medium Budgeted TV serial Graphics 

When you have 90% of the Star cast and Cameos either doing the movie for free or at peanut’s price and still if the Producer is claiming to spend 200 to 300 crores on this movie then we as audience expect some grand visuals and good cgi but instead we get to see blurred images and most of the times you can almost feel the green screen…I guess team didn’t put any budget and intelligently blurred images to fool audience as if they had Censor Issues 😂 

For the first time I was watching a Telugu movie trying to read the subtitles to understand dialogues….because 75% of the time you feel that the Voice has been dubbed by International English Medium Kids trying to speak proper Telugu with English accent and in some cases you will even find Hindi, Tamil and Malayalam accents as well 🙏 Its only Mohan babu who as usual had proper command over the language and played his part well. Though Sharthkumar tried his best to deliver in proper Telugu but you can literally feel that he is trying very hard!!! A part from Sharthkumar no other actor including Vishnu tried to work on their Telugu diction. Also the film is totally shot in New Zealand  and hence the forest background didn’t give me the local vibes instead they should have shot it some forests near Kerala or North Eastern India 🤔. Because of the English Telugu Accent dialogues, Location and more importantly over the top makeup of each artist with Fake Tattoos…we will not get a feeling of watching a proper Telugu movie though the story is completely native ☹️

On top of it the First Half is Total Mess filled with with Cringe scenes and dialogues like :

  1. Nemali ni Pelli chesukoni Namili vadilestha!!
  2. Till then Hero does all kind of Romance in front of his Mothers Samadi and suddenly says there is no Temple greater than his Mothers Samadhi for him 🙏
  3. The movie had lot many Lady Warriors but looks like their Fights have been choreographed by Dancers instead of Fight Masters!!! All their Moves look like as if their doing sexy dances with sword in their hands ☹️
  4. All the Heroine scenes could be best suited for Liril soap ad campaigns 😂
  5. I am not sure why we still need to follow Raghavendra Rao’s school of showing hot romance in devotional movies. The costumes of Heroine even while praying to God, gives erotic vibes more than devotional feel

For the first time ever have seen audience in PVR multiplex laughing out loud and booing scenes and banging heads for a movie which was supposed to be serious.

After you go through his awful experience….sometime in Second Half Prabhas comes as a saviour not only in the Film or For the Film but also to give solace to audience for going through all the torture 🙏

Off-late I used to have complaint against Prabhas for his lazy acting and dialogue delivery style…..but in movie I felt that his same style as whistle worthy and subtle, it could be because of the role or dialogues he got or it could be completely because of the torture my mind went through after all those over the top acting by remaining artists 😂

PS : My 12 year old daughter forced me to add this line “in the name of Devotion dont take your kids to this movie and traumatise them”

e: Sekhar Kammula strips a familiar rich-vs-poor setup of hero worship and commercial formula, then lets Dhanush, Nagarjuna and the writing carry it. I enjoyed the realism, performances and philosophical dialogue, though the pacing may make it a harder recommendation for everyone.
v: Loved the idea, realism and performances 🙏 Dhanush is terrific, Nag fits like a glove... but I can totally understand if the length tests your patience.
body:
there are few kind of movies which while watching you get suck into the brilliant concept, near to realistic execution, career best performances by the lead and supporting cast and yet you come out of the theatre with a feel of something is missing…..and Kuberaa is one such movie where though I enjoyed the off beat concept and narration but I might hesitate to suggest others to watch this movie as I overheard conversations of few audiences feeling that the movie is a test to their patience 

Story wise, we have seen many movies with the storyline of Rich vs Poor which has scope for pure commercial formula!!! But its Sekhar Kammula’s vision to set up an Ultra Rich vs a Begger in a near Realistic approach without any commercial elements should be appreciated 🙏 

Especially the way he designed few scenes, only a director who gives ZERO FUCKS to Hero Worship and Commercial Story Telling can only pull such things off 🙏

Acting wise Dhanush is sure shot to get all the awards for his acting…His body language, Smile, Dialogue Delivery everything makes us believe that he has been a begger since his childhood….The only thing that put me off was I felt Dhanush was bit hefty in couple of scenes for a Begger 😂😉

In his Vast Career I personally feel that No Role perfectly suited Nagarjuna’s body language and Voice Modulation as much as this role suited him 🙏 Its as if he was born to portray this role to perfection 🫡

Initially I was surprised on why Sekhar ditched Sai Pallavi for Rashmika, but after watching movie I understood that out of all Sekhar’s movies this is the one which has weak arch for an actress but still its yards ahead when compared to Heroine roles in other movies…and Rashmika though with her own limitations and regular trying to be cute expressions gave way more matured performance 

The only commercial aspect of this movie is DSP’s Background Music….and he did elevate intense scenes with his terrific BGM which gives goosebumps.

Special Shout Out to the Thought provoking dialogues….especially the one where Rashmika indirectly makes all of realise that we are Beggers in one way or the other is pure Philosophical 🙏

Length of the movie could be a reason of complaint for some….but thats the case with each and every Sekhar’s movie. I have seen fee reviews of complaining about abrupt climax but I felt with no commercial elements included where the Hero is not educated to take on the Corporate system Intelligently nor has brute power to beat the shit out of them…then its the only possible way to reach the climax of the movie, else it would have been a never ending saga 🙄

e: BHAIRAVAM has a strong friendship-and-betrayal core, excellent BGM and cinematography, and committed performances from Nara Rohith, Manchu Manoj and Bellamkonda Sreenivas. Some Kantara-like echoes and an unresolved opening conflict hold it back, but it remains a very good effort for the team and budget.
v: Good rustic action drama with a solid friendship/betrayal setup. Not a must-watch for me, but definitely a nice comeback for Manoj, Rohith & Bellamkonda 😊
body:
a Semi Rustic Rural Action which could have been an impactful and must watch movie but ends up being an overall Good Movie. Nevertheless a much needed comeback for Manchu Manoj, Nara Rohit and Bellamkonda Srinivas….

STORY : Story is the heart and soul of this movie. The filmmakers waste no time in throwing you straight into the story from the very beginning. The first five minutes might feel suffocating , as much of the stiry is conveyed through narration during the opening titles, but it prepares you for what’s to come. Though the first half reminds us of KANTARA in bits and pieces but the multi dimensional setup of friendship and betrayal is what the major plot of the movie!!! I was so impressed with the story and had high things to mention about Vijay Kanakamedala that it disappointed me a lot when I got to k ow that its a REMAKE 🤐

STORY & DIRECTION by Vijay Kanakamedala, there is nothing much to talk about the story as it’s a remake….Direction was good but should have taken basic care to avoid similarities that could have reminded us of KANTARA not sure why such basic effort was not put into avoid a plot line. Also the other thing which didn’t satisfy me was that there was no closure to the opening conflict established during the titles!!!! A simple scene to provide a closure to the conflict should have  done wonders rather than leaving it to the audience assumption that issue might been solved 🤷

After his back 2 back ventures with Allari Naresh for Nandhi and Ugram, Vijay directing the comeback for Nara Rohith, Manchu Manoj & Bellamkonda Srinivas…..I am sure he will the Comeback Director for many other stars who are eager to comeback with a bang 😊🥰

BGM by Sricharan Pakala was Too Good and also the songs are catchy. Cinematography was top notch and the visuals create an impact for sure!!!!

Acting wise its a comeback for Nara Rohith, Nara Rohith has this habit of selecting Niche Subjects where the content does all the talking and he can manage with with typical dialogue delivery style and expressions without putting much efforts 😉 and he did exactly the same in this movie just shouldering his character as Vardha with his subtle expressions and dialogues 

Manchu Manoj who is known for his offbeat subjects, characters & acting styles is back doing the same….he has done exceptionally well with the character having grey shades and who is struck in a conflict 🙏 Its a true comeback for him and if he can control

that extra bit of over expressions and dialogue delivery, I am sure he can do wonders in his second innings

Kudos to Bellamkonda Srinivas for trying to pull of a character which is almost equivalent to a character artist in the First half and carries the second half on his shoulders 🙏 and he plays a complicated role which challenge’s his acting capabilities and he put in a lot of hard work 👍 but unfortunately though he gave his best there could be inevitable comparisons with what Rishab Shetty has pulled off in Kantara 😪 and I put the complete blame for this on the Director

Actress Aditi Shankar standout with her performance as Village girl and her dance moves….but her dubbing as village girl should have been take care of as it doesn’t sync in aptly. Thats the only Technical issue i have noticed in this movie

Overall, This is Very Good Movie considering the Team and Budget…..

PS : I don’t understand how the Censor board works? How and Why they gave this movie A is a billion dollar question 🫡

e: CREW works for me because it behaves like a straightforward commercial crime-comedy and lets its three leading ladies carry the fun. Logic takes a back seat at times, but the casting, witty writing and performances make that easy to forgive.
v: Finally a proper women-led commercial entertainer without all the gyaan 😍 Tabu + Kareena + Kriti simply take over and have fun. Logic can take a small coffee break 😜
body:
it’s been ages since Bollywood came up with a PROPER Women Centric Movie without any Agenda or Propaganda or Forced Feminism….I remember #Kahani was the last one such movie, while Kahani was a Crime Thriller….CREW is a proper commercial entertainer 😍 which boosts of having some wonderful artists Tabu, Kareena & Kriti Sanon

Being a proper commercial movie the content has its own ups and downs wrt logic or cinematic freedom (which general Bollywood critics and so called Directors worry about a lot) but all that goes for a toss with some wonderful performances……Special Kudos to the Casting department for such an apt casting!!!

All three of Tabu, Kareena & Kirti were on fire both looks and performance wise and they carried the movie wonderfully on their shoulders 🙏 The best part I loved in this movie was just how in Hero centric movies there is nothing for a Heroines….similarly this commercial Women centric movie has nothing much for its Hero’s 🤣

The special surprise of this movie is Kapil Sharma who played a subtle role as Tabu’s husband which is completely opposite to what we expect from Kapil Sharma and he did a very good job 👍

If you have watched Rajesh Krishnan’s last comedy thriller #Lootcase this movie Crew is pretty much similar Comedy Crime movie which shows the ups and downs of three air hostess with witty dialogues and performances by the 3 main ladies!!!

e: Tillu Square knows its audience already understands Tillu’s world, so it wisely avoids reinventing the formula. Siddhu remains the heart and soul, Anupama brings fresh energy and the returning characters make the sequel feel like another hilarious event in Tillu’s life.
v: Tillu Square adds almost NOTHING new... and that is exactly why it works 😂 Same Tillu madness, same fun, with an extra Radhika kick 😍
body:
Even before you step into theatre for this sequel, you exactly know what kind of movie you are about to watch and have your expectations set accordingly and thats the greatest plus for Tillu Square!!!!

while the positives of first part #DJTillu is its surprise element with the hero characterisation, Costumes, One liners & Dialogue Delivery….where as in the Second part the main Positive was the audience are prepared for what they are going to watch!!!

Music, Content and Direction wise they didn’t even try to add anything new into the sequel and surprisingly that worked 🙏 Except for adding 3 main characters all the remaining characters were continued from the original thus making the story just another event in Tillu’s life!!!!

while Siddhu is the heart and soul of this film, Anupama added the fresh dose of Glamour to the content…..and the special entry by the OG Radhika aka Neha Shetty gives the extra dose of kick to the film 😍

Tillu Square is one such rare movie where nothing EXTRA is added to its prequel and just gives what the audience want and yet make them laugh and enjoy it more than the first part 🙏

e: GAAMI has an intriguing concept, ambitious interwoven screenplay and surprisingly strong camera/VFX work for its budget. The final twist keeps you guessing, but the painfully slow narration drains so much energy that the journey starts feeling eternal long before the climax arrives.
v: Super interesting concept and surprisingly good visuals... but ayyo that SLOOOOOOOOOOOW narration 😞 The lag almost murdered my curiosity before the twist could save it.
body:
A Unique Concept Narrated in C/o Kancharapalem style of screen play with Top Notch Visuals (based on the limited budget) and Camera Work SPOILED all together by SLOOOOOOOOOOOW PACE Narration 😞 This is a perfect example of how a bad work in particular craft kills the whole movie!!!

To Start with Concept wise the team tested with a unique storyline which grabs audience attention and keeps them guessing about the possible climax with a proper twist which will blew away your imagination. Though the end twist may be hard to digest for orthodox movie lovers and for the audience who love different concept movies will find it interesting though not convincing

Screenplay of the movie is largely inspired from C/o Kancharapalem….but in C/o Kancharapalem the regular boy next door kind of love stories make the audience feel connected, whereas in Gaami the emotional & physical trauma of the characters will make the audience bit uncomfortable and disconnected a bit due to this screenplay!!!

BGM has been apt for this kind of movie and special mention to the Camera Work and the CGI team for their efforts to give some visual treat scenes with the limited budget they had 🙏🙏

Acting wise it would be new to see Vishwak Sen in such a subtle & dull character as we are used to his over energetic performances previously and he had nothing much to do in this movie apart from carrying that sick & confused look throughout……all the other characters did good job as per their character limitations.

Now coming to the main villain of this movie…..its the Painful Lag right from the word go till the climax!!!! You will feel like you have been watching this movie for an eternity 😞 which kills all the enthu of wanting to know how this unique concept movie unfolds. If you remember Rubber Balaji character from Amrutham, you will get a feel that this movie has been definitely directed by him 🤣

e: I went in expecting another Bollywood patriotic film built around familiar India-Pakistan beats and came out completely surprised. Hrithik and Deepika own the screen, but the spectacular aerial-action sequences are the real heart of FIGHTER and make this a proper big-screen 3D experience.
v: I expected another routine patriotic movie and got a proper big-screen blast 🔥 Hrithik + Deepika + those aerial fights in 3D... full paisa vasool for me 😍
body:
Don’t miss this movie on Big Screen with 3 D Glasses on!!!

To be frank when the Trailer dropped I was not so excited to watch this movie as I felt its just another Bollywood movie of cooking a story around Surgical Strikes to encash the sentiment…….but Man I was wrong!!!! This is one of THE BEST INDIAN ACTION WAR FARE movie I watched on screen and it’s a must watch on 3D

To start with…..HRITHIK had just nailed it with his Greek God Looks and amazing screen presence and who better than Siddharth Anand knows how to project him on screen, he previously did the same with Bang Bang and WAR and now again in Fighter!!! Siddharth knows how best he can make use of Hrithik’s charismatic personality 😍 It was an eye feast to watch him in Airforce Uniform 🫡

DEEPIKA was 🔥 in this movie and in few scenes she literally snatches away our eyes from Hrithik…..she did a fantastic job!!!! and it was total 😍 to watch the pair of Hrithik & Deepika on screen and I wonder why it took so long to cast them together 🙏

Content wise it is a Tailor made Commercial Patriotic movie with Surgical Strike as backdrop filled with good emotional points and bit over the top patriotism and obviously villian being Pakistan 😉

apart from Hrithik and Deepika’s excellent screen presence…..The Action parts are the Heart and Soul of this movie and I have never seen such AIR stunts in an Indian Movie which literally gives Goosebumps and provide WOW factor to this movie!!! Especially watch them

in 3D for a wonderful experience 🔥😍🫡

a MUST WATCH movie for all the Action movie lovers and especially Kids…..and if you are Hrithik (or) Deepika fan then its a Double Dhamaka for you guyz!!!!!

e: HANU-MAN works because Prasanth Varma treats mythology, superhero cinema and mass-commercial ingredients as one package. The CGI is overhyped in places, but considering the budget the ambition is impressive, and the first and last ten minutes set up the larger universe extremely well.
v: Not a cult classic for me... but definitely VERY GOOD 🔥 Smart mix of mythology + superhero masala, and that BGM does a LOT of heavy lifting 🙏
body:
MAN : Let me make this clear, This is Not a Cult Classic Movie but a VERY GOOD movie with proper mix of Science Fiction & Mythology along with Mass Commercial Elements!!!

Prasanth Varma has always been a unique story teller and his previous movies Awe, Kalki & Zombie Reddy stand as Testimony of his story writing capabilities. And in this movie also he showed his uniqueness in selecting the plot of a guy in quest to become a Super Hero ends up being a Super Villain which sounded unique at-least for me.

Direction wise Prasanth Varma did a very good job in making sure to mix almost all commercial elements like Mass Comedy & Sentiment into this movie barring Special Song :P…The First & Last 10 mins are the Heart and Soul of this movie, where in the First 10 he established the Villain Conflict very well and in the last 10 mins he made sure the ground is set for establishing the Prasanth Cinematic Universe….Considering this as a First movie of the Franchise this is no less than the First Iron Man movie of the Avengers……baring the first and last 10 mins the remaining movie is filled with regular commercial elements of what is bare minimum for a Super Hero movie and hence I don’t count this as best work of Prasanth Varma who made me go Awestruck with his very first directorial AWE!!!!!

Coming to the CGI all those social media posts of going gaga over top notch Visuals looked Over Hyped for me and I felt there is a lot of scope for improvement but considering the budget the team has done very good work….with the film being Successful hopefully the budgets will increase for upcoming ventures and we can get top notch visuals

Teja Sajja did very good performance and looked apt for the role…Vinsy Rai was perfect as the stylish super villain 🙂

BGM is the Soul of this movie and the music directors did a fantastic job, especially with the Hanuman Chalisa BGM…..somehow I feel that most of the appreciation that the VFX team is getting should go to the music directors for providing such a BGM to take audience into a trance and thus enhancing the visual impact of what is shown on screen.

Overall Content & Taking wise this movie is Good and has achieved a cult status only due to the fact of being a Low Budget film with lesser known star cast. Same Output with High Budget and Famous Star Cast would have definitely got mixed views……and also among Hindu Gods, Kids have a special liking for Lord Hanuman and thats the major back bone of this movie

e: Mahesh finally gives fans the massy, no-social-message commercial performance they have wanted for years, but Trivikram’s exhausted family-conflict writing gives him very little to work with. The star is energetic; the movie around him is disappointingly routine.
v: Not Agnyaathavaasi-level disaster... but definitely not good either 😪 Mahesh gives full energy after ages and somehow drags this routine Guruji family curry to watchable territory 🙏
body:
Let me make you clear this is Not #Agnyaathavaasi but not a Good Film either as Mahesh Babu is the only saving grace of this movie, who makes it a Decent Watch

Mahesh Babu finally tried to deliver something which fans wanted from him for so many years….a proper commercial movie with NO SOCIAL MESSAGE 🙏 and he succeeded in that with terrific Mass Look and Dialogue delivery but the only thing faltered is by believing in Trivikram to deliver Commercial Movie to him 😞

Kudos to Mahesh for giving his best to Dance and that too having dancer like Sree Leela against him is a huge challenge to his dancing capabilities….However he gave his best and unlike his previous attempts to dance this time he succeeded rather than making a Joke of himself

Trivikram should stop cooking stories around Family Conflicts to deliver Commercial potboilers…..there is no Juice left in this genre and he had to fill the story with unnecessary scenes to make a full fledged movie!!! Though there are couple of dialogues here and there but none of them could justify the GURUJI tag given to him 😞 and also there is no scene which could justify his masterclass!! Its high time Trivikram ditches the Family genre and move towards some other interesting concepts and also he should focus solely on his scripts and work rather than poking into scripts of PK thus creating a mess over there and here

Unlike their previous movies Athadu & Khaleja…which didn’t had good theatrical run but eventually achieved cult status….the duo of Mahesh & Trivikram wanted their third movie to be an instant commercial success and in process of trying to achieve that they forgot what the general audiences expected from their combination 🙄

Thaman should take a break…..none of the songs are upto the standards of a big hero movie!!! Tough BGM was good for action episodes but at-least for me it sounded out of place/sync for a Mother-Child Sentiment movie and would have been more apt for a Thriller

I think Guruji hired Sree Leela for a Dance number and for reasons known to him only extended her Dance Performances to multiple scenes across the movie this making her main heroine 🙏 …. its High Time for Sree Leela to start acting apart from Dancing Dancing & Dancing and trying to look/act cute in between Dances

Overall Guntur Kaaram with same subject and taking might have got bit better reviews and appreciation from audience if it had not been directed by Trivikram…..

e: Salaar feels like Prashanth Neel asking what would happen if Prabhas entered a KGF-sized world and then scaling the elevations, violence and action even further. The story beats may feel familiar, but the impact, Prabhas presentation and Prithviraj’s acting make the experience work.
v: Prashanth Neel basically asked: what if Prabhas did KGF at 10X volume? 😂 Elevations, violence, shadows, swag... 1000% paisa vasool if even 0.1% of you is a Prabhas fan 🙏
body:
Eye Feast to Prabhas fans….get ready Salaar Part 2 🙏 and Prashanth Neel was right about Salaar being his version of Game of Thrones and Prabhas being John Snow 😉

Prashanth Neel Take a Bow….How many times you can use the same formula of elevations and actions and still come out with flying colours 🙏…. Salaar is 10X of KGF in Elevations, Violence & Stylish Fights, it’s just a What if scenario of What would happen if Prabhas did KGF 😍

Prashanth Neel made the best use of Prabhas Cut Out and have hardly gave him any dialogues which was a master stroke as in the recent movies we have seen the dialogue delivery of Prabhas has been ridiculous….This is the best usage of Prabhas which even Rajamouli failed to utilise!!!! Man he can give Goosebumps just with Shadow of Prabhas, he doesn’t even need his full cut out 🙇

There was nothing much to do for Prabhas apart from giving some breath taking poses in action episodes and elevation scenes….Prithviraj was the apt choice as Vardha and he took care of all the acting part 🫡 Tough Shruthi Hassan had a minor role she did her job well and especially her English Accent as NRI was too good 👍

Music by Ravi Basur was not extraordinary as it was in KGF but he did good job in elevation & action episodes…Special Call out to that Engine Starting Sound and those relevant dialogues from Kids when Deva is getting Triggered 😍

Content wise the First half reminded me of Prabhas very own Raghavendra movie and second half is a mix of multiple things…Tough every scene is not new and gibes us a feeling of being watched earlier but the impact it creates is worth watch

1000% Paisa Vasool if you are even a 0.1 % Prabhas Fan for others its a movie similar to the taking of KGF but Scaled upto 100 times 🙏

e: DUNKI has Hirani’s familiar mix of comedy and emotion, but the immigration struggle will naturally connect more strongly with NRIs and people who have faced visa problems. SRK is solid, Taapsee works well, but Vicky Kaushal gives the film its most powerful emotional stretch.
v: Not Hirani’s best for me, but still a good one. SRK is solid, Vicky is 🔥 and if you’ve ever fought with visas/immigration, this will probably hit much harder 🥲
body:
The reason behind Rajkumar Hirani’s movies being favourite of critics as well as public like Munna Bhai Series, PK, 3 Idiots are due to the facts that they have universal content which connects with Mass, Class, North & South Indian, NRI audiences alike along with mix of wonderful Emotions and Comedy ….. Dunki has a good mix of Emotions and Comedy but the universal connectivity to the core story is what lacking in this movie, People who are NRI’s and the ones who are aspiring to go to foreign countries having Visa issues will connect well to the plot bit for others its bit difficult to understand the emotions of the characters

Coming to SRK, after back to back massy characters he tried to portray a content driven character. But some how I felt he didn’t look good in the old age character tough he played his age 😉

Bollywood should stop involving Punjabi nativity in every other movie because first of all its hard for the audience from other parts of india to understand the Punjabi influenced Hindi dialect and secondly there are no good leading actors who can portray Punjabi characters to perfection. Even SRK didn’t suited to the character but he was far better than Amir Khan from Lalitha Singh Chada

Tapsee Pannu and others portrayed their roles well….and Man what a time Vickey Kaushal is having 🙏 he is the gem of an actor and his story is the key to the emotional content of the movie for which everyones gets tears 🥲

Overall it may be not the best work of Raju Hirani but still far better than any other Bollywood directors Best!!!! and content wise tough it may appeal to lesser audience but it is one of the best content for SRK in last decade

e: ANIMAL is less a conventional movie and more an intentionally extreme experience: violent, vulgar, technically polished, frequently excessive and impossible to react to with a single emotion. Ranbir is phenomenal, the BGM and cinematography elevate the madness, and Sandeep Reddy Vanga goes far beyond anything he attempted in Arjun Reddy.
v: Probably the first FAMILY movie you should never watch with family 😉 Vanga goes full mad mode here. WOW, WTF, delight, disgust... everything at once. Ranbir is 🔥
body:
Sandeep Reddy Vanga is probably the first director in the History of World Cinema who made a Family Movie which cannot be watched with Family 😉

Rajamouli was absolutely right in saying Sandeep Reddy Vanga is this generation’s Ram Gopal Varma…..this film is atleast 10x of what Arjun Reddy was 🙏 in all aspects

If you are a traditional film lover or the one of those intellectuals who question how can a single person bash 100’s of persons, If you are a feminist, if you are the one who cant handle vulgar actions and dialogues on screen….then this movie is not for you, please don’t waste your time

This is not a movie which can be handled by regular movie goers…..it’s an EXPERIENCE where you have wow moments & what the fuck moments equally….in some portions you will sympathise with the lead actor and in few you will hate him to the core, in some parts you will feel how well its been portrayed and in some you will feel its dragged to the core 🙏 All in All its a Movie of Mixed Emotions….where you experience everything starting from DELIGHT to DISGUST, from being WOW to being YACK!!!

starting with Technicalities, the title ANIMAL is apt suited for this movie with well designed BGM and CINEMATOGRAPHY to up the visual and audio experience of whats being unleashed on screen…..

Acting wise….there is no doubt who is going to win all the famous awards this season and its Ranbir Kapoor for sure, Anil Kapoor did a terrific job as Dad and I was pleasantly surprised with the characterisation and acting of Rashmika, if at all there is any sensible char in this movie thats is of Geethanjali played by Rashmika 🙏

All others characters played their part really well….and though it was more of a special cameo out of almost 3.5 hrs movie Bobby Deol did a terrific job

Post Kabir Singh (Hindi version of Arjun Reddy) Sandeep openly said in few interviews that he was hurt with few reviewers calling it a Violent movie and he will make a movie to show them what actual Violence is….. And I am still in trance of why and how he chose a Family Back Drop to showcase such mad violence, definitely he is Content Creator with IRON BALLS 🙏

e: MANGALAVAARAM impressed me with both its courage and its craft. Ajay Bhupathi tackles physically and emotionally disturbing material without playing safe, Payal Rajput gives an exhausting committed performance, and the cinematography and Ajaneesh Loknath’s BGM turn the thriller into a haunting audiovisual experience.
v: BOLD, RAW, RUSTIC... and absolutely not for sensitive viewers 🙏 Payal goes all in, Ajay Bhupathi doesn’t play safe and that BGM + camera work are 🔥
body:
I bow down to the Brilliance of Ajay Bhupathi and his team 🙏

Never expected an out & out BOLD, RAW & RUSTIC Telugu movie which throws a direct slap on the face of Hypocritical Society and gives a valuable lesson of rather than Judging a Book by its Cover we should understand what is going on with a person both Physically & Mentally!!!

It needs Guts to write such a story and execute it to near perfection…..and also needs guts to play such a Bold and Emotionally Exhausting Role irrespective of how their current career is and hats-off to Payal for pulling out that role 🫡

Cinematography by Dasaradhi Sivendra is top notch and almost 75% frames of the movie are wall paper worthy 😍 and especially the scenes shot in low light are worth watching!!!!

Music & BGM by Ajaneesh Loknath is the soul of this Thriller which can give Anirudh’s BGM a Run for their money…….and it was no surprise for me when I came to know that he is also the Music Director for Kantara 😍

Each and every Character of the story played an excellent role to give that Thriller feeling……special Shout Out to Ajay Gosh, he was awesome 👍

Having said all the above this movie is a strict NO for the Sensible persons who can’t handle Guts Wrenching Emotions associated with Sexual and Physical Abuse…..so if you are sensitive to the above its better to skip this movie else the visuals will haunt you 😞

e: Tiger 3 finally gives Salman Khan a solid commercial film again. The story is wafer-thin and YRF’s Pakistan obsession is exhausting, but Salman-Katrina chemistry, entertaining action and the franchise’s continued respect for its female lead make it a decent spy entertainer.
v: Finally a good Salman movie after ages 🙏 Story is thin and I’m tired of Pakistan spy stories, but Bhai + Katrina + action make it a decent festival watch 😉
body:
Kabhi EID…..Kabhi DIWALI

BHAI ke movie binnaa….Festival hai AADHURI 😉😉

A Good Film by Salman after ages 🙏🙏🙏🙏 which makes it a Decent watch….when I say Decent its just because of the high dose of Spy Thrillers in Bollywood

When it comes to Bollywood Spy Thrillers and especially Yash Raj’s Spy Universe I don’t understand why they are so obsessed with Pakistan and this movie took it to a notch higher with Indian Raw Agent trying to uplift the Democracy in Pakistan 🙏. Though it sounds over the top but Anything is possible with Salman Bhai and at least for me it looked convincing 👍. Hope this is the last spyverse movie obsessed with Pakistan 🙏

I love Tiger Franchise for being the first fully commercial Top Star movie giving equal importance to Female Lead characterisation and good to see that they still continued doing that….as with any other Spy Movie tough the story line is wrapper thin and has its own flaws, The Action Scenes and the Actors chemistry make it up to a good watch if not must watch!!!

For the people who are comparing Tiger3 craze with Pathan, I just want to remind them that the craze for Pathaan was just for the fact that SRK os doing a spy thriller for the very first time and I wonder if he can pull the same craze for the next part of Pathan (if there is any) but Salman Khan doing that effortlessly even with 3rd Instalment of Tiger shows his command over masses and all he needs is to bend his back and select good scripts ( but a serious NO to TUBELIGHT 😉)

The only disappointment I had with this movie is with its Music…forget about Pathaan even the first two instalments of Tiger had very peppy songs….but these songs are 😏

e: SKANDA lost me from the very first scene and never found a way back. A hero introduced as a foreign-university topper and ethical hacker solves everything by flexing muscles, the action becomes parody-level excess, and Thaman’s usually helpful BGM only amplifies the chaos.
v: Nolan gaadi movies decode cheyatam kaadhu raaa... dammunte SKANDA decode cheyandi 🙏🤣 Ram looks good, dances well... migatha antha Boyaaa universe torture.
body:
Nolan gadi movies decode cheyatam kadhuraaaa…..meeku dammunte maa Boyaaa anna Skanda decode cheyandi 🙏🙏🙏

This is how the product is made when the makers think that their audience are senseless….Agreed that there are many out and out illogical mass masala movies which have become blockbusters in recent past but they were successful in grabbing the audience attention in at-least one or other department and thus making them completely forget about the logics and enjoy what is shown, but unfortunately in Skanda you get disconnected right from the first scene itself and the there is no point of getting reconnected to the movie or the plot.

When you establish the Hero’s character as a Foreign University Topper and outstanding Ethical Hacker…then the least we expect is that he uses his INTELLIGENCE in cornering the Villains (in this case 2 states CM’s 🤣😉) BUT BUT BUT thats Nolans way of movie making but in Boya’s way the heros just flexes his muscle power and thats it 🙏

Looks like all the action scenes where choreographed by Mutton Kottu Masthan 🤣 Generally Thaman has this ability to take an ordinary scene to next level with his BGM and that has become a huge minus for this movie as the scenes were already Over the Top and with his BGM they were just unbearable 🫡

Taking wise the movie is shot in typical Boya’s style where the screen is filled with hundreds of character artists whose only duty is to get dressed and give over expressions and deliver over the top dialogues praising the Hero/Villan 🙏

The only positives about this movie are Ram’s Looks and Ram-Sreeleela’s dances!!! Except them everything else is unbearable

e: Miss Shetty Mr Polishetty impressed me with how comfortably it handles a bold modern relationship idea without making the audience uncomfortable. Naveen proves he is far more than a comedy actor, Anushka fits the mature character beautifully, and the writing balances witty one-liners with genuine emotion.
v: Beautiful, bold and mature love story 🙏 Naveen is much more than comedy, Anushka fits perfectly... only the actual stand-up comedy could have been funnier 😄
body:
Excellent Movie for New age audience…..

First and Foremost I need to talk about the brilliance of the Writer & Director Mahesh Babu…for effortlessly blending a bold subject with subtle comedy and showcasing it in a manner where it appeals to larger audience without making them feel uncomfortable. The witty one liners as well the emotional dialogues, Mahesh Babu has got everything perfectly balanced 🙏 I guess this is his first movie but yet he proved that he belongs to the class of directors like Karan Johar & Imtiaz Ali in conveying bold and mature love stories with ease 😍

Naveen Polishetty is a true actor where his acting capabilities are not only limited to comedy but man he easily topped with his performances in emotional scenes as well…..its just because of his acting that made the chemistry between Anushka and Him so adorable and believable 🙏

Tough Anushka’s physique and screen presence has been impacted due to her weight issues but she was on dot with her acting and suited perfectly for the matured women character

Kudos to the Production house and the director for bringing together a star heroine and an upcoming yet Talented actor together for a bold story which was presented so beautifully and gracefully 🙏🙏🙏 Special mention to the dialogues be it comedy or emotional ones 🫡

The only disappointment I had in this movie was the Standup Comedy parts should have been better and engaging as I felt the normal scenes has more comedy than the stand up parts 😞 Nevertheless I came out of theatre with a satisfaction of watching a Beautiful Bold and Mature Love Story

e: JAWAN offers very little that feels new to a regular South Indian commercial-cinema audience, but that barely matters when Atlee packages familiar social-message and mass ingredients around SRK with this much energy. Nayanthara and Vijay Sethupathi are strong, but SRK steals the show because... BAAP baap hota hai 😉
v: If Pathaan was starter, JAWAN is full SOUTH INDIAN MASS THALI 😍🤣 Nothing new for us South folks, but watching SRK go full Atlee-mass is a proper fan treat.
body:
if you are SRK fan then #Pathaan was just a starter where as JAWAN is a proper full fledged yummy in your tummy SOUTH INDIAN TREAT because all of a sudden SRK tried to be a RAJINI and its a pure MASSY TREAT to fans 🙏🙏🙏

Tough Vijay Sethupathi and Nayantara shined well and did excellent job but at the end its only SRK steals the show kyon ki woh BAAP hai 😉

Tough BGM was good but it didn’t meet the standards set by Anirudh himself 😢

Special mention of the one liner dialogues which give full kick to the fans 🙏🙏

Content wise it looked like during lockdown SRK has watched various South Indian Movies and got inspired to do a Message Oriented Movie on :

1. Bank Frauds like Mahesh Babu’s Sarkaru Vaari Paata

2. Worst Conditions of our Government Health Care System like Venkatesh’s Ganesh

3. Importance of Voting for Right Candidates like Vijay’s Sarkar

4. Cute Father & Daughter sentiment movie like Vijay’s Theri

5. Massy Father & Son Dual role commercial like Vijay’s Bigil

6. Massy movie surrounded by Girls like Vijay’s Bigil

so he called Atlee who is the director of Theri and Bigil and he made a Commercial Kichidi content with a plot covering main points from all the above movies treated with a typical Atlee’s Screenplay and Direction and Bang we have one of the best commercial movie for SRK Ready 😍🤣

for a regular audience of South Indian Movie this film offers nothing new except for the treat if watching SRK doing an out and out commercial

One thing for sure is this movie will definitely open doors for Top South Indian Directors to work with Top Bollywood Stars…..

e: KUSHI is pleasant more than powerful. Vijay Deverakonda is back in a likeable boy-next-door zone, Samantha fits the grounded role easily and their chemistry carries the film, but the interesting atheist-vs-believer marriage conflict never reaches the emotional depth its premise promises.
v: No big HIGH, no big disappointment either. Vijay + Samantha are cute together and make KUSHI an easy one-time watch... just wish the core conflict hit harder.
body:
A Good Decent Entertainer which neither gives you any major High nor disappoints either……

After LIGER’s debacle Vijay Devarakonda is back to playing Boy Next Door kind character and he is a treat to watch….After watching this movie I think he should be trying an Out and Out Comedy character at least once and I am sure he will kill it with ease!!!

After a Long Gap Samantha played a role which doesn’t need her stardom to carry and was a typical girl next door kind of char which Samantha donned with ease……

More than the acting power of the lead pair its their fresh pairing and cute chemistry that worked well for the film….First half of the film was decent and passable with the setup and chemistry of the lead pair and its the second half which had the main conflict.

On Paper the concept of Problems faced in new marriages with Atheist vs Orthodox Believers sounds interesting but the execution was not much effective especially when the movie draws a comparison with old Mani Rathnam Classics which dealt with similar Newly Wed couple challenges and also for the standards of the director Shiva whose first two movies were excellent if not classics.

I personally felt that the climax which had a strong point to convey was not properly executed 😞 but overall its a good one time watch movie which you will not regret watching on big screen!!!!

e: OMG 2 connected with me almost scene by scene. The way it blends sex education, religion, humour and courtroom drama makes a difficult subject accessible without diluting its message, while Pankaj Tripathi, Yami Gautam, Akshay Kumar and the supporting cast elevate already strong writing.
v: ENTERTAIN + ENLIGHTEN 🙏 OMG 2 handles a taboo subject with humour, religion and solid writing without turning into a lecture. Parents, please watch this one.
body:
You watch few movies for Entertainment and few for Enlightenment…..and very rarely you find a movie which Entertains & Enlightens you on few topics which are considered Taboo!!!! Fortunately OMG2 falls in that category 🙏🙏🙏

The way the Content Creators have blended Sexual Education with Religion is terrific and hard hitting just to make the masses connect and realise the main motive of the movie!!!!

Its a Must Watch for All the Parents who wants to understand their teenage kids problems….

I got so connected to the movie that each and every scene and dialogue was clap worthy for me…the overall content has been enhanced by the great actors like Pankaj Tripathi, Yami Gautam, Akshay Kumar and all other actors who did 200% justice to their respective roles!!!

when I watched OMG 1, I was very impressed with the content but OMg 1 is nothing when compared to the brilliance of OMG 2!!!

You May or May Not Like it based on your sensibilities and how open are you towards the taboo of Sexual Education but irrespective of that this movie is a must watch if you are a parent!!!

e: I entered GADAR 2 worried that my changed sensibilities might ruin the affection I still had for the 2001 original. Within 15 minutes, the nostalgia took over. Once Tara Singh enters Pakistan, logic disappears, the goosebumps return and Sunny Deol reminds you exactly why this character became iconic.
v: 22 years later, I went in with grown-up logic and came out waiting for Tara Singh to enter Pakistan 😂 Pure nostalgia + Sunny Deol + hand pump goosebumps 🙏
body:
Back in 2001 when I had just stepped into Intermediate First Year which was much much before Social Media Era….there was an Euphoria about couple of newly Released Hindi Films which was unusual in a town called Guntur in AP where it was very rare at that time for a Hindi movie to have a direct release….


Being a Teenager who has limited scope and understanding about the World and was yet to build my own perspectives about things….I loved the Innocence of Tara Singh and the Love Story between him and his Madam Ji!!!! And later in the second half have got goosebumps when Tara Singh was bashing Pakistani Goons and Army with his bare hands with a little help from the iconic Hand Pump 😇

Cut to present after 22 years when Gadar 2 was announced, I was skeptical about how I would be approaching this movie as many of my sensibilities have changed along with my perspective of the world and borders and especially people of Pakistan…….I was wondering if the new movie would look cringe to me and may be it will impact my love for the Gadar 1!!!!

With all the above doubts I stepped into the theatre today with almost knowing what the story is about…..BUT BUT BUT after 10, 15 mine into the movie I forgot about all my perspectives & sensibilities & logic and got completely sucked into the movie….I was becoming restless dying to see when Tara Singh steps into Pakistan……and once he steps in it was goosebumps as usual and I enjoyed it throughly and the director has played with my emotions by throwing us glimpses of Gadar 1 at crucial junctures and YES the iconic Hand Pump makes a comeback but this time with dignity 🤣

This movie is more or less a tribute to Sunny Deol who was in series of flops in recent decade and obviously will have flops again in the future….but Gadar 2 reminds us what he is capable of 🙏

The 2 iconic songs (Ghar Aaja Pardesi & Mein Nikala Ghadi Leke) has been retained and they still have the same magic similar to 22 years ago 🙏🙏

If you have watched Gadar 1 in 2001 then Gadar 2 is a must watch as it serves as a wonderful medium of that Era of Bollywood where Massy Desh Bhakth movies were a trend…..if you are a genx kid then its better to stay away from this movie as it doesn’t suit the current generation sensibilities!!!!

e: BHOLA SHANKAR feels less like a movie and more like a చిరు ఉపాధి పధకం for people desperate to work with Chiranjeevi. The outdated remake, weak music, cringe comedy and wasted Vedalam moments convinced me that Chiru urgently needs fresher directors and content rather than another fan-driven project.
v: Bad remake, weak music, cringe comedy... but hey, still better than Aacharyaaa 💪😂 Chiru really needs to get out of this bhajana-batch remake zone.
body:
Don’t let the regular movie reviews fool you, this Mehar Ramesh’s Remake is still better than Koritala Shiva’s Original Masterpiece Aacharyaaa 💪 … this is not a movie its more of a చిరు ఉపాధి పధకం to all his fans to be a part of his movie 🙏

I strongly believe that Chiru should stop entertaining his so called fans in giving chances in acting or any other departments…..🙏 This movie is a perfect example of how lame the whole product could be when you blindly give chance to your so called fans or Bhajana Batch!!!

Irrespective of how good or bad the movie is, the music in Chiru’s movie never disappoints….but thanks and courtesy to Mahathi Sagar this movie disappoints in music too 😞

Looks like the producers and Chriu himself wanted to make some quick bucks and hence they bought remake rights of any outdated story may be at a reasonable price and thats the only noteworthy investment of this movie 🤣 They have onboarded all other Actors and Technicians who are dying for a chance to work or work with the Mega Star and are either willing by to work for free or even pay the producer to be a part of this film….It was more like చిరు ఉపాధి పధకం to all his fans

When this movie was announced, though everyone was skeptical about it….I still had a feeling that Vedhalam had couple of stylish and high octane scenes which suite Mehar Ramesh’s style of film making but unfortunately he messed up with those scenes as well!!!

I was always a huge fan of Chiru’s comedy timing but somehow I felt his comedy in this movie was cringe to the core…..what was suppose to be a different attempt from Chriu to imitate Pawan was a total failure and looked very artificial….The Nadumu scene from Kushi which was supposed to be cute and romantic in the original was totally made cringe 🙄

Its high time for Chiru to work with new age directors and content for that matter even Dark Themed movies rather than working on Remakes which doesn’t offer anything new and also he should stop working with his so called Fans who blindly follow him and thus giving Chiru an upper hand in driving the content 😢

PS : Pawan Kalyan sudden ga Women Trafficking gurunchi matladinapude telusukovalsindi Bhola Shankar promotions chesthunadani 😉

e: JAILER is average-to-good as a film, but Nelson succeeds at something many recent directors struggled with: balancing Rajinikanth’s larger-than-life style with enough story to hold the movie together. The cameos and Anirudh’s terrific BGM provide most of the extra theatrical lift.
v: Half-cooked story maybe... but Rajini swag + those cameos + Anirudh BGM make JAILER a proper theatre treat 🙏 Far better than his recent lot.
body:
after a long time…..its a treat for Thailvar Fans!!!! Nelson has achieved what most of the new age director’s failed to achieve, i.e to find a reasonable balance between Rajni’s style without going overboard and a decent story.

Content wise a half cooked to decent story which is in line with the format of Vikram with good twists….but its Rajni’s swag and cameos by Siva Rajkumar, Mohan Lal, Jack Shroff elevated with Anirudh’s terrific BGM that holds the movie for a neutral audience!!!

Overall a Average to Good movie which could have been better but a far far far better movie from Rajni in recent past!!!!

e: My first Adipurush watch in Telugu 2D was overwhelmingly disappointing: bad dubbing, weak emotional connection, questionable casting and shockingly poor CGI. A later 3D rewatch improved the visual experience somewhat, but it could not fix the deeper problems in vision, character depth and execution.
v: Music super. Migatha antha almost disaster 🤦‍♂️ 3D made the CGI a little less painful, but casting, dubbing and emotions were still nowhere close to what Ramayana deserved.
body:
recently my friend Sandeep pointed out that most of my reviews start with the phrase “though I am not a big fan of ….” which made me realise that I have been using same pattern repeatedly…..Thanks to him I am trying to change my writing style, so this review is dedicated to him 🙏🙏🙏

to start off, I have watched Adipurush in TELUGU and 2D Version in CINIPOLIS, so my review is purely based on that experience…

NEGATIVE’s :
