1. The Telugu dub has been horrible….there are lip sync issues even for Prabhas dialogues

2. Not sure how was the Star Cast selected…at least for me none of them looked perfect fit

3. Prabhas was expression less and Saif was over expressive in their respective roles…may be due to the high CGI involved 🤷🏻‍♂️

4. Though its a known story and we have been hearing this epic all along if you look at this movie as a standalone then there is no point in the movie where we can get emotionally connected to the onscreen characters….every emotion looked artificial without proper character depth!!! the only saving grace is that we all are well versed with the characters and we already known why a specific character behaves (thanks to the Puranas)

5. The CGI experience in 2D is HORRIBLE to say least….the Pillamari Raju shown in Omkar annaya’s Mayadeepam had far better Demons representation than this 300 crores epic 🤣

6. Coming to Graphics….forget about International standards these were on par when compared to our Indian Daily Soaps 🤦‍♂️

POSITIVE:

1. The only best thing for this movie is its wonderful BGM & Songs 🙌

after watching this epic movie my respect for Rajamouli grew multiple folds….as only intention to make a grand movie is not enough you need to have a great Vision, Visualisation and Execution to bring that grandness on screen 🙏

also previously I commented on Gunashekar for repeatedly trying to make periodic movies like Rudramadevi and Shakunthalam with below par graphics….but after watching this movie I felt Gunashekhar would have made a better Ramayana then Om Rauth!!!!

finally going to watch this movie again in 3D this Sunday….hope that at-least changes my views on CGI 🤞

Currently there is a ticket reserved for Lord Hanuman in each theatre but looking at the viewer’s experience post weekend the whole theatre should be reserved for Vanara Saynam 🙏

After watching the movie again today in 3D, i felt that 3D version is far better in providing quality experience of whatever they made….where as 2D version was just horrible. I wonder why even they released a 2D version which has led to this disastrous talk for the movie, whereas the 3D version audiences will at least give an average experience to viewers for CGI

e: As someone who gets scared even by Chandramukhi-level horror, I still walked into VIRUPAKSHA for the love of good cinema. The first half takes time to build its world, but the supernatural thriller elements, twists, technical craft and Samyuktha Menon’s performance make the second half genuinely rewarding.
v: I’m a coward with horror movies 😢 and VIRUPAKSHA still dragged me in 😂 Slow first half, terrific second half, killer BGM... and yes, my sleep was gone for a few days.
body:
I am basically a timid guy when it comes to Horror movies and got shit scared even watching the likes of Chandramukhi & Arundathi…..but its just my love towards good cinema that made me watch this movie inspite of my weakness!!!

though we cannot categorise this movie into Horror genre its more of a THRILLER but with supernatural elements its loaded with good thrills and twist’s especially in the second half….the BGM and Cinematography has been mind blowing and elevate the tempo of the movie!!!

The first half though bit slow (considering the love stories) will set up good premise for the second half with proper characters buildup….and the second half takes you for a good thrill ride 👌

I felt Sai Dharam Tej was misfit for the character as his dialogue diction was numb and didn’t add to the confidence shown by the character onscreen, but considering what he had gone through in his personal life….its a perfect comeback for him!!!!

Samyuktha Menon has been a show stealer and has effortlessly performed in crucial scenes…all the other cast have did their job to the mark!!!

there would be certain expectations if you are coming from Sukumar’s camp…and the director Karthik Varma Dandu had certainly met them all and in my opinion has been the best one to come when compared to other directors from Sukumar’s camp!!!

I loved the aspect of the writer/director not trying to showcase the supernatural elements as myth or giving some scientific justification but they rather genuinely stick to the genre irrespective of their personal beliefs 👌👌

PS : I am definitely sure that this movie will definitely impact my sleep for the days to come 😢 have to go through all this just because of my unconditional love towards movies 😉

e: RAVANASURA shows the recurring problem when established heroes attempt darker roles but the film still feels obligated to protect the hero image. Ravi Teja as a baddie is the one interesting element; predictable justification, weak songs and average BGM prevent Sudheer Varma’s thriller from ever becoming exciting.
v: Ravi Teja as a psycho baddie sounded exciting... movie మాత్రం got scared and protected the HERO image again 🤦‍♂️ Best idea in the film, mostly wasted.
body:
the major problem with established hero’s trying something new or off beat is that they don’t dive completely into it and stay true to the genre and instead try to balance it out with commercial elements, eventually ending up with neither this nor that….and Ravanasura is a perfect example of that!!!!

another problem is when established hero’s try Negative/Psycho Path characters there should be a must needed twist stating that either he is acting like a baddie to catch real culprits or Killing only the baddies because of his emotional flashback…..only to justify hero’s image!!!!

the only hope I had on this film was due to its director Sudheer Varma, but man he disappointed me to the core…..though Ravi Teja as a Psycho Path was new and treat to watch but at no point we feel excited as we already know that eventually would be a Good person with a purpose 🤦‍♂️

Ravi Teja’s negative shade is the only positive in this movie and I honestly felt that he is far better as a baddie when compared to his now routine loud comedy…..

Songs are a BIG MINUS and BGM is just average…..apart from Sudheer Varma, its the Ravanasura title song which grabbed my attention and was one of the reason for me to be eager for this movie….but after watching I am not convinced even if the Title is apt for this movie 🤷🏻‍♂️

PS : I even didn’t like Dhamaka as well, but it turned out to be a hit….so may be Ravi Teja’s no barriers held negative characteristics may strike a chord with movie lovers!!!!

e: BALAGAM is the only movie in this archive that made me watch it twice before writing my experience. Its deeply rooted story proves that simple local lives can hold universal emotion, while Bheems’ music, natural performances and Venu Yeldandi’s surprisingly assured direction make the film feel lived rather than acted.
v: Watched it twice before I could even write about it 🙏 BALAGAM is simple, rooted and beautiful... and yes, this RGV fan had wet eyes in a few scenes 😢
body:
this is the only movie which I had to watch twice before writing my experience…..Myself a self proclaimed fan and follower of RGV had my eyes wet with emotion atleast on 2, 3 scenes while watching this masterpiece 🙏🙏

Content wise this movie has once again proved that as a writer if you are sticking to your roots then you are surrounded with thousands of simple yet beautiful and emotional stories which you can share with the modern world…….

Songs, Lyrics and BGM are the heart of this movie and was more than surprised to see its been scored by Bheems known for his out and out commercial movies his last album before Balgam being Dhamaka 🙏

Each and every actor gave their best and I almost felt like they were not acting and living the characters 🙏🙏🙏

Finally coming to the Director Venu 👌👌 well who can expect that a comedian and that too who became famous with the Jabardast shows can write and direct such a heart touching emotional content 🙏🙏🙏 He once again proved the fact that don’t judge a book by its cover…..

People like me who missed this on big screen should not miss it on OTT…..

e: Dasara had the ingredients for a stronger village political drama, but the writing shifts focus and never feels fully cooked. What keeps it engaging is Nani stepping convincingly into a raw mass role, supported by terrific cinematography, strong action staging and an effective BGM.
v: Nani is terrific in this raw mass avatar and the visuals are 🔥 Story మాత్రం felt half-cooked for me. Good one-time watch, could have been much more.
body:
an average movie which could be watched only for the performances of its lead cast…and Raw Cinematography!!!

content wise this movie had the potential to showcase good political drama setup in a village from early 90’s….however the writer/director wanted to avoid the obvious comparisons with Rangasthalam and shifted the focus towards Love vs Lust concept and hence content wise this movie looks like half cooked…but the director balanced the limitation in content with some terrific cinematography and raw action scenes….though the music is average BGM has been very good to lift the mood of the action and emotional scenes

its Nani’s performance that stands out…this is the first time he tried such a raw and massy role (may be Jenda Pai Kapiraju and Paisa can be ignored here for obvious reasons) and he once again proved that he is an excellent actor….as we are used to boy next door roles of Nani, it will take us some time to sync in with his Telangana Accent and Massy Looks!!!!

Overall a One Time Watch……

e: Das Ki Dhamki works because Vishwak Sen commits completely to the commercial format while still giving himself room to perform. The first half is entertaining, the twists keep the screenplay moving, and his second role plus Leon James’ BGM give the film its strongest moments.
v: Proper commercial timepass with Vishwak doing almost everything 😄 Fun first half, nice twists, solid second role... and Leon James BGM gives it a good kick.
body:
to start with I was never a fan of Vishwak Sen and hated Phalaknana Das to the core for its slow and over realistic portrayal…..but his recent performances have grabbed my attention and was eager to know how this movie would turn out given a fact that he tried full length commercial movie for the very first time!!!

coming to the content, its a proper commercial plot with first half focused on setting up the interval block with good entertainment and hit songs….and a twist during interval and followed by another twist during middle of second half!!! but the direction and acting of Vishwak Sen is what that add’s value to the script.

Acting wise Vishwak was at his casual best during the first half and its the second character which has the potential to showcase his acting power and Man he simply nailed it, though few of the audience may find it bit overboard…..for some reason I felt Nivetha Pethuraj did lot of over acting, may be due to her characterisation!!! All the other artists were at their usual best…

Special mention of the BGM by Leon James as it elevated the action and suspense scenes 🙏

Overall a Good watch….

e: Ranga Maarthaanda may tell a broadly familiar story about ageing parents and changing family relationships, but the stage-artist perspective gives it added depth. Prakash Raj is predictably excellent, while Brahmanandam delivers the revelation of the film with a deeply emotional performance that completely changes how we see him.
v: Story may feel familiar, but Prakash Raj + Brahmanandam make this a MUST WATCH 🙏 Watching Brahmi make us cry after decades of making us laugh... unforgettable.
body:
Few years back I first saw the Teaser of Marathi film Natsamrat acted by great Nana Patekar and directed by Mahesh Manjrekar….It immediately grabbed my attention as it had an Actor and Director whom I adore a lot, though I haven’t watched the movie due to language constraints nor did I knew the plot but I came to know that it was critically acclaimed….

years later when I came to know that Krishna Vamsi is remaking the same movie and had Prakash Raj in it, I was equally excited that another Director and Actor whom I adore are remaking the same movie which I missed to watch…..so this is one such movie which I couldn’t miss watching on Big Screen irrespective of what the talk was 😊

Coming to the story its similar to the lines of BaghBaan starring Amitabh and Hema Malini and many such similar movies which deals with the concept of looking at our parents and the challenges faced by them in this modern world and career oriented and practical kids…..though there is nothing new in the story the way the screenplay included a Stage Artists struggle in the modern day has been excellent

We all know how excellent is Prakash Raj as an actor and this movies just reminds us why he is considered as the best…..but the original show stealer in this movie is Brahmanandam….we all have grown up watching his comedy and cherish the memes created using his funny expressions….but this time he makes us CRY with his excellent portrayal of an emotional character and man he is an excellent actor which we failed to realise watching him doing comedy!!! Hope this will be a new phase in his career and he will do many such roles in future🙏🙏

Shivathmika is a surprise in this movie as she made her presence felt with her acting skills and didn’t get faded away among the acting pioneers….Rahul Sipligunj and Anasuya also made their presence felt…

Illayaraja music and BGM are soothing and lyrics have superb depth!!! Dialogues are excellent and have great philosophical depth…

Overall what could have been good watch if you haven’t watched similar themed movies has become a MUST WATCH just because of Brahmanandam & Prakash Raj

e: Writer Padmabhushan moves through a pleasant but fairly average middle stretch before revealing the emotional idea that gives the film its identity. The final thirty minutes are the heart of the movie, with Rohini and Ashish Vidyarthi emerging as the true show-stealers alongside an effortless Suhas.
v: Started nice, became average... then those last 30 mins hit ❤️ Rohini + Ashish Vidyarthi completely changed the movie for me. Must watch for that emotion alone.
body:
I still can’t believe that I missed this movie on big screen 😞 MUST WATCH for its pure emotion…..

a movie which starts on a good note and continues with average stuff and entertainment here and there ends at an excellent note…..the last 30 mins is the heart of this movie which otherwise would have been an average fare!!!!

its been a cake walk for Suhas…..but the show stealers are Rohini & Ashish Vidyarthi 🙏🙏🙏

the movie could have been made far much better for its pure emotion but the budget constraints might have led to the compromise but the scenes picturization and screenplay looks natural…..

e: Tu Jhoothi Main Makkaar follows Luv Ranjan’s familiar relationship-comedy template, but Ranbir Kapoor and Shraddha Kapoor bring fresh chemistry and the film finds its strongest rhythm after the interval. The crazy climax is exactly the kind of comic escape that makes the whole conflict work without over-explaining it.
v: Typical Luv Ranjan madness 😄 First half takes its sweet time, but interval nunchi full fun... and that crazy climax made the whole thing work for me 🤣
body:
if you are a fan of Luv Ranjan’s format of films….then once again Tu Jhoothi Main Makkar is a must watch!!!!

it follows similar Luv Ranjan’s template and dialogue formats and man this movie though looks similar in bits and pieces to his previous films….has way more entertainment value 👌

Interval Block, Second Half & Crazy Climax are the super strength of this movie where as First Half though sets the tone could be made better…

Ranbir Kapoor & Shradha Kapoor have sizzling chemistry and have been a fresh pair on screen….and they both did a fantastic job 👌 but somewhere the die hard fan in me who enjoyed and loved the trio of Luv Ranjan, Karthik Aaryan & Nushrat was disappointed a bit as I thought they would have been perfect fit for this role….but the guest appearance of Karthik & Nushrat was a pleasant surprise 😊

All the supporting cast did a wonderful job and off-late Dimple Kapadia is getting some note worthy characters and she is killing it

Special mention to the crazy climax, I was wondering how the director would justify the conflict points between main chars as justifying one would show others in negative!!! but man the director choose to go for crazy climax which would be laugh riot and you will be never bothered about the justification 🤣

overall a Good Watch….

e: Pathaan worked for me as exactly the comeback vehicle Shah Rukh Khan needed: unapologetically large, stylish and crowd-pleasing. The film may not be technically flawless, but its cast, action, terrific BGM and Spy Universe ambition make those imperfections very easy to ignore.
v: SRK comeback ante ila undali 😍 Swagger, action, Deepika, John, killer BGM... and when physics itself gives up, Salman Bhai Irukuuu!!! 🤣🔥
body:
EXCELLENT TREAT!!!!! I am still awestruck and would definitely watching it multiple times 😍 we all know that Bollywood has been going through worst phase with all round attack from Boycott gangs supported with weak content and Box-office Hijacked with Hindi Dubbed movies, and when nothing is working for them it needed the KING to come back from 4 years of Exile and a helping hand from BHAI JAAN to literally drag Bollywood out of trouble 🙏🙏🙏🙏

It has Good Content supported by all the actors who did a fabulous job along with all the terrific stunts and looking hot at the same time 😍 Technically the film may not be perfect but it will ensure you don’t care about those….BGM is TERRIFIC and Yash Raj Banner is known for its high production values!!!

a perfect comeback movie by SRK which makes even normal audience go wow and his die hard fans can only scream scream and scream…..Deepika too did a terrific job with her Stunts and Glamour!!! Same goes with John Abraham!!! overall just like how Iron Man has set up the future of Avengers…..Pathaan has nicely setup the Spy Verse for Indian Cinema 👌👌👌

to put it in Dil Raju’s perspective…….

e: Waltair Veerayya is formula cinema with limited story impact, but Bobby understands the nostalgic Chiranjeevi flavour his audience wants. The Srikakulam dialect, comedy timing and dance staging bring flashes of vintage Chiru even though the Ravi Teja track and climax never deliver the expected high.
v: Poonakalu raaledhu... kaani time-pass ayipoyindi 😄 Routine story and weak climax, but vintage Chiru comedy + dialect + dances gave me enough to enjoy once.
body:
Poonakalu raledhu gaani Time pass ayyipoyindi…..Bobby who is self proclaimed fan of Chiru, has made sure to present him in the massy avatar which has made him the Mega Star….but lack of impactful content and Chiru’s looks in few scenes (which somehow lost the grace) are the drawbacks

Though the content is ordinary and screenplay is commercial formula based, but its been ages last time Chiru has done such character and thats what make this film bearable for normal audience and bring back vintage feeling for his fans….Personally I got the vibes of Annaya, Shankar Dada and Andhariwadu vibes looking at the massy look, Srikakulam dialect and Comedy timing….which proves a point that though Chiru may have lost his charm in looks but his comedy timing is still intact and if any director wants to make an out and out comedy entertainer with him he still can do wonders 🙏 especially the way he sings Jambulakadi Jaru Mitaya song is 👌👌👌

Songs and BGM are pretty ordinary and doesnt have any impact….but the dances again are choreographed to give those vintage Chiru feel and thats worked well….

Unfortunately the much hyped Poonakalu in 2nd Half with Ravi Teja is missing as I expected much more impact other than a normal back story….Pre Climax and Climax episodes though Bobby tried to do something different didn’t gel well!!!!

overall its one time watch with routine direction and not so great content but definitely a far better movie for Chiru post comeback!!!!!

e: Veera Simha Reddy is designed almost entirely as Balakrishna fan-service. Gopichand Malineni lands a few elevations and political punches, but the familiar dual-role structure, repetitive fights and underwhelming music leave the film without the content needed to make those highs memorable.
v: Balayya elevations plenty... fresh content very little 🙏 Hardcore fans may enjoy, but for me this is nowhere near Simha, Legend or Akhanda.
body:
once again proved….except Boyapati!!! No one can give a High Elevations to Balaya along with kickass content…..Gopichand a self proclaimed fan of Bala Krishna got some good elevations and few political punches which will excite hardcore fans but failed to provide proper content to support those elevations

Coming to the content it follows the same template of Balaya’s enormous past movies which has him playing dual role with the so called younger role being a dummy and the senior being the most powerful 🙏 and a back story to support his cause…though Gopichand tried Sister Sentiment it reminded me of Chanakesava Reddy with a twist!!!

Except for the oora mass faction style fight in Istanbul nothing else was new….though the movie had around 7 fights, almost all the fight styles are same with just a change in the fighters and background 🙏

Thaman’s music which was a huge asset for films like Akhanda and others didn’t gel well with whats happening in the movie….

well the intention of Gopichand is clearly to serve the hardcore fan base of his fans and its clearly evident the way that the main song of the film which is written to praise the key character of the film has the name “Jai Balaya” where none of the characters name is Balaya or Balakrishna 🤣

Ultimate Content like Akhanda and Talk Show like Unstoppable has brought back the craze of Balakrishna, but him going back to choose subjects like this would impact his new found craze among the youth and family audience 😞

Movie may be an average Hit due to its commercial format or Festival season….but definitely will not create an impact which the movies like Simha, Legend or Akhanda have created!!!

e: Dhamaka doubles down on Trinadha Rao Nakkina’s familiar mix of loud comedy, convenient logic and manufactured sentiment. That formula may still work for its target mass audience, but for me it became so tiring that I walked out before the climax — while once again missing the effortless comic Ravi Teja of Venky and Dubai Seenu.
v: Last time Ravi Teja made me leave before climax was Khatarnak... Dhamaka proudly joined that club 🙏😪 Loud, tiring and made me miss Venky/Dubai Seenu Ravi Teja badly.
body:
hmmm….when was the last time I walked out of a Movie without watching the climax? KHATARNAK and bingo its Ravi Teja again with DHAMAKA 🙏

when Trinadha Rao is directs a movie you know what to expect out of it…..just like his previous movies Cinema Chupistha Mama & Nenu Local, this is also filled with illogical story and senseless characters with loud and over the top comedy and cringe sentiment in the name of middle class sentiments, which somehow miraculously works for him 🤷🏻‍♂️ and thats exactly Dhamaka is all about!!!!

not sure why Mass Maharaja Ravi Teja has been focusing on Powerful Characters rather than sticking to his original Mass Entertaining Roles….missing his style of comedy from Dubai Seenu’s and Venky’s 😞

Director struck to his core strength of catering to the mass audience and cared a damn about so called Multiplex audience…will not be surprised if this movie works in B & C centre’s

e: Cirkus contains all the ingredients of Rohit Shetty’s established comedy school — exaggerated characters, broad reactions and unapologetically loud humour. I normally have no problem enjoying that style, but this time the laughs are too sparse and even the better gags feel recycled from his own earlier films.
v: I’m usually okay with Rohit Shetty nonsense 😄 Problem here is not the nonsense... it simply isn’t funny enough. One-time watch at best.
body:
ONE TIME WATCH!!! a typical Rohit Shetty’s Comedy with Over The Top forceful comedy and overacting characters….Kids and few audience will like this comedy but for others this will sound unbearable!!!! But thats how Rohit Shetty’s school of comedy works

Personally I love different genres and respect the fact that each and every director has their own style, I generally make sure that I cache clear my mind for every movie and try to watch and enjoy it irrespective of the my own liking or disliking as I know before hand what I should expect from certain type Directors or Production Houses!!!

Following the same I enjoy Rohit Shetty’s over the top comedy (mind you not double meaning or vulgar, though there is no proper definition for it) and enjoyed All the Best, Golmaal Series and Bol Bachchan etc….but Cirkus unfortunately couldn’t work for me as there we minimal laughs and also the comedy scenes which worked out had given me a feel that I have watched this somewhere and that too in Rohit Shetty’s movie only, may be this is due to the fact that he repeats all his comic actors a lot and for similar kind of roles 😞

Ranvir was effortless in this movie and Jacqueline was uselesss 😉

e: Avatar: The Way of Water is extraordinary filmmaking craft, particularly once James Cameron takes us underwater, but my reaction was more mixed than expected. The long first-hour setup reduced the excitement and, having lived through the original Avatar phenomenon, I never recovered that same sense of discovery despite appreciating the technology behind it.
v: Technically mind-blowing, emotionally mixed for me. Water world looks beautiful, but the first Avatar spoiled us too much... that once-in-a-lifetime WOW never came back 😞
body:
TheWayOfWater : well have mixed feelings…..to be frank the AWE and WOW factor which I experienced watching Avatar 12 years back was missing.

Back then Avatar took us all by surprise with the scale of James Cameron Visualisation and what ever hard-work he put to invent the technology back then was clearly visible on the screen!!!

But may be due to the huge expectations or slow pace of the movie to come to the core point makes the whole first 1 hr as if we are watching the unseen scenes of the Avatar which have been edited out and now rereleased after 12 years……and by the time the story moves into the WATER our enthusiasm already drops a bit 😞 However the initial setup of the Water world is beautifully captured and conveyed!!!!

Though the under water scenes are excellent but still the Awe factor is missing as people had already set huge expectations on the movie….

until and unless that you are aware that master craftsmen Cameron had to invent a all new technology to capture motion sensor perfectly under water and thats when you start enjoying this masterpiece. Thats the major drawback of this movie as 99% of the audience are least bothered about what technology is newly created or how much efforts the team had yo put in to shoot underwater and rather simply consider if the movie is engaging enough and the CGI is captivating or not!!!

Bottomline : If you have not watched Avatar previously then Avatar#2 is a Must Watch and especially for the kids……but if you have already watched Avatar and have lived through that hysteria that it had created back then, then keep your expectations as low as possible and watch the movie

e: Love Today takes one of the most ordinary anxieties of modern relationships — handing your unlocked phone to someone else — and turns it into sharp, hugely entertaining cinema with a meaningful message. Pradeep Ranganathan’s writing, direction and lead performance make the concept feel both funny and uncomfortably familiar.
v: MAN!!! Such a simple smartphone-age idea turned into a full laugh riot with a lovely point 😄 If you guard your unlocked phone like national security... MUST WATCH 😂
body:
Finally got time to watch this movie on Big Screen…..MAN!!! Relevant Content to the current world with a Beautiful message conveyed in an entertaining way!!!!

It doesn’t matter where and how you watch this movie….but its a Must Watch for each one of us who are so addicted to our mobiles which have been an integral part of our life and feel uncomfortable in sharing our mobile with anyone even for a fraction of a minute!!!

Each and every actor and technician has done justice to the wonderful script. While writing the review I searched for the technical team and am surprised to see that main lead Pradeep Ranganathan has also Written& Directed this movie 🙏🙏🙏

e: Yashoda tackles a sensitive subject through disturbing imagery and an increasingly uneasy thriller setup. The interval and post-interval portions are deliberately uncomfortable, while Samantha leads a strong cast and Mani Sharma’s BGM keeps a constant sense that something is wrong beneath the surface.
v: This one made even the theatre AC feel suspicious 😅 Uncomfortable subject, hard-hitting scenes, Samantha solid and Mani Sharma BGM keeps you uneasy throughout. Sensitive hearts, beware 🙏
body:
not sure what to write? The Story and Visuals are not for the sensitive hearted 🙏 and makes you feel discomfort especially the interval and post interval block….

Even now me and wife are trying to figure out whether it is the AC in the multiplex on a winter night (or) the unpleasant visuals which sent us shivers down the spine, where as my daughter was watching the movie more excitingly and even posing us questions on Surrogacy!!!

if you are in game of watching hard hitting movies with couple of unpleasant visuals then its a must watch film as it touched a very sensitive topic!!!!

Acting & Action wise Samantha was at her usual best and Unni Mukundan, Varalaxmi Sarathkumar got some meaty roles and they gave their best!!! Rao Ramesh & Murali Sharma did their routine bit without much effort!!!

BGM by Mani Sharma adds depth to the scenes and carries that feel if something is fishy throughout the first half!!!

The duo of Hari & Harish who are the both Writers and Directors of this movie did a good job, though the CG work could have been far better!!!!

e: Kantara begins with a familiar landlord-versus-tribal conflict but becomes something far more immersive through folklore, raw staging, spectacular sound and Rishab Shetty’s complete creative commitment. The final twenty minutes are the kind of cinematic madness that make the theatre itself feel like part of the experience.
v: Just VAAAAAVVVV!!! 🔥 Simple story, but the folklore + raw visuals + BGM + Rishab turn it into full JAATHAARAAA. Last 20 mins... madness 🙏
body:
Just Vaaaaavvvvv!!!!!! Simple age old story of Landlord vs Tribals….but the approach of involving folk-fare, the terrific Visuals, terrific BGM, terrific Performances, terrific Action sequences are what which make this movie a MASTER PIECE!!!!! your eyes and ears cannot distract from what is being served on the Big Screen…..If there is any movie in the recent past which cannot be missed on Big Screen, then this is THE ONE

Rishab Shetty take a bow man!!!! before going to the movie I have obviously gone through all the reviews going gaga on how he is the Writer Director and Main Lead of the movie….but after watching the movie personally I felt he had no other option from donning the hat of all 3, as it would be impossible for any other person to understand and believe what he has on paper and how it would translate on to big screen 🙏 and what he has done in the last 20 mins on screen is simply he only can understand what he wants to do….TERRIFIC!!!

The way the movie was handled in complete Raw and Rustic way, the way each character arch has been addressed will simply blow your minds….

All said and done…this movie is not for normal cini goer or for those who seek entertainment and not even for those who has concern with the basic story telling approach of this movie!!!! But for those who seek a different Visual and Audio experience on Big Screen….you are in for a JAATHAAARAAA!!!!!

For years or probably decades Kanada Movie Industry was at rock bottom with even other language films out performing their movies in their own territory….Upendra was partially their saving grace and that too only for a limited audience!!! But in recent past and special mention to Hombale Films for bringing back the glory to Kanada film industry 🙏🙏🙏

e: The Ghost has several technically strong ingredients — Praveen Sattaru’s direction, an interesting screenplay structure, well-edited fights and an effective BGM. Unfortunately, the routine and underwritten core story never creates enough involvement, leaving all that craft functioning mainly as a saving grace.
v: Style undi, fights unnayi, BGM kuda super... story మాత్రం below average 😪 Good craft keeps trying, but The Ghost never really pulls you in.
body:
Average!!! Good Direction, Interesting Screenplay, Good BGM, Excellently Choreographed & Edited Fights …. all gone in vain due to below average story!!!!

The content never gets you hooked to what’s happening on the screen….all the remaining factors are just saving grace to cover up the below par content!!!!

The title of the movie though powerful is a mismatch to the story and disappoints the audience who went to watch the movie after expectations from the title!!!

Praveen Sattaru couldn’t impress with the routine action format story this time, though his direction was good!!!

BGM was damn good and elevated the action parts….

Though age is catching up, Nagarjuna tried his best to fit in the role….acting wise there is nothing much in the role nor acting is expected much from him!!!!

e: GodFather worked for me as a strong Chiranjeevi comeback vehicle despite abandoning many of his usual commercial ingredients. The political-thriller setup lets his screen presence and expressions dominate, while Satyadev makes brilliant use of his biggest mainstream platform and repeatedly stands toe-to-toe with the film’s stars.
v: Finally... MEGA BOSS IS BACK!!! 😍 Chiru’s eyes do enough mass work, Satyadev almost steals the show and Salman Bhai takes care of all physics violations 😂
body:
After an Average Sye Raa and Debacle Aacharya….Finally MEGA BOSS is BACK!!!

Though there was little buzz around the movie as its a Remake (with original movie already being available in Telugu) and Acharaya being a Disaster….I looked forward eagerly for this movie for the only fact that Chriu had a terrific record with Remakes not only financially but also upgrading the overall film to next level (barring Shankar Dada Zindabad)

Content wise I haven’t watched the original Lucifer and hence cannot compare any aspect with that…

I felt that its a full meals for Mega fans though there are no trademark Mega commercial elements like Comedy or Regular Chiru trademark Songs or his ever charming steps ….but still Chiru’s God Father enthrals us!!!! Those expressive eyes are Chiru’s major asset and man this political thriller gives ample scope for those killer expressions 🙏

Satyadev is an asset for Telugu Industry, this was his first big platform to showcase his talent to general mass audience and he utilised it to the core….the way he stood out with his performance against the likes of Murali Sharma, Nayantara, Salman and Chiru is commendable!!! In few scenes he simply took the limelight away from Chiru with his terrific performance 🙏🙏🙏

Murali Sharma, Nayantara and others were apt in their roles…..

I felt the Direction and Writers team did a good job though majority of their work was already done!!! I never felt that I was watching a remake movie 🤔

Though Thaman’s BGM was good and gave good elevation to Mega Eyes!!! I felt he could have done way better especially after what he did in Akhanda!!!

now a days every commercial action/fights are being trolled for their over the top sequences unless its KGF….and here the Chiru and Director did excellently used Salman bhai for those episodes so that all the trolling would be on him 😉 😉 😉

Salman does what he knows the best….Physics ki KCPD chesi vadiladu!!! I seriously demand a movie by Boyapati mama with Salman Khan….idharu kalisi Phyiscs ni Bang Bang Bang chesestharu 🥸

e: Lovers’ Love Stori takes a risky non-linear approach, beginning close to the pre-climax and then gradually revealing its characters’ backstories. Directors Vempati Srenivas and Venugopal Makala make that structure work surprisingly well, with Dhruvan Katakam providing the strongest emotional connection despite the film’s obvious production limitations.
v: Small indie movie, but the screenplay kept me hooked 👍 Cast has limits, budget shows... still the passion and content easily make it worth a watch.
body:
Where to Watch : Youtube, MX Player, Hungama Play, Airtel Xstream, VI

Link : https://youtu.be/kkZNQz44gGg

Good Content and Good Screenplay!!! its never easy to start the movie at Pre-Climax part and then later start revealing the back stories especially for non thriller movies as most of the audience will start loosing intrest in whats happening on the screen and try to pre process what the climax would be!!! However with this screenplay the Directors duo of Vempati Srenivas & Venugopal Makala had made sure that to glue the audience to the current proceedings on the screen.

Vempati Srenivas & Venugopal Makala have Produced, Directed and have written Dialogues for this movie which shows their passion….

Acting wise Dhruvan katakam did a fantastic job and his character is what we instantly gets connected to. All other actors did okay considering their own limitations, Any famous/good star cast from short movies industry would have elevated the content to next level.

BGM and Song Lyrics were inline with the story and with in their limitations no where deviated from what is required. All the departments did apt job.

e: Oke Oka Jeevitham has a beautiful emotional idea about regret, missed choices and the temptation to revisit the past, but the execution never feels as strong as the writing deserves. The first half is slow and the music adds little, while Vennela Kishore, Priyadarshi and the nostalgic details help the second half become the real soul of the film.
v: GOOD idea, weak execution 😞 First half drags, second half finally gives the emotion. Vennela Kishore’s regret track hit me the hardest... aa guilt trip vere level 😢
body:
GOOD Content BAD Execution!!!

Story wise people with Low Confidence, people who have guilt on their past career and personal choices will definitely connect to this movie…and for others it may be Okay Okay Types Story!!! Execution wise though you will not be sure where exactly it went wrong it could have been handled much better!!!! Songs and BGM are just okay and are actually a minus!!!

The Star attraction actually turned out to be huge minus due to her lack of acting abilities!!! The introduction shot of Amala Akkineni is a small tribute to her efforts towards Blue Cross and shows how much the director really wanted to cast her. Amala Akkineni though has been the main attraction her limitations in Acting was clearly visible, and I felt that it was a set back to hype the emotional depth to the Mother-Son scenes which where otherwise excellently written!!!!

Though Sharwanand is the hero and Darshi and Vennala Kishore played equally key roles….yet content wise Kishore’s characterisation is what we connect to the most and man he makes us most of us take the guilt trip back the memory about our study choices 😢 and also Darshi’s characterisation takes us back to the memories of all our school crushes 😍

Though first half tries to set the tone of the film not sure why it felt bit slow and lagging 🤷🏻‍♂️ all through the first half of the movie you will those small yet memorable Nostalgic moments at regular intervals throughout the first half…….Second half is the Soul and Saving grace of this movie!!!

e: Brahmāstra worked for me very differently from many of the reviews I read after the show. I enjoyed the mythology-inspired content, Ayan Mukerji’s ambition and the cast, while the VFX — widely praised elsewhere — was actually the element I found least convincing. It is a divisive film, but one I was happy to watch again.
v: Apparently I watched a different Brahmāstra from the internet 😂 I liked the content and franchise idea... graphicsే నాకు biggest complaint. Watch it and decide for yourself.
body:
Personally I loved the movie….it had Good Content + Great Visualisation (from Directors perspective) + Great Star Cast + Excellent Acting

Poor Graphics is the only minus in this movie which other wise would had been a GREAT WATCH!!!

The only thing I couldn’t understand was the concept of Hero getting Fire ignited when Heroine is around!!! Vaadu em fire gurunchi matladuthunado 😉

I watched the 9:30 show and when I read reviews post movie I was shocked to see all the reviews being complete opposite to what I have experienced while watching movie. They say the Graphics were Great but the content was let down 🤷🏻‍♂️ For a minute I thought was I different from the lot and had to take time to introspect my movie watching experience but still I felt the same, It had very good content for the type if story they selected and have the potential of a Franchise based film similar to Krish. I had to crosscheck with my friend who watched it along with me and he also had similar opinion to mine.

Finally I conclude that this movie caters to different audience in different ways and you must watch it to have your own experience. I would be definitely watching it for the second time for my daughter. Kids will love it.

PS : No-onefrom cini industry cares that I exist hence there is no point in them bribing me to give positive review. So consider this as my genuine experience and it may differ from yours based on our tastes 😉

e: Liger is frustrating because Puri Jagannadh’s films have often survived weak plots through explosive characterisation and sharp dialogue. Here, the Pan-India ambition strips away exactly those strengths, leaving an old-school masala structure without the attitude that once made his formula entertaining.
v: DISASTER!!!! 😭 Puri went Pan-India and somehow forgot the Puri-ness itself. No kickass character, no dialogue fire... Ramya Krishna alone trying to save the damage.
body:
Disaster!!!! Poori & Devarakonda kalisi Karan Johar gadi ni De…De..De…Debesesaru!!

Everyone knows that Puri is very weak with his stories and its only his kickass characterisations and their kickass dialogues which give that much needed kick to audience!!! and much to my dismay thats exactly what missing in this movie….You expect some ultimate high octane dialogues from Puri’s hero, but when the hero stammers there is no scope for him to deliver basic stuff forget about Puri’s trade mark dialogues 😞

In the quest to go Pan India….Puri just ditched his strength which has been his only saving grace all these years!!!

Ananya Pandey was at her annoying best…Ramya Krishna was the only saving grace

Being a huge fan of Puri Jaganadh’s hard hitting dialogues….I was very keen to see how Liger fares especially in the times where any movie with content is being a Blockbuster and Normal Masala movies being outrightly rejected!!! and till #ismartShankar Puri was struck in the same old formula and this movie being made on grand pan indian scale was curious how things would turn out….and it Puri made it worse by sticking to his old rotten masala format minus his trademark style dialogues

e: Karthikeya 2 expands the original beautifully into a larger treasure-hunt adventure without losing the intellectual curiosity that made the first film interesting. Chandoo Mondeti keeps faith and scepticism in conversation with each other, then surrounds that idea with strong locations, cinematography, BGM and purposeful characters.
v: EXCELLENT. BRILLIANT. PERFECT sequel 🔥 Treasure hunt + mythology + logic without forcing one side down your throat. I was ready for Part 3 before credits ended 😄
body:
EXCELLENT, BRILLIANT and a PERFECT SEQUEL!!!! Chandoo Mondeti is a worthy director and though the films after his debut with Karthikeya didn’t work out he bounced back with Karthikeya2!!!

If You watch a movie as a movie and doesn’t take sides between a Theist and Atheist, then this movie is enthrals you with superior Content based theme of Treasure Hunt with good dose of Thrill and Theist vs Atheist concept!!!

In few scenes the Theist concept takes upper hand and in few scenes Atheist concept gains upper hand but all this is done to take the story forward in a gripping way and this itself shows the intelligence of the Writer cum Director 🙏

Below are few specimen dialogues which justify both sides….

1. Devudini Poojinchatam kanna artham chesukotam avasaram!!!

2. Nenu Devudi dveshini kadhu….Satyanveshini!!!

3. Yella aythe Gudi gaa Devudini namadam thappo…allane gudi ga science ni namadam guda thape!!!

4. Dhenini Gudi ga Namakudadu….allani dhenini guda guddi ga namakunda kuda vundakudadhu!!!

and when such a gripping content gets support of the terrific cinematography , Terrific BGM and excellent locations then its a visual and audible treat to audience!!!!

Each and Every character had importance and relevance to the story and everyone of had done a great job in portraying those emotions….

I am a huge fan of Karthikeya 1 and the part 2 didn’t disappoint me even for a second….Now eagerly waiting for the 3 part of this franchise

e: Bimbisara starts with a fresh reversal of the usual time-travel setup — sending a man from the past into the present — but rushes through too much of its promising first half. The second half works better and Kalyan Ram carries almost the entire film, making it an above-average watch rather than the knockout the concept could have delivered.
v: Excellent idea, only above-average movie for me. First half rushed, second half saves it and Kalyan Ram carries almost everything 🙏 Blockbuster talk was bigger than my experience.
body:
I felt its OVERRATED!!! I generally have the tendency to ignore the talk around a film and completely get myself involved into all aspects of the movie and surprisingly my experience when compared to the general talk from what I read and heard….I felt its OVERRATED!!!

on paper the concept is excellent and less explored as generally most of the time travelling movies (at least which I am aware of) has the concept of a person from future travelling into the past, but someone from past coming into future is something new ( Aditya 369 has it covered partially)

With such a good concept in hand the director messed it up and was in hurry in the first half and second half saved the movie. But considering its his very first movie need to appreciate him for his efforts!!!

There was no scope for any other actors in the movie except for Kalyan Ram and though he put all the efforts to carry the movie on his shoulders but he couldn’t make complete justification…Nevertheless Great effort from him!!!

Most of the Keeravani’s BGM resembled Bahubali & RRR…

I believe the Low/Medium Budget + Proper Release Timing (as Tollywood was producing poor content till then) + proper Publicity helped the movie to become a BLOCKBUSTER which otherwise could have been an above Average movie

e: Sita Ramam overcame probably the biggest obstacle possible for a romance: me 😄 I went in reluctantly, expecting another love story, and was completely absorbed from the opening titles. Hanu Raghavapudi’s world, Dulquer and Mrunal’s chemistry, the writing, music and visual craft combine into one of those rare romantic films I was genuinely glad not to miss on the big screen.
v: I hate love stories... and still came out calling this a CLASSIC ❤️ Sita Ramam got almost everything right. Wife was right to drag me into the theatre 😄
body:
Finally Watched #SitaRamam : before I start, I hate Love stories and Gautham Menon’s Romantic movies are big let down for me and I slept during those classics as I go to Theatre just for my wife 🙂

Having Said that which was the last Romantic movie I loved the most…..it was Malli Malli Idhi Rani Roju, which I still regret of not watching in Big screen…..and I am glad that I didn’t miss watching this CLASSIC!!!!

Though I was already aware of the rave reviews for this movie….I was reluctant to watch it as I was considering it as yet another love story and my wife forced me to just because of her LOVE towards Dulquer Salmaan….and I am

glad that I bowed to her insistence

Once the Titles started I was completely involved into the beautiful world of Sita & Ram…This film is an example of perfect match of Great Content, Great Casting, Great Acting, Great Dialogues, Great BGM, Great Locations, Great Direction and Great Production!!!!

Below are glimpse of some meaningful and impactful dialogues from the movie :

1. ayinaa ipudu neeku kavalsindhi mana vaalu kadhu sayam chese vaalu 🙏🙏

2. Ayudham tho yudham chesevadu sanikudu anni..dharmam tho chesevadu ramudu anni

3. Nuvu Vinadhi Nijam kaadu….Naminadhe Nijam

The way the director dealt with so called sensitive topics and the way Sumanth’s characterisation is written is simply EXCELLENT!!!

Swapna Dutt is bringing back the glory of her Father’s production house in great style!!!

I totally loved the movie…..though my kid didn’t enjoy it much and considered it slow and boring because there is no action 😉

e: Vikram is elevated far above its basic drug-mafia story by powerhouse performances and Anirudh’s terrific score. The first half felt confusing and initially made the hype seem excessive, but the way Lokesh Kanagaraj connects the pieces in the second half — and expands the Kaithi universe — is where the film becomes genuinely exciting.
v: Standalone ga above-average drug-mafia movie. But as the start of Lokesh universe madness? Much more fun 😄 Kamal + Fahadh + VJS + Anirudh BGM do the heavy lifting.
body:
An above average Drug Mafia based movie…elevated by top notch performances by Kamal Hasan, Fahadh Faasil, Vijay Sethupathi and others…and a terrific BGM by Anirudh 🙏🙏🙏 The BGM haunts you even several hours after the movie….If considered as a standalone movie, then its a one time watch, but Lokesh’s vision to expand this universe gives us the small kicks to link with Khaidi and other future parts….hopefully the director fully explores all the chars which are rushed and not properly justified…..

First half is bit confusing and I felt that the movie was over hyped….but the way things unfolded in second half is the brilliance of the director!!!

A Must Watch for fans of Khaidi….

e: Ante Sundaraniki succeeds at a difficult balance: it tackles sensitive social and family issues without turning into a lecture, while still giving Nani, Nazriya and the ensemble enough comedy to remain a mainstream entertainer. The runtime and music could be tighter, but the writing and performances make it a must watch.
v: Vivek Athreya + Nani handle a sensitive topic without turning it into a lecture 🙏 Funny, thoughtful, a little long... music could be better, but still a MUST WATCH for me.
body:
Another Excellent movie from Director Vivek Athreya….I believe for sensitive subjects that there is a thin line difference on how you handle the subject either stick to the topic and make it preachy and boring and add commercial elements and dilute the topic….Vivek and Nani knows how to play around by sticking to the core subject all along and also including proper entertainment for commercial purpose and never crossing the line…..All the artists Nazriya, Naresh, Rohini, Nadiya, Harshavardhan and all others did perfect justice to their roles, especially during the pre climax and climax 🙏…..Music & BGM should and must have been more effective!!!!

Considering how talented the director is and how terrific the actors are there is always a feel that the outcome could have been a bit more effective….The duration is debatable!!!

Overall this movie may not be as critically acclaimed as Mental Madhilo or Brochevarevura….but its still a MUST WATCH!!!

e: F3 makes no attempt to disguise what it is: an illogical comedy built around back-to-back episodes rather than a story anyone should analyse seriously. That approach works largely because Venkatesh dominates the film with his comic timing, while Varun Tej, Sunil and Vennela Kishore keep the energy high.
v: More FUN, less FRUSTRATION than F2 😄 Logic ni bayata parking lo pettesi vellandi. Venky Mama + Varun + Sunil + Vennela Kishore take care of the rest 😂
body:
for me when compared to #F2 this was more FUN and less FRUSTRATION not because of the plot but because of the artists or may be even because this time I was well prepared on what to expect!!!!

again….its VENKY Mama’s show all along and director Anil Ravapudi had made sure to utilise his terrific comedy timing to the fullest…..Varun Tej also did a very good job and would have been his best applauded performance if not sidelined by Venky’s comedy timing….

After many attempts….finally Suneel got a proper and full length comedy role to remind his glorious past but has been bit sidelined in the second half by Vennala Kishore….

Just like the Golmal and Housefull franchises in Hindi….here also audience would be least interested in the STORY and get entertained by what’s happening on the screen irrespective if it is logical or not and even the scene has any link to the storyline!!! Fortunately Anil had made sure to fill the whole movie with many such episodes which though illogical and doesn’t fit in the storyline still entertain the audience to the core….

We doesn’t even notice Devi Sri’s Songs and BGM….as well as other Technicalities in the movie…

e: Sarkaru Vaari Paata starts from a relevant financial theme but loses focus by trying to simultaneously deliver comedy, sentiment, action, hero elevations and message-heavy dialogue. Mahesh Babu carries the film with ease, yet the writing gives him far less than his performance deserves.
v: Strictly average. Good core idea buried under full commercial khichdi 😪 Mahesh is the only real saving grace and once again makes me wonder why nobody gives this actor a proper challenge.
body:
strictly average, Mahesh’s One man show and he is the only saving grace of this movie 🙏

In the era post the RRR’s and KGF’s either you need to strictly stick to the content without deviating OR stick to the genre OR create magic like KGF where you completely arrest the audience denying them to use their logical sense…..and in this era the normal “COMMERCIAL” movie which has a mix and match of everything is a gone case……

Parasuram has selected an interesting and relevant point…..but has completely messed it up by taking the commercial approach and trying to add Comedy, Sentiment, Action, Heroism and Dialogues!!!!

Don’t know about hardcore fans….but for me the Dialogues were completely irrelevant and meaningless and senseless…..I think in this new era where emotion is conveyed through Action and BGM, having lengthy and senseless dialogues is a crime….and dialogue writers should note that not every one is Balaya 😦

Mahesh literally showed the glimpses of what acting talent he had and its upto the directors to not waste it in silly Commercial Message oriented movies!!!!

e: Acharya is one of those rare Chiranjeevi films that left almost no impression on me at all. Every major selling point had recently been delivered with more impact by another film, while the Chiranjeevi–Ram Charan combination feels driven more by commercial appeal than dramatic necessity.
v: DISASTER!!!! 🙏 Chiru + Charan together and still ZERO impact... that itself is some achievement. Almost every big moment reminded me of another movie that did it much better.
body:
DISASTER!!!! when was the last time Chiru’s movie has left ZERO Impact (irrespective of Hit or Flop) for me it was Shankar Dada Zindabad and now Acharya took that spot!!!!

There was No Impact of the Story, as Akhanda has similar and more powerful story line!!!

There was no impact of the Violent Climax, as again Akhanda had more violence!!!

There was no impact of the elevation shots, as we all are in KGF elevation hangover!!!

There was no awe factor of the multi-starer , as RRR had a more awe feeling due to Ram and NTR combination!!!

There was no impact of the Father-Son combination, as Manam had a womderful Father-Son combination impact!!!

So to say there is nothing new to offer in this movie…nor what offered is impactful 🙏

Its end of Manisharma….Lahe Lahe had more impact due to its lyrics and other 3 songs reminded me of the late 90’s or early 20’s era 🙏….The movie would have had more impact without BGM 🤦‍♂️

And RamCharan’s Sidha’s role was added considering the commercial viability rather than any other importance….

Hope the BOSS will be back soon….

e: V has the polish expected from Mohana Krishna Indraganti, but never quite finds the extra spark needed to rise above an average-to-good thriller. Nani’s stylish performance and Thaman’s high-octane BGM are the clear highlights, with P. G. Vinda’s cinematography adding plenty of visual flair.
v: Nani stylish ga full show nadipisthadu... Thaman BGM ఇంకో hero 😄 Slick ga undi, fights bagunnayi, but movie ayyaka “inka edo miss ayyindi” feeling మాత్రం పోదు.
body:
Nani’s one man show….and Thaman’s Terrific BGM!!!! Just like Mohana Krishna Indraganti’s other movies…this movie also settles as a Average, Good movie and gives the audience a feeling of something is missing!!! Except Nani’s terrific and stylish performance and Thamans high octane BGM there is nothing else to either brag about or complain in this movie.

Spl mention of cinematography by P.G Vinda and few stylish action sequences. Sudheer Babu, Nivetha Thomas & Aditi Rao Hydari did their bit in the limited acope they had.

e: Uma Maheswara Ugra Roopasya proves how powerful a seemingly simple story can become when every department understands its tone. Venkatesh Maha’s direction, the Araku setting, cinematography, dialogues and Satyadev’s wonderfully subtle performance outweigh the film’s slow pace and less memorable songs.
v: Man... simple story ni ila kuda cheppacha 🙏 Satyadev + Venkatesh Maha + Araku world totally worked for me. Slow ga untundi, but beautiful ga lands. MUST WATCH.
body:
when an extraordinary director Maha, sensible producer Praveena (both c/o Kancherlapalem fame) associated with very talented Satya for a malayalam remake, i was confused why they were wasting their talent and man I got my answer _/\_

to start with, I havent watched the original version but can confirm that only malayalam makers can only come up with such simple yet impactful subjects _/\_ Direction, Camera, Locations, Dialogues, Song Lyrics, Acting & BGM have been a top notch!!! Songs and Pace of the movie are the only negatives I can think about

Satya has completely nailed it with his subtle yet impactful performance and has been well suported by each and every artist in the movie.

I was completely blown away with the whole chain of incidents which lead to the major plot of the movie. How in the worlc can one come up with such a simple events which lead to the butterfly effect.

A MUST WATCH…..

e: Lootcase does not need a complicated story or technical fireworks to work. Its biggest strength is the cast — Kunal Kemmu, Rasika Dugal, Vijay Raaz, Ranvir Shorey and Gajraj Rao — who turn a straightforward suitcase comedy into an easy, dependable weekend watch.
v: Story gurinchi thesis rayalsina avasaram ledu 😄 Kunal + Vijay Raaz + Gajraj Rao gang simply make it a fun weekend timepass. Expect laughs, nothing more.
body:
a good time pass for your weekend. Nothing Much about story or other technical aspects. But the whole bunch of talented actors : Kunal Khemu, Rasika Dugal, Vijay Raaz, Ranvir Shorey & Gajraj Rao ensured they provide good entertainment. Special mention of Vijay Raaz and Gajraj Rao who entertain us in their Villan Avatar _/\_

if you wqnt to kill time by watching a decent comedy movie, then go for it will not dissapoint you. Apart from that dont expect anything much from this.

e: Raat Akeli Hai handles murder, abuse and family secrets with far more restraint than its dark premise might suggest. Honey Trehan avoids unnecessary nudity or shock tactics, while the lighting, camera work, Nawazuddin Siddiqui and Radhika Apte create a beautifully moody mystery whose only real drawback is its pace.
v: Dark murder mystery, but without cheap shock tricks 👍 Nawaz + Radhika super, lighting gave me old RGV vibes... konchem slow, but the final twist makes up for it.
body:
on Netflix, a well made movie with murder mystry with underlying sexual abuse content….the general opinion we have about any Netflix Movie which deals with sexual abuse and has dark title “Raat Akeli Hai” is it follows the no holds barred approach and fill the plitline with Cuss words and Nudity and over the top Violence but what we get to see is a complete opposite movie where the director was on a mission to prove that though the concept is bold it can be handeled without any cuss words, nudity and sex.

Lighting & camera angles throughout the movie, reminded me of vintage RGV!!!! qnd was completely bowled over it.

And with the actors like Nawaz and Radhika we can only expect steller performances and they dont dissapoint us!!!

The only negative I can find is the movie is bit slow but that can be obviously overlooked from the perfect performances and final twist!!!

Must watch for those who like Bold Content with a clean approach!!!!

e: Shakuntala Devi is less interested in explaining how its subject became a mathematical phenomenon than in exploring what happened when an extraordinary personality collided with the expectations of parents, husband and daughter. That choice may disappoint viewers seeking a conventional biopic, but Vidya Balan and Sanya Malhotra make the personal story strongly engaging.
v: Human Computer story kosam vellithe konchem disappoint avvachu. But genius Shakuntala Devi vs normal family life angle worked well for me... Vidya + Sanya are terrific 🙏
body:
if you are watching this movie with an expectation of understanding the hardwork, Challanges faced and efforts put in by Shakuntala Devi to become the Humman Computer as we know her, then you are in for a great dissapointment!!!

But if you are in to understand the ups and downs that happen in the life of a Genius and her relationship with her normal parents, normal husband and normql daughter then you are in for a treat!!! and the director make sures to prepare you in the first scene itself _/\_

The movie very well protrays how many Geneius/sucessful persons though praised by millions of outsiders fail to get the same respect and love from their own. And in this aspect is more or less similar to “My Father Gandhi!!!”

Acting wise Vidya Balan has nailed it as usual with her effortless protrayel showcasing various emotions and has been very well supported by Sanya Malhotra with her terrific performance.

Amit Sadh and Jisshu Sengupta though had limited role but made their presence felt

PS : When all the Kangana’s and Tapsee’s are fighting over to take credit on who is the flag bearer for female centric movies….Vidya Balan has been the unsung hero’ine in this!!!

e: Gulabo Sitabo asks the viewer to adjust to its deliberate pace and strongly local Lucknowi flavour before its pleasures begin to reveal themselves. Once that rhythm clicks, Amitabh Bachchan and Ayushmann Khurrana become two wonderfully petty pillars holding up a sharp landlord-versus-tenant comedy.
v: Patience compulsory 😄 Lucknow slang + sloooow pace first test chestayi... adjust ayyaka Amitabh vs Ayushmann landlord-tenant Tom & Jerry full fun.
body:
You need patience and passion to watch this movie!!!! to start with the Lucknowi slang makes it very hard for large of audience to connect with whats happening on screen and the slooow naration tests the patience!!!!

if you can overcome that major hurdle then you are in for an excellent ride given by the combo of AB vs AK!!! Story wise its Landlord Vs Tenant which is a desi adoption of Tom vs Jerry…..with few genuine roasts _/\_

on screen the chars of Ayushman and Amitabh tried to overshadow each other but in actual AB and AK were supporting this plot as major pillars _/\_ and the best performances were a simple cake walk for them!!! Never seen AB in such a kammenaa avtar 😛

e: Kaamyaab turns the invisible life of Hindi cinema’s character actors into a warm, bittersweet and remarkably restrained film. Sanjay Mishra carries the entire journey with ease, while Hardik Mehta resists melodrama and lets the final irony — that even the finest sidekick remains overshadowed by the hero — land naturally.
v: Simple story, zero drama-baazi, beautiful emotion 🙏 Sanjay Mishra makes you feel for all those familiar faces we’ve watched for years but never remembered by name. MUST WATCH.
body:
@Netflix, if you are in game for non-commericial movie with simple story line and excellent performances this is a must watch!!!!

with around 1.5 hrs of duration this movie shows the true feelings of side kicks of our Bollywood who even after being in tons of movies go unnoticed and the age of social media memes gives them a hope when ppl recognize them due to their memes!!!

as usual Sanjay Mishra has done a terrific performance and carried the whole movie on his shoulders!!!! Director has not tried anything to put melodramatic and the story looks realistic in every sense including a very well written climax with bottom line, No matter how well a side kick performs or no matter how well the audience enjoys the side kicks acting he will be always over shadowed by the “HERO” _/\_

e: Shubh Mangal Zyada Saavdhan deliberately treats its same-sex romance like the most ordinary Bollywood family conflict possible. That simplicity is both its strength and limitation: the film never becomes a hard-hitting message drama or an all-out comedy, but Ayushmann, Jitendra and the ensemble make a still-taboo subject accessible without melodrama.
v: Basically a regular family love story... only the couple happens to be two men 😄 Neither hard-hitting nor laugh-riot, but it makes the relationship feel refreshingly normal.
body:
MAN!!! is there any movie genere that Ayushman cant do with ease!!!!!

story and execution wise its a simple routine love story where the lead pair falls in love and their parents doesnt approve their love….in the second half one of the lead pair enters the house to impress their partners family and finally the family approvs their love in typical “Jaaa Simran jaaa….jii le apni zindagi” style!!! but the only difference being the homo-sexuality of the lead pair!!!!

The writer and director Hitesh Kewalya thought of keeping the whole Homo-sexuality angle very simple without any melodrama or over the top message dialogues!!! nor he has ensured to make the film an out and out family entertainer with comedy (like Dream Girl)….so the film neither becomes a message oriented one nor a comedy entertainer but falls some where in between!!!!

All the artists were at their best with good charaterizations which made the whole homo-sexuality part (which is still considered as a Taboo) look very simple and watchable even for “FAMILY” audience!!!!

dont expect much from the movie and you will like it…..All the Ayushman fans (including me) who thump their chests with the choice of his script selection have one more movie to brag about!!!!

e: Bheeshma uses organic farming as its plot foundation but Venky Kudumula keeps the message secondary to entertainment. The first half is okay, the post-interval comedy lifts the film considerably, and Nithiin, Vennela Kishore, Raghu Babu and the stylish presentation make it an easy commercial watch if you leave logic at the door.
v: Nithiin back on HIT track 😄 Organic farming message pakkana petti Venky Kudumula full comedy mode lo velthadu. Second half nunchi proper commercial timepass.
body:
Nitin is back again on HIT track!!!

plot wise the concept of ORGANIC FARMING was kicked aside by director Venky’s narration style…..womder how different directors have different style, if the same plot had Koratala Siva directing it he would have made it a commericially serious message oriented movie with top notch and stylish action scenes…..but Venky choose a different style of mixing entertainment to the message oriented subject. Though the message is almost dominated by the Comedy, but it never dissapoints the general entertainment loving audience!!!!

The first part was okay and with the Interval twist…..I thought the second half would be on serious note and all the hype about the comedy in the movie is just a bluff. But with immediate post interval scene the director showed his true intentions of never leaving the comedy angle and that where the fun starts!!!!!

All the comedy One liners punches and irritating meme lines by Nitin have been well written!!!! Raghu Babu and Vennala Kishore combination rocks to the core!!!!

the movie is shot quite stylishisly and the BGM is apt with couple of hit songs!!!! Fights are good…surprisingly songs didnt give much chance for Nitins dance moments and the only mass song had Rashmika getting all the attention!!!

overall its pakka commericial entertainer with lots of comedy in 2nd half with hero doing all the bafoonery acts and still being an Hero!!! Dont expect any message or Logic from the movie and you will love it…..

e: Panga takes a story that could easily have been pushed into loud melodrama and tells it with wonderful simplicity and realism instead. Ashwiny Iyer Tiwari gets the emotions right, Kangana Ranaut is superb, and the entire supporting cast helps turn it into an effortless must-watch.
v: EXCELLENT!!!!! 🙏 Simple, realistic and no unnecessary melodrama. Kangana super, supporting cast perfect... theatre aina OTT aina, just watch it.
body:
Excellent!!!!! How can one make a movie with such a story in a simple & realistic way without any melodrama!!!!! For me there was no one scene which looked un-realistic and director Ashwiny Iyer Tiwari did a fantastic job to get the emotions right!!!!

we all know Kangana is a fantastic and natural actor and man she is a super star _/_ she portrayed all the emotions of a House Wife with a dream in perfect way!!!! apart from her all the other actors : Jassi Gill, Richa Chadda & Neena Gupta did perfect job….spl mention of the kid who played the Son!!!!

Music and BGM perfectly blend with the mood of the film….Dialogues are simple yet makes complete sense!!!

irrespective of you watch it in Theaters or OTT…..its a must watch!, the sooner the better!!!

e: Disco Raja throws sci-fi, retro styling and regular mass cinema into the same mixer, but Vi Anand never fully balances the concept with Ravi Teja’s trademark energy. There are interesting ingredients — especially Sunil’s return and Thaman’s terrific music and BGM — yet the film ultimately lands only a little above average.
v: Sci-fi idea bagundi, retro setup interesting... but Ravi Teja energy motham concept ni swallow chesindi 😄 Thaman + Sunil save enough to make it just above average.
body:
personally I fell like its Vi.Anand’s version of Ismart Shankar…..where Sci-fi and regular mass have been thrown together into a mixer!!!!!

the major problem with having Ravi Teja is as a director you need to ensure to make use of his energy levels and comedy timing, else certain ppl will feel the movie is slow and dull AND if you utilize it, he will takeover the whole movie with his High energy levels and the whole concept and story takes back seat…..and that is where Vi Anand failed in balancing & blending Ravi Tejas energy with the concept and story!!!!

though the sci-fi concept, Retro setup & Re-introduction of Sunil create an interest…….Ravi Teja with his high energy as Disco Raja completely over shadows everything and that’s where you start feeling the movie as routine!!!!

other than Ravi Teja…its Thaman’s terrific BGM & music along with Sunil which will get our attention _/\_

overall its neither Good nor Bad movie but above average!!!

e: Ala Vaikunthapurramuloo reveals its basic story almost immediately, yet Trivikram keeps the film engaging through comedy, family emotions and strong character work. Allu Arjun gets a full showcase, Murali Sharma is a terrific second pillar, and Thaman’s chartbusters and BGM give this simple commercial film plenty of life.
v: Story first 10 mins lone ardham aipothundi... still I liked it to the core 😄 Bunny + Murali Sharma + Trivikram comedy/emotions + Thaman make this simple family story work big time.
body:
very rarely you see a film where you cant point out any outstanding points but still you like the film to the core (just like Seethama Vakitlo Sirimalle Chettu) and Ala Vaikunthapurramuloo falls in that category!!!!

you can know what the story of the film is just within first 10 mins but still Trivikram’s command over comedy and family emotions, Murali Sharma’s excellent characterization and brilliant acting and Allu Arjun’s all rou d performance ensures you are engaged for the whole length!!!!

Because of the wraper thin Family story, Trivikram didnt got a chance to show his intellectual brilliance in dialogues just like Aravinda Sametha or Julai or Khaleja but still he had his pen going on with few of his mark dialogues scattered over the films length!!!!

Allu Arjun is back with a bang as he got a brilliant oppurtunity to portray Comedy, Emotion, Mass Fights and Class Fights in a single movie…..and he once again proved that he is the best in the lot of Tollywood dancers with his trademark graceful steps which look simple yet difficult to perform _/_……..Spl mention of the dance episode in the office board room which has similar impact to one that of Gabbar Singh’s Anthakshari scene and he cleverly ensured to satisfy the EGO of PK fans!!!!

Trivikram and Fight Masters have ensured that all fights are authentically shot!!!!

Unlike Agyathavasi & Aravindha this time Trivikram took extra care to not spoil the impact of. chartbuster songs with picturization……The leading scenes picturization and locations/sets for all the songs sync in perfectly!!!!

On screen if Allu Arjun is one pillar than Murali Sharma is another pillar for this movie and his
characterization and acting create a huge impact to hate him through out the film!!! apart from Murali Sharma and Sachin all other STAR actors are used more or less like junior actors 😦

Thaman gave life to this movie with his chartbuster songs and ultra kool BGM!!!

overall its a simple and cool film and a must watch for Allu Arjun and Murali Sharma…..it will create an Impact in A centers but may be impacted by Sarlieeru in B & C centers!!!

e: Sarileru Neekevvaru finally lets Mahesh Babu step away from his recent message-heavy films and enjoy a full mass avatar. His comedy timing, punch dialogues and screen presence are refreshing, but an overdone train episode, thin content and a weak, illogical climax make the overall experience much more mixed for a neutral audience.
v: Babu neee Maaassu... Mind Blocku 😄 Mahesh mass comeback fans ki feast. Naaku మాత్రం train comedy + weak climax వల్ల average timepass gaane undipoyindi.
body:
Babu neee Maaassu Bomma Mind Blocku!!!!! Sarileru to MB fans is ….what GabbarSingh was to PK fans _/_ they will enjoy the mass avatar of MB to the core and to neutral audience its a time pass average movie!!!!

to start with I was vexed up with Mahesh’s choice of never ending streak of message oriented and Family based movies for past few years with his similar acting and sloooww dialogue modulation and this movie has breathed fresh air to my expectations of exploring the actors mass acting potential and he completely owned it with his typical comedy timing and entertaing and punchful dialogues and his dance and grace in Mind Block song would be a treat to his Fans!!!!

content wise there is nothing much similar to many mass movies but as MB has tried this genere after a looooong gap it feels refreshing _/_

Director Anil has tried hard to meet the expectations on his comedy track due to past track and that has resulted in him overdoing it and the whole train comedy is filled with over acting of Sangeetha, Rashmika & others…..specific genre of audience may get irritated with the whole train episode but those who love the masssss comedy will like it to the core ( have seen my daughter laughing out loud for the whole train episode where I was feeling irritated with the never ending silly comedy ) and the climax though tried to be different is very weak and illogical even for a mass movie!!!! but the confrontation scenes between Prakash Raj, Vijayashanti and MB in 2nd half have been handeled superbly with both powerful punches as well as comedy!!!!

though music from DSP was very oridinary the songs have been shot well however the BGM is superb and elevates the heroism to next level!!!

overall it would be a runaway hit in B & C centers as they find the movie as complete package where as in A centers the silly comedy in first half and illogical climax may impact it along with how good
Ala Vaikunthapurramloo is!!!!

e: Chhapaak worked for me because Meghna Gulzar treats an extremely painful subject with restraint. The film explores not just an acid-attack survivor’s struggle but also family support, women’s empowerment and the exhausting reality of sustaining a social cause, with Deepika Padukone and Vikrant Massey carrying the emotions without unnecessary drama.
v: Entertainment kosam vellakandi... but definitely WATCH IT 🙏 Meghna keeps the pain and message simple without forcing tears, and Deepika + Vikrant do the rest.
body:
not for the nrml cine goers….but a must watch!!! Director Meghana Gulzar has brilliantly showed the struggles of Acid Attack Survivor’s and her family not only that she has also included the elements like Women Empowerment, the constant struggle for running and affording a cause.

The things I loved most are :

  1. The relation between the lawyer and her husband….though there are no dialogues and drama around it, but director was successful in showcasing how a husband supports her wife to chase her dreams buy getting involved in basic things _/_
  2. The cute relation between Amol and Malti….I would have loved to see them as friends instead of making them fell in love with each other, but as they said its real life story I couldnt argue much
  3. Excellent Lyrics and simple music to make us feel the pain of the Acid Victims _/_
  4. Simple but effective dialogues without much drama but still convey the pain and message

Though acting wise there wasnt any challange for Deepika (as she has proved herself in many earlier films) but definitly need to appreciate her in taking up this film so that it could reach to maximum audience!!!!

and Vikrant as Amol did a good job in showcasing his emotions as a guy who runs for cause but couldnt afford it _/_

e: Darbar gives Rajinikanth plenty of chances to remind us why his style remains unmatched, and Anirudh’s BGM amplifies those moments wonderfully. But the writing feels badly dated, the logic is often baffling and Murugadoss never builds enough around that star power, leaving only scattered fan moments in an otherwise disappointing film.
v: Rajini style + Anirudh BGM... akkada varaku super 🔥 Migatha story/logic chusthe Murugadoss really wrote this aa? ane doubt vachindi 😦
body:
though many actors have yried to replicate his style and grace….though he himself has done in zillions of times it always a treat to watch Thalivaaa’s Style!!! and in Darbaar he once again proved that he is the One and only One Style Icon…..and when Rajini’s style meets Anirudh’s BGM then only sky is the limit!!!!!
