Unfortunately Darbar’s postive ends there!!!! was it really Written and Directed by Murgadoos….Man how could he make a movie with such an outdated things 😦 surely he has lost form after Spyder ( though I liked it for the different concept)…..but still how can he direct a scene where the backdrop shows that Father has been killed some 27 Years back and in current date a 4, 5 years old kid is kiising his photo and saying miss you dad _/_

except above there is nothing much to say about remaining crafts…..Though BGM has been great the songs have been equally bad!!!

Fans of Rajini’s style may like some parts of the movie…and fans of Murgadoos, better to stay away from this!!!!

surely Rajini must retire as none of the current lot are utilizing his screen presence fully to create an impact like Narasimha 😦

e: Prathi Roju Pandage feels extremely familiar in both story and treatment, with Maruthi’s humour and Raashi Khanna’s TikTok-obsessed character providing most of the variation. The real reason to watch is Rao Ramesh, who carries the routine family drama so completely that Sai Dharam Tej can sometimes feel like he is appearing in an extended cameo.
v: Shatamanam Bhavati déjà vu strong ga undi 😄 But Rao Ramesh alone becomes hero + villain + comedian and somehow keeps this routine family drama alive.
body:
Story wise it appeared to be sequel to #SathamanamBhavati….and also 80% of the taking resembels the same. However the director Maruthi tried to add his trade mark humour along with making Heorines char to potray that of a Tick Tok addict, Apart from that this movie has nothing different to many of the recently released so called Family Value Movies!!!

Rao Ramesh is the solo pillar of this otherwise routine family drama and carried it on hus shoulders….after couple of scenes we will start believing that he and only he is the Hero Villan and Comedian of the movie!!! Rashi Khana did a good performance as Tick Tok queen and all the remaining family members did good role to complement Rao Ramesh’s terrific performance!!!! Sai Dharam Tej literally had an extended cameo kind of role and he did a decent job…..

nothing much to say about other departments as they neither did a worst job nor did a great job!!!!

e: Amma Rajyam Lo Kadapa Biddalu felt less like a movie and more like a long political spoof designed to ridicule a few people while glorifying another. The uncanny casting, makeup and imitations are genuinely impressive, but beyond that I found almost no story, emotion or entertainment to hold onto.
v: Casting + makeup మాత్రం terrific... movie మాత్రం political spoof collection la anipinchindi 😐 RGV says audience wants entertainment. Naaku ikkada adhe miss ayyindi.
body:
I generally watch a movie as a movie and nothing else…..but still its was crystal clear that RGV made this movie with the sole intention of making mockery of few ppl and project one person as the greatest leader…..

i liked Lakshmi’s NTR as irrespective of whom it targetted it showed the love of between an aged and lonely old man & an already married women and the consequences they faced as the oldman belong to one of the powerful political family.

but in this movie there is nothing but just a mockery of ppl and audience by just showing spoof’s.

The only positive/good I see in the movie is the terrific work done by the casting directors and make up artists to closely match the real life chars and nearly perfect imitation of Lokesh, Pawan Kalyan and KA Paul.

As RGV himself says in the movie that “In Politics or Cinemas or in life the audience doesnt expect anything other than entertainment” and this film is far and miles away from providing any sort of entertainment to the general audience!!!

e: Venky Mama survives almost entirely on Venkatesh’s effortless comedy and emotional timing and the chemistry between the uncle and nephew. The story, dialogue, direction, music and BGM leave little impression, while the pre-climax and climax become so illogical that even Venky’s charm cannot fully save the film.
v: Title laga this is Venky Mama’s show 😄 His comedy + emotion + mama-alludu chemistry save whatever they can... climax varaku మాత్రం patience test full ga.
body:
as the title suggests….its Venky’s one man show!!! apart from Venky’s Comedy & Emotional Timing along with Mama-Alludu chemistry there is nothing much to say about the story, dialogues, direction, BGM or Music. The pre climax and Climax episodes test the patience of audience with complete illogical sequences _/\_

only Venky Mama is the saving grace for this otherwise below par film…….

e: Housefull 4 knows exactly what kind of movie it wants to be: loud, illogical and proudly ridiculous. It is neither the best nor the worst of the franchise, but Akshay Kumar’s expressions, the ensemble madness and a stream of absurd surprises made it a thoroughly enjoyable time-pass watch for me.
v: LOVED IT!!!!!! 😂 Logic, emotion, message anni intlo vadilesi vellandi. Akshay full madness... only my Aakhri Pasta deserved much better 😄
body:
LOVED IT!!!!!! a perfect movie for you…if u want to enjoy a fun filled crazy movie without any logic!!!! but if u are a person who expects logic emotions and mesaage then please be at home….

I have been following all the Golmal and Housefull series and though this is not the best but it is not the worst……

Akshay Kumar is the real allrounder of Bollywood where he can fit into the super Action/National Integrity/Message Oriented and now into the madness of the Housefull so effortlessly and man he steals the show with his epic facial expressions and it really takes a lot to accept a char which is just a main comedian role and not a hero of the movie!!!!!

Being a big fan of Aakhri Pasta I was dissapointed that this char was not etched properly unlike the previous housefull series…..barring that dissapointment one can expect a lot many mad suprises like Nawazuddin doing an ITEM SONG and The Hulk Rana playing kawaalli singer Rangeela Raja _/\_

overall a nice time pass and laugh riot movie if you dont mind the illogical plot and mad comedy!!!!!

e: Sye Raa starts with a very familiar patriotic-film template and spends too long on family and romance, but the movie changes dramatically once its central conflict takes over. From there, Chiranjeevi, the huge supporting cast and the technical departments combine to deliver the scale, intensity and fan moments the opening stretch was missing.
v: First 45 mins almost punishment 😪 But revolt start ayyaka movie totally changes gear. Chiru’s eyes + dialogue diction + final stretch make it a proper big-screen ride 🙏
body:
To start with….the film simply follows the tested format and screenplay of a Patriotic Movie with Char Introduction and Initial days, Followed by the Opression and then Revolt followed by Backstabbing and The End!!!!! and to make matters worse the first 45 mins of the movie was a pain with focus more on Narasimha’s family, romance etc…..and simply Chiru -Nayantara, Tammana combination was not convincing!!!!!

but what followed after the first painful 45 mins makes this movie a Block Buster……once the main conflict has been established it was a treat to watch all the efforts put in by the Director, Fight Masters, Dialogue Writters, DOP and Music Directors _/\_

with the actors like Chiru, Amitabh, Kicha Sudeep, Jagapathi Babu, Ravi Kisan have ensured to carry the intensity of the movie on their shoulders……though he put all the best efforts its bit hard to Imagine Chiru who is of 60+ years of age in the char of a warrior, but the Intensity in his EYES and the diction of his dialogues were simply awesome and convince us to ignore his age!!!! Acting wise its his best performace after Apadhbandhavudu!!!!!

Direction by Surrender Reddy has been very good and he ensured to give those awesome moments for the Chiru fans….special mention of the final 10 mins which showed the brilliance of Chiru’s Intensity to the core _/\_

Finally Tammana and Kicha Sudeep got meatier roles after being ignored in Bahuballi…..Tammana did a very good job and Kicha Sudeep has simply excelled himself where he totally owned up the scenes and even dominated Chiru with his careless attitude…..dissapointed that Vijay Sethupathi was limited to only couple of scenes and didnt had much scope to showcase his talent but adds value with his screen presence!!!! Amitabh’s char was far more subtle as a guru…..but when all these wonderful actors fill up the screen its an Awesome view!!!!!

Finally…..All the Technicians and Actors have worked really hard to make Chiru’s dream project a SUCCESS!!!!!!

e: GangLeader suffers mainly from the huge expectations created by Vikram Kumar and Nani joining hands. Taken on its own terms, though, the deliberately ordinary heroes and villain, subtle comedy and a handful of wonderfully staged scenes make the simple revenge story feel far more distinctive than its plot suggests.
v: Personally, I LOVED it 😄 Simple revenge story, but Vikram Kumar gives it his own flavour. Nani natural ga rocks... expectations ni konchem pakkana petti chudandi.
body:
personally I loved the movie!!! this time Vikram came up with a simple revenge story but with special treatment…..special mention of 5 particular scenes (Starting Scene, Interval framing, 2 scenes in second half and the post climax scene reavling Sravani’s char) which stand out to show the intelligence of the director _/\_

the major set back of the film is the expectations out of Vikram post Manam & the deadly combination of Vikram and Nani!!!!! where the audience expect an highely intelligent and entertaining thriller….. but if we watch it without expectations then we can understand the intellegance of the director in coming up with a story where none of the main characters are powerful including the villan but its bot diificult to digest for the regulat audience who are accustomed to poweful villans in Rajamouli and Boyapati type movies!!!!!

Nani was as usual at his Natural best and totally submitted himself to the character!!!!

BGM from Anirudh is trendy and songs could have been better from the guy of his calibre…..

thr movie though with the simple and powerless chars, sublime comedy still holds the grip on audience.

Strictly Not for the audience who expect Powerful Villan/Hero characters (or) those who expect full length comedy entertainer from Nani…..Audience who love different genre movies will connect with it!!!!!

e: Chhichhore captures college friendships with characters who feel instantly familiar, then blends that nostalgia with a genuinely meaningful emotional message. Nitesh Tiwari and his writers balance comedy, sentiment and emotion in almost perfect proportions, creating the rare film whose effort and result are both complete successes.
v: Man!!!! What a movie 🙏 College friendship, comedy, emotion, message... anni correct mix lo land ayyayi. Dil Chahta Hai / 3 Idiots zone lo happily pettestha.
body:
Man!!!! what a movie….I am not exaggerating, but this movie has in it to make it to the list of the likes of #DilChahtaHai #3Idiots & #ZindagiNaMilegiDobara

The film actually made in terms of the above 3 mentioned above but it stands out in its own unique way in the emotinal message it delivers & the realistic way the collage life & chars are protrayed…..We always can find a “Anni” “Sexa” “Acid” “Mummy” & “Bevda” in our group of friends

Director Nitesh Tiwari and his group of writers did a fantastic job with the story, dialogues and screen play by mixing emotion, sentiment and comedy in perfect proportions……..The Screenplay of the movie stands out and is outstanding!!!! thus leaving audience with a feel of watching an Emotional Comedy movie with Sentiment!!!!!

in one word……the film dialogue “its not your result that decides if you are successful or a failure…..but its ur effort that decides it!!!!” sums up the whole movie

but in my view….the Chhichhore team not only succeded in their efforts but also with the results _/\_

e: Dream Girl takes a premise that could easily have slipped into cheap or vulgar comedy and handles it with surprising control. Ayushmann is effortlessly convincing, Raaj Shaandilyaa’s writing keeps the jokes lively without crossing the line, and the supporting cast turns the unusual setup into a bright, accessible entertainer.
v: Ayushmann ki ee subjects select chese dhairyam ekkadi nunchi vasthundo 😄 Naughty setup ni vulgar ga kakunda full fun ga handle chesaru. Supporting gang కూడా rocks.
body:
from where does Ayushmann has got this guts to select the unconventional subjects and effortlessly put such a natural & convincing acting!!!! He is defintly on the path of being the next big thing in Bollywood along with Raj Kumar Rao….

story wise i felt like the content was inspired from #TumhariSulu with a twist of Ayushmann playing the Pooja role……if not handled properly the so called decent audience would have out right rejected the movie as it would have fallen in vulgur category!!!! but thats where the Debut Director & Story/Dialogue Writter #RaajShaandilyaa has shown his talent in making sure the dialogues are spicy and witty enough but never crossed the border to become vulgur (justed wiki’d about him and observed that he had experience of vast writting for Comedy Circus) and the master stroke was selecting a top notch supporting artists who ensured that the content is conveyed perfectly in witty way but never crossing the border!!!!

BGM perfectly complements the mood of the story and the 2 songs are perfect match to the contenet!!!! Visuals were bright and appealing…..

the only drawback (if any) in the movie was the usage of the Hariyani and Utter Pradesh slang in dialogues……which though gave realistic feeling of the places where the story happened but will make bit difficult for audience from other parts of the country to enjoy the movie effortlessly!!!!

e: iSmart Shankar is Puri Jagannadh going back to unapologetic mass cinema, this time with a sci-fi hook and Ram operating at absurd energy levels. The writing may not have Puri’s hardest-hitting dialogue, but Mani Sharma’s BGM, Ram’s performance and the director’s full-throttle attitude made this exactly the kind of mass feast I wanted.
v: Puri + Mani + Ram kalisi proper garam masala biryani vandaaru 🔥 Logic pakkana, MASS full ga. Ram energy ento devudike teliyali 😂 Poyiiii kummundri!!!!!
body:
when 3 baaaps of Mass (Puri, Mani & Ram) come toghther…..the result is Isssssmartish Block Buster _/\_

Puri choose a Masssssssy movie with a scifi backdrop and mannnn he delivers!!!!!! being a Puriiii fan…..I loved all his previous works and this movie was nothing different for me, however Poori has ensured to give that extra mass kick!!!!!

Dialogues wise nothing much hard hitting dialgues from poori this tine but he came with few of the best massy dailogues _/\_

Manisharma gave the best BGM…..esp the BGM in climax gives you instant high!!!!!

Ram _/\_ _/\_ wonder if he was on drug to give such a hyper energitic performance!!!!

finallly…..aaadaaa Poori Mani & Ram kalisi balasinaa potelllu ni kooosi…..garam maasala poosiiiii…..masth birayniiii ondiru…..poyiiiii kumundri!!!!!

e: Falaknuma Das has a few actors doing genuinely good work, but their effort disappears inside a 150-minute film that felt painfully stretched and repetitive. I am normally open to realistic cinema, but here the refusal to use emotion, twists or entertainment made the so-called realism feel more like a test of patience than a strength.
v: Brahmotsavam tarvatha na patience ni ila test chesina movie idhe 🙏😪 20-min story ni 150 mins ‘realism’ peru tho stretch chesi champesaru.
body:
one of the worst movies I have ever seen after Bhramotsavam…..a story line which would have been apt for a 20 mins short film was stretched stretched stretched into a 150 mins film!!!!

this movie will be an example where how the audience patience will be tested if the director doesnt want to take any cinematic liberty and doesnt want to include any emotions twists or entertainment and solely depends on so called realistic approach!!!!!!

few of the actors performed excellent but all their efforts go in vain as we see the same far stretched repeated scenes without any purpose!!!

I am generally open to different geners and realistic films….but this movie has tested my patience as there was nothing expect the directors over zeal to make an realistic film with realistic story with realistic emotions and realistic dialogues.

a normal cine goer will be totally pissed of with this movie….a total waste of time!!!!!

e: Jersey is unapologetically emotional rather than mass entertainment, so its impact depends heavily on what kind of cinema you enjoy. For viewers who connect with realistic drama, Nani’s effortless performance, Gowtam Tinnanuri’s direction, well-shot cricket scenes and touching dialogues make it a deeply rewarding watch.
v: REEListic story with REAListic emotions 🙏 Nani ki ee role cakewalk laga untundi. Mass kosam kaadu... emotion connect ayithe Jersey definitely hits hard.
body:
REEListic Story dealt with REAListic emotions!!!!

a Must watch if you are a fan of movies with emotional content!!!! a one time watch if you are normal movie lover and a Never watch if you are purely into Entertainment or Mass Movies!!!!

What could have been an award winning ir once in life time performance for many other actors…had been a simple cake-walk performance for Nani!!!

Director had done full justice to the emotional theme of the movie and also the cricketing scenes have been shot really well!!!

Audio is pretty ordinary but the BGM though sublime was pretty good in elevating the emotional mood of the film!!!!

Heroine Shraddha, Satyaraj and the little Kid have done complete justice to their respective roles!!!

special mention of the superb dialogues which sounded pretty real and touching like few below….

Baaga aade vadini Captain cheyaaru……aadu Captain avuthe andhharini baagha adisthadu annukunodine Captain ni chestharu!!!!

aadi vyasu ki artham kakappvachu gaani…naaa manusuku telusu ra mosam chesanu anni!!!

maa naana prayatnisthu chanipoyadu anukunam kadhaaa…..kaadhu chanipothadani telisinaa prayatninchaadu!!!

naaku aapu ichinolantha guda nanu dabbullu epudu thirigi isthavu ra anni epudu adagaaru!!! adhi naa medha prema tho kadhu……nenu thirigi ivalenanna namakam tho!!!

e: F2 reminded me of the old family multi-starrers where frustrated husbands run away from domestic life, get into trouble and eventually rediscover the value of family. Anil Ravipudi revives that template with plenty of loud comedy, but almost everything irritated me except Venkatesh slipping comfortably back into his vintage comic zone.
v: FUN kosam vellanu... FRUSTRATION ekkuva vachindi 😪 Story, comedy, songs, overacting anni test chesayi. Vintage Venky comedy okkate naaku real fun.
body:
I felt FRUSTRATED more than fun!!!!

back then in late 90’s and early 20’s there used to be a trend of so called “Family Multi Starrers” where a Group of friends and Husbands get vexed with their Families/Wifves and go on a wrong path….then due to circumstances they realize the importance of happy wedding and importance of wife and story ends!!! with endless and mindless comedy wrapped all over the plot like…..Sandade Sandadi….Kshemamga Velli Labhamga Randi….etc

which had the slowly fading heros either Srikanth/Jagapathi Babu , upcoming and struggling hero Shivaji and Rajendra Prasad as lead caste!!!!

Mr. Anil has got INSPIRED from the same golden era…..and casted Venkatesh, Varun and again MR.Rajendra Prasad!!!!

The Film had Frustrating Story….Frustrating silly Comedy….Frustrating Songs and BGM….Frustrating Family….Frustratingly overacting Heroins and Prakashraj!!!

the only FUN is to see Vintage Venky who had done comedy movie after a long time!!!!

e: Vinaya Vidheya Rama takes every familiar Boyapati ingredient and pushes it several levels beyond excess: more emotion, more villainy, louder dialogues, bigger fights and logic that disappears almost completely. Ram Charan’s ease with the high-voltage material is the only real positive I found, even though my daughter apparently had a very different verdict 😄
v: Ram Charan did a Balakrishna 😂 Boyapati regular excess ni kuda OVER-dose chesadu. Physics, biology, geography anni holiday lo... Charan మాత్రం madness ni confidently survives.
body:
Ram Charan did a Balakrishna!!!!!

the normal template of Boyapati is…..an Emotional Family!!! a Powerful Hero!!! a Cruel Villan!!! High Voltage Dialogues !!! High Top class Fights!!! and weak Physics!!!!

but with Ram Charan & High budget on board…..Boya ensured an OVER Emotional Family!!!! an OVER Powerful Hero!!! an OVER Cruel Villan!!! OVER Voltage Dialogues!!! Over the Top Fights!!!! and Weakest Physics!!!!

this time he ensured to Brutally Rape Biology, Geography, Civics along with Physics!!!!

while Boya was busy with above….DSP ensured he did his bit to rape the concept of Music and BGM _/\_

the only positive in the whole movie is Ram Charan…who was completely at ease in deleviring this High voltage Dialogues and Fights!!!

PS : MY DAUGHTER LOVED THE MOVIE!!!!

e: Petta is not trying to win anyone with airtight logic or a fresh story; it is designed to celebrate Rajinikanth’s screen presence after a run of slower, message-heavy films. Karthik Subbaraj understands that brief, Anirudh gives the mass moments a superb canvas, and Vijay Sethupathi, Nawazuddin Siddiqui and Simran add extra flavour.
v: Go get RAJINIfied!!! 😍 Story/logic pakkana petti Rajini style + Anirudh BGM kosam vellandi. Karthik Subbaraj finally gives Thalaivaa the commercial feast fans wanted.
body:
Go get RAJINIfied!!! after all the social message oriented slow paced movies from Pa.Ranjit….Karthik Subbaraj was successful in delivering a much needed commercial pot boiler for the Super Star _/\_

as its a commericial movie so lets not care about logic and story line!!! Karthik was successful in glorifying Rajini’s screen presence and style charisma!!! Anirudhs BGM is asusual terrific and sets the perfect canvas for the superstar to unleash his neverending stylish charisma!!!! Also loved the way director tried to take dig at RSS and BJP in a subtle manner 😛

Though didnt get much meatier roles…..Vijay Sethupathi and Nawazuddin Siddiqui proved icing on the cake with their terrific acting!!! After a long gap was pleasently surprised to see Simran on the big screen and she is beautiful as usual and the romance between Simran and Rajini were dealt in very cute manner!!!!

Rajini’s first dialouge in the movie is “ayipoyanu anukunaru kadharaaaaaaa……..(and there is the Rajinis typical laugh) and looks like it was intentional as though Rajini is facing very low in his career but he is never out of the Race!!!!

e: NTR: Kathanayakudu works best for viewers who simply want to relive NTR’s charisma and revisit famous incidents from his film career. For me, the lack of dramatic setbacks, the endless recreations and the difficulty of accepting Balakrishna as a much younger NTR make the three-hour film feel shallow despite his enormous effort and a few excellent scenes.
v: DISAPPOINTED 😞 Balayya effort 1000%, but 3 hours of movie recreations without enough drama exhausted me. Ee life story ki web series space better undedi.
body:
Kathanayakudu, DISSAPOINTED!!!

COULD HAVE BEEN A BETTER MULTI-SEASON WEBSERIES RATHER THAN A MOVIE!!!!

to begin with, I generally classify the audiance watching a Biopic into 3 categories…

1. People who want to relive the charisma of the person
2. People who want to know the ups and downs in the life of the person and how he/she overcame the challanges faced
3. People who care a shit of above 2 points and watch it as a normal movie

#Mahanati was a classic hit because it had content to cater all the 3 classifications….unfortunately Kathanayakudu fails in that aspect as there is no much failures of NTR after his initial struggle which is essential to create the much needed drame….though there are some 4, 5 scenes which elevate the drama but the quantity is much less to sustain the drama for the whole 3 hrs long movie!!!!

rather than getting carried away with the awe factor of a Son essaying the role of his real father in movies…..probably Krish/Balaya could have applied some logic that its easy to show case a person in his youth as an middle aged or old man with make up…..but the vice versa is not possible!!!! Just couldnt digest the fact and somehow it was pain to watch Balaya who is in his late 50’s? as a youngster who wants to chase his dreams!!! Having said that Balaya has put in 1000% efforts to make this movie a memorable one for his family, party and hardcore fans of NTR….but some how the movie is missing the depth to cater to larger audiance

The whole Mayabazar Lord Krishna role scene was excellently shot……should have totally avoided Balaya babus self dabba scene!!!only later part of 2nd half was engaging. but the time you reach that point you will be vexed up with endless movie parodies 😦

Finally Watch it….for Balaya and to know a high level glimpse of the stories and incidents which we have already known!!!!

Hope atleast Mahanayakudu…..caters to all the 3 classifications of the audiance!!! till then I am ready to take the warth of all NTR Balaya and TDP fans 😛

e: 2.0 worked for me as a focused futuristic sci-fi film rather than a regular star vehicle. Shankar builds the entire movie around one unusual idea, keeps commercial distractions to a minimum and pushes Indian visual effects towards an ambitious scale, while A.R. Rahman’s BGM and the final Rajini-heavy stretch deliver the spectacle.
v: Shankar imagination ki hats off 🙏 Out-of-box sci-fi idea + huge visual ambition + Rahman BGM... ee scale lo dream chese filmmakers ni support cheyyali.
body:
to start with I have seen many a posts where people are clebrating or making fun of the collections of this film…let me tell you
if this movie fails then Indian film industry doesnt deserve a creative genius like Shankar and he can comfortably move to Hollywood and that would be our greatest loss

How on earth Shankar can come up with these out of box concepts and visualization _/\_ pretty much like Hollywood movie the whole movie revolves around single concept and there are no unecessary distractions and commericial elements……Shakars visualisation is of top notch and it was always a challange for the CGI team to make Shankars dream a relaity. Story wise it is the only movie I have seen after Avatar which showcased Human race in negative and I pretty much loved that concept. AR Rahmans BGM is World class. and Fans get to see typical Rajini style in only last 30 mins.

Wonder what Shankar could have achieved if he hadnt faced challanges with the CGI team

Those who are commeting on the movie comparing with Bahubali….please note that Bahubali was a periodic drama with time and tested formula of Brothers revange ( story wise it didnt had any novality) but 2.0 is a futuristic Scifi film with superb and creative story…..And Bahubali was perfectly packaged and marketed with Business brain of Rajamouli. So stop talking nonsense and hive 2.0 its due credit. Shankar always comes with these unique story ideas (for I he came up with a story of a super successful model turned into a ugly beast due to a virus) and 2.0 on How mobiles make Humans run for their life _/\_

e: Deva Das has an ordinary plot and equally basic execution, but its casting changes the experience considerably. Nani’s effortless expressions and Nagarjuna’s screen presence give the film most of its charm, while an impressive BGM and regular laughs make it an easy time-pass watch if you leave the logical brain at home.
v: Basic story, basic execution... but Nani handles acting, Nag handles glamour 😄 Their combo + good BGM make it a decent timepass.
body:
it has a normal basic story plot…..and basic execution, you neither feel as if you are watching a great movie nor you feel as you are watching a bad movie!!! The director tried to balance between a comercial and message movie…..However the strength of this movie lies in the perfect star cast where the director successed in utilizing the natural acting skills of Nani and superb screen presence of Nag which has proved to be the game changer for this movie. Coming to Nani….Man what an actor!!! he makes it look easy with his cute expressions _/\_ coming to Nag his screen presence is enough and his fitness and handsome levels are outstanding!!! looks like while Nani was busy in taking care of the acting part of the movie….Nag has shouldered the responsibility of Glamour part!!! Nothing much for the Heroines….

Songs wise its again an average…..with evety song being neither good nor bad!!! However the movie has very impressive BGM…..Overall its a Good Time Pass movie with good laughs for every 3-5 mins only if you put your logical brain at home

e: C/o Kancharapalem may share a broad emotional space with films like Naa Autograph, but its execution and sensitivity put it well above most comparisons for me. The local setting, first-time actors, natural dialogue and small situational songs create an experience that feels lived-in rather than manufactured — a classic for viewers open to this kind of cinema.
v: What a movie!!!!! 🙏 Familiar love-story space ni so natural ga, sensitive ga chepparu. Characters, dialogues, little songs... everything feels lived, not acted. Repeat-watch list.
body:
To start with, thanks to Srikanth Dontharaju for inspiring/forcing me to watch this movie in theater……coming to the movie, what a movie, though it is inline with the concept of Naa Autograph and many others…..but execution and sensivity wise it is well above others.

with Vintage rural background and natural dialogues which create an everlasting impact…..a simple dialogue in which a prostitute say’s “Ipati dhaka nanu vasthavaaa anniadiginolle thappa…..premisthava anni adiginollu leeru raa” and a Boy gifting Condoms to his lover who is by profession a prostitute _/\_

Man there are many more such impactful scenes and dialogues!!!! and all the STAR cast acting for tye very first time adds more naturality to it!!! and wonderful short situational songs with loads and loads of meaning adds to the wonderful experiance.

Will be in repeated watchlist once its released in Amazon 🙂

PS : This classic is not for regular movie goers….so please dont watch if its not your gener and kill the soul of the movie with your negative feedback

e: Sanju openly presents itself as Sanjay Dutt’s version of events, so I did not see the positive framing as something the film was hiding. By focusing mainly on addiction and the TADA case, Rajkumar Hirani finds enough material to explore the complicated father-son relationship, deep friendship and his familiar criticism of TRP-driven media, backed by an excellent cast.
v: Ranbir makeup lo 80% Sanju ayithe, acting lo 200% Sanju 🙏 Vicky కూడా superb. Hirani’s version of the story worked well for me as a father-son + friendship drama.
body:
to start with, many ppl are commenting on the movie for showing Sanjay Dutt in positive light and that he was shown as if he was a victim!!!! I guess those intellectuals missed the very beginning scene of the movie, which clearly conves that the movie is Sanju’s version of the incidents

now coming to the movie……the plot of the movie focused only on the Drugs and TADA case on Dutt, However that was enough for Raj Kumar Hirani to briliantly convey the emotions and relation between a super star father and his spoil brat son and the emotional depth of friendship _/\_ and Hirani in his typical style conveyed his take on the Media which runs behind Breaking News!!!!

It was a perfect Star cast and the Vicky who played the role of Sanju’s best buddy put a steller performance and made audience to notice him rather than being shadowed with steller performances of Ranbir, Paresh & Manesha……

Make up wise, Ranbir Kappor’s resembeled 80% of Sanjay Dutt but acting wise he was 200% Sanjay esp during the days of Khalnaayak times!!! He put a steller performance especially for the Drug addict and rehab acts _/\_

The icing on the cake is Sanjay’s cameo in the rolling title song “Baba Bholtha hai bas ho gaya” which is a tight slap on the TRP hungry media!!!!

PS : I was very much dissapointed as there was no mention of RGV or Daud which was the first movie to release after Dutt’s release from Jail’s first term 😛

e: Kaala doubles down on Pa. Ranjith’s preferred style even though that approach had already frustrated me in Kabali. The film rarely feels like a Rajinikanth vehicle, the exaggerated supporting characterisations and recurring rap interventions became exhausting, and even Nana Patekar is given a generic role — for me, Kabali was considerably better.
v: GOOD news: Pa. Ranjith didn’t change after Kabali. BAD news: exactly the same 😂 Rajini kosam vellina naaku mostly patience testే. Kabali itself felt better.
body:
The GOOD thing is Pa Ranjith didnt try to change his way of story telling irrespective of Kabali’s debacle……..and the WORST thing is Pa Ranjith didnt try to change his way of story telling even after Kabali’s debacle!!!!

Rajni might have accepted the movie as the story might help him to connect with the masses and help him in his political carrer but he shouldnt have taken the decision to torture his Film Fans!!!

Barring 2 scenes this was never a Rajini’s movie…..many of previous Rajni’s movies had storng message with commercial elements which worked wonders for him…..but somehow Pa Ranjit was only concerend with his typical way of story telling and over the top charachterizations who test your patience _/\_

special mention of the RAP gang who always stay beside Kaala and perform RAP irrespective of the situation…..and they test your patience in couple of scenes where the RAP something like….”Kaala Kaala Kaala…..Manoolani champesaru Kaala….inkenthakalam ee mounam Kaala Kaala Kaala” and in another scene where trying to give condolence they again Rap “ammaa chala manchidi….amma chala manchidi”….hufff mee creativity ki oo dandam raa ayya

Nana Patekar was simply wasted in a generic role but he made sure his presence is felt…….Kaabali was far more better than Kaala….

e: Officer is deliberately far removed from conventional star cinema: Nagarjuna’s cop runs when survival demands it, there is no standard heroine track or hero-elevation package, the violence is harsh and RGV’s odd camera angles remain unapologetically his own. Those choices will alienate many viewers, but I liked the focused two-hour conflict, intelligent action design, BGM and several sharp dialogues.
v: I know I’m in the minority 😄 Officer worked for me. Realistic action, strong BGM, RGV angles and a vulnerable Nag... regular hero elevations expect cheyakunda chudandi.
body:
before I start my analysis of the film, I will try to analyze the reasons why it got so disastorus reviews/mouth talk:

1. rather than film being bad, Its more to do with RGV’s recent offscreen attitude which has rubbed many ppl on the wrong side, and they were hell bent in making this film a disaster even before its release (including so called reveiw writers)

2. the film is so realistic where hero being a cop runs for his life and waits for right moment, which doesnt gel well with the hero fans who want the hero to fight even 500 odd goondas irrespective of in which situation he is

3. the film has too much violance like chopping of a Kids finger, which doesnt suite the sensabilities of family and sensitive audience

4. RGV uses his weird camera angles which doest make a pleasent view for the normal audience who are accustomed to watch a movie in specific angle

Now coming to the movie, I have seen reviews complaining about No story in the film……My first question to them is were they busy sleeping in theater?? Movie is just 2 hrs long and covers the conflict of a Police Officer who is also a Mafia Gangleader and another Officer who is falsely accused as a Mafia leader…..well how much more story u need for a 2 hrs film???

Yes the movie is far away from commercial aspects where there is no heroine and no hero elevation scenes or dialogues……..but the movie is too real where the hero runs and the female lead has more gunshots than the hero _/\_ and though there are no hero elevation punch dialogues. there are thought provoking dialogues like :

oka vishayani artham chesukone mundhu……daani guda artham chesukovalsina vishayam okati undi anni guda artham kavali…..

1. jivitham lo nuvu entha ethu edhiginaa….neekaaana payna okkadu untadu anni epudu gurthupetuko

2. aadu chepina…ee nijam abadhamooo….ee abadham nijamo…manam kanipetali

3. Snehithulanni degarunchukovali……satruvalani marinyha degaraunchukovali

4. Prathi manashullo devudu rakshasudu idharu unttaaru

5. warnings isthu nenu time waste cheyanu……and the villan simply chops off a Kids finger with this simple dialogue _/\_

Yes, I agree that RGV should come out of this underworld and mafia stories but that is what he and Nag have said in each and every interview…….and as they promised it has one of the best BGM and realistic and intelligent action episodes (Beach episode, Essel World episode and whole Climax)

Just to conclude…..I might have loved this move because I am adarant fan of RGV and have his influence in the way I take pictures. However this movie was liked by my Wife nd my daughter equally, which shows that if you go with open mind…u have chances of liking this movie!!!!

e: Mahanati succeeds with every kind of viewer I could imagine: people who lived through Savitri’s aura, later generations who knew the legend from family and films, and complete newcomers simply looking for a cinematic experience. Nag Ashwin’s narrative, the period craft, Samantha’s climax and astonishing lead performances make it a wonderful, deeply emotional experience.
v: Haa... ee movie gurinchi ఎంత రాసినా emotion complete ga cheppalenu 🙏 Mahanati pulled me into that era and Keerthy + Dulquer simply LIVED those roles. EPIC.
body:
to start with…..the audience for this movie can be classified into 3 types:

1. The old old age ppl, who lived during the aura of Savitri and are keen to see how the current generation has show cased her aura on screen

2. The next category is the old aged ppl…who though may have not lived through the aura, may have known little about her (jst like the current kids known about Chiru) and are keen to see her story

3. The last group who may have no idea who the hell Savitri is and are least bothered to know about her aura….but came to theater just for a cinematic experience

and the beauty of this EPIC is all the above 3 types of audience get glued to the movie withine first 20 mins and leave the auditorium with heart full of emotions!!!

The first 2 types of audience will find the Biopic a great tribute to the legendary actress, whereas the the 3 type of audience will find the movie similar to the lines of Madhur Bhandarkar’s Fashion set in the Movue backdrop and 1960’s aura……irrespective of your perspective of watching the movie, you will surely get involved till the rolling titles and the 3 hrs long movie never feel like Long!!!!

The Director, Cinematographer and the Dialogue writer and BGM composer have made sure that the audience get lost in the beauty of the Black n White era…….

Rather than narrating the biography in a simple and straight manner, the director has cleverly mixed it with the story of a Journalist shows his brilliance _/\_ The first 10 mins itself gives the audience a clue about what they are goining to witness in the next 2.5 hrs and the Climax with superb dialogues and Samantha’s performance is simply a standout _/\_ _/\_ _/\_

Keerthy suresh and Dulquer Salmaan just lived in the chars of Savitri and Gemini Ganeshan!!!!

haa…….could keep on writing on this movie, but cannot 100% put the emotions I have gone through while watching it……Thanks Nag Ashwin for the wonderful experience, you have dreamt about this Biopic and made it Big….Very Very Big!!!

e: 102 Not Out proves that strong writing and execution can do wonders without a huge canvas. Amitabh Bachchan and Rishi Kapoor are effortless, but the real stars are Umesh Shukla and writer Saumya Joshi, who turn a potentially heart-wrenching three-character story into a warm, funny and emotionally lasting experience.
v: Father wants to send his 75-year-old son to an old-age home 😂 Premise itself enough! Amitabh + Rishi give laughs, emotion and a lovely message without turning it into a tear-fest.
body:
Amitabh and Rishi Kapoor are in that phase of career where they can select the scripts which emotionally move them or challange their acting capabilities without worrying about the so called fans or box office results!!!! and here we go they have worked on a subject which lasts an emotional impact on the audience.

The script doesnt challange the acting capabilities of the 2 legends at any point of time…..but its the content and execution which keeps the audience glued to the screen. common we was the last time we came across the story which is atleast 50% emotional or meaningful as the one where a Father wanting to Join his Son in a Old Age Home!!!! _/\_

given the nature of the story, one could expect the movie to be a Heartwrenching emotional ride…..but what we get is 1 hr 40 mins of geninue laughs with under current emotion and message _/\_

the stiry has mainly 3 chars and these are the kind of stories which creats an intrest in the writer and director the film rather than the star cast…..and its Umesh Shukla the director and Saumya Joshi the writer….kudos 2 both of u for making us believe that superb content with low budget can do wonders

e: Bharath Ane Nenu did not win me over through originality; I felt Koratala Siva was drawing heavily from the political climate and films such as Leader. But he packages those familiar ideas extremely well, blending commercial hero elevations into the story, giving Mahesh Babu one of his strongest recent vehicles and tapping directly into audience frustration with politics and TRP-driven media.
v: Leader ni full commercial BLOCKBUSTER package lo cook chesthe Bharath Ane Nenu 😄 Freshness meeda doubts unna, Mahesh + dialogues + DSP + elevations totally work.
body:
to start with, I was never a fan of Koritala Shiva’s stories as I somehow feel that he gets inspired from whats happening around him and then completely fills with commercial elements…..like Srimanthudu was directly lifted from Modi’s Saansad Adarsh Gram Yojana and added few high octane commercial scenes

for Janatha Garage, he got inspired from Telangana govt’s Haritha Haram project and designed Hero’s charachter who loves tree’s and the story is inspired from many of RGV’s old fomula of Sarkar series!!!

Now coming to Bharath Ane Nenu……he got inspired from the polictical environment in the country and state, then watched LEADER movie and bingo he got his story readymade!!!! (only my point of view though)

as the story is readily available, he completely focuses on ensuring that commericial ingrediants and Hero elevation scenes are perfectly added and followed the same elevation templates of Srimanthudu and Janata Gaurage, which effortlessly blend into the story!!!! and there we go we have a Blockbuster ready!!!!

its obviously the best movie Mahesh had in the recent past…..and we the audience instantly get connected to the movie as we were vexed up with the real current political scenario and how the media is behind trp’s!!!

the movie has some of the best dialogues in recent times and Mahesh performance is as usually intense and DSP’s music is again as usually terrific!!!

In one sentance…BharathAneNenu is a commercialised and Blockbuster version of LEADER!!!

e: Rangasthalam is less about Sukumar showing off clever narrative tricks and more about performances and world-building. The long runtime may test some viewers, but the cast is excellent, the 1980s Godavari village is beautifully realised, DSP’s BGM and meaningful songs add enormous flavour, and Ram Charan finally gets to show the actor inside the star.
v: 3 hours ante patience kavali 😄 But Charan, Samantha, Aadhi, Jagapathi Babu + that beautiful 80s Godavari world made Rangasthalam worth it for me. Charan finally shows the ACTOR 🙏
body:
the movie will disappoint you, if you are big fan of Sukumar’s intelligent direction. movie will disappoint you, if you are impatient to watch a movie which has a runtime close to 3 hrs.

on contrary, you will love the movie to the core if you watch it for Charan, Samantha, Aadhi, Jagapathi Babu & Naresh’s EXCELLENT performances. you will love the movie for the EXCELLENT potryal of the 1980’s Godari village. DSP’s BGM is as usual terrific and the music with perfect and meaningful lyrics add value. spl shout out to “Aa gatununtava” song which had great lyrics and somehow missed in the Hit list and was supressed by other 2 chartbusters

Finally after a Decade in films, Charan has finally showed audience his acting capeabilities, which will make the Actor Chiru (not the megastar or best dancer of TFI) proud!!! Hope he continues similar kind of script selection

e: Needi Naadi Oke Katha stays admirably raw and focused instead of adding commercial distractions. That same honesty may limit its reach with viewers looking only for easy entertainment, but average and below-average students can connect instantly with its pressures, its idea of what it means to ‘settle’ in life and Sree Vishnu’s wonderfully natural performance.
v: VERY GOOD ki GREAT ki madhyalo ekkado 🙏 Raw ga, honest ga untundi. Class topper kaani vallaki ee marks/job/settle pressure chaala familiar ga hit avvachu.
body:
the film gets struck some where between a Very Good Movie and a Great Movie!!!! Kudos to the director for keeping the movie raw and to the point without adding any commercial elements, however that is what it makes the movie not connected to normal audience who watch movie for time pass!!!

Story wise its apt and any average and below average student gets connected to the movie instantly!!! and that dialogue Settle avadam ante okkapudu Govt job vasthey life lo settle avadam ane valu…tarvatha Bank Job ipudemooo Software Job!!!! _/\_

Sri Vishnu……such a natural performer _/\_ will ensure not to miss his movies

e: Tholiprema may have worked for almost everyone around me, including my friends and parents, but I remained completely disconnected from its romance. I liked several dialogues, the cinematography and the mature work from Varun Tej and Raashii Khanna; unfortunately the contrived romantic setup and familiar hero-heroine ego conflict overwhelmed those positives for me.
v: Hmmm... totally disconnected 😄 Visuals bagunnayi, Varun + Raashii mature ga act chesaru... but ee love-at-first-sight + ego-love story naaku malli work avvaledu.
body:
hmmmm…..felt totally disconnected!!!! Need to find the reason why I dont like watching Love stories….still Thinking what was the last total love story i liked? (may be Love Aaj Kal? or cocktail? or Anand? or Godavari?)

Not sure when our film makers start making REALISTIC love stories rather than coming up with nonsense like love at first sight and giving the actress no other option rather than fallingnfor him jst bcoz the hero fights for her and blend them wiyh no sense scenes!!! Who the hell now a days get out of train to fetch drinking water from Tap _/\_ and more over Hero Heorine madhya ego problems Kushi nunchi chusthundhe

Having said that when all my friends liked the movie including my parents…..the only thing I can say is thanks to RGV for fucking up my taste for Love stories!!!

PS : when the whole Telugu states were gaga over Yem Maya Chesave…..probably I was the only one who hated it 😦

However Loved couple of dialogues “Devudike caste lenaapudu….afterall manushulam manaki caste endhuku uncle” “Manushulam….prema gurthundadhu thappulu okate gurthuntayi” “mqnatho kondaru prema natistharu, kondaru kopam natisthaaru…kaani mana medha kopam natichevaalle ekuva premistharu”…..Cinematography and visuals were excellent….Varun Tej and Rasi gave matured performances

e: AWE! is the kind of unusual film that can divide viewers completely, yet its ambition kept surprising me throughout. Regina Cassandra delivers the standout performance, the BGM is terrific, the humour often carries a thoughtful edge and even the lone song neatly reflects the film’s central conflict.
v: AWEsomely awful aa... AW(E)fully awesome aa? 😄 Decide cheskondi. Naaku మాత్రం every few mins something interesting undi, Regina + BGM especially stood out.
body:
after watching the movie you may feel AWEsomely AW(E)ful OR AW(E)fully AWEsome……..but for eqch and every 5, 10 mins you will defintely feel AWE!!! BGM has been terrifically AWEsome!!!!

Though there are many performers, you will defintely fell AWE for Regina’s terrific performance!!!

Dialogues are humorus and thought provoking esp between Nani, Priyadarshi and Ravi Teja!!! and couple of dialogues from Nitya Menon as well

Though there is only one song, the lyrics is too good!!! SHATRUVAY DEHAME…..MANASUTHO THALAPADE!!!! sums up the story line _/\_

e: Padmaavat left me wondering what inspired Sanjay Leela Bhansali to fight so hard to make this particular story. The film is visually grand in places and Ranveer Singh is terrific, while Ratan Singh’s death and the jauhar sequence show Bhansali at his strongest; unfortunately Shahid Kapoor and Deepika Padukone feel badly underused and the core story never held me.
v: Intha controversy, intha grandeur... naaku మాత్రం story very thin ga anipinchindi 😐 Ranveer super, climax/jauhar portions Bhansali magic... migatha chala flat.
body:
wonder what has inspired mr.Bhansali to take up this project against all odds!!!! a nothing story of Two already married men’s lust for a women!!! Except for few low light grand shots and terrific performance from Ranveer the movie has nothing in it

Shahid Kapoor has a impeccable acting talent is unfortunately reduced to a single expression extra artist and Deepika who did fabulous acting even in crab Happy New Year is reduced to No expression artist

The shot in which Ratan Singh dies while fighting Khilji & the whole Jauhar episode shows the brilliance of Bhansali _/\_

e: Agnyaathavaasi frustrated me because even if the core story was familiar, the screenplay and direction still had every opportunity to make it work. A few trademark Trivikram lines survive, but weak staging drains their impact, while Pawan Kalyan’s deliberately eccentric performance is stretched so far that what might have been fun in one scene becomes exhausting across a full film.
v: Sharmaaaa... Varmaaaaa... manakenti ee KHARMA!!! 😭 Story familiar aina screenplay/directing save cheyyali ga... ikkada PK quirks ni కూడా overkill chesesaru.
body:
Cinema Story elago inspired ayinapudu…….kanesam screenplay & direction medhana focus petalsindhi…….Trivikram mark dialogues konni unna worst direction vala vati value lekunda poyindhi!!! PK ki perfect ga vachina ekayka acting gay performance adhi cinema lo oka scene unte fans enjoy chestharu gaani cinema motham unte rotha puduthundi!!!! Trivikram style lo ne cinema gurunchi chepali ante 》》 Sharmaaaa…..Varmaaaaa……maanakenti ee Kharma!!!!

PS : Naa venaka seat lo oka aunty cinema lo prathi scene ki thega navvesi pedha pedha ga arusthu thega irritate chesindhi (bahusa Jabardasth effect anukunta?) , cinema ayyipoyaka mathram cinema thala thoka lekunda chala chetha ga undi anndi, mundu amme thalakayi pagalagottali…….. 😛

e: Tubelight asks Salman Khan to carry an offbeat emotional story through innocence, childishness and vulnerability rather than star power. I respect his wholehearted effort, but Kabir Khan’s casting never convinced me: fans struggle to accept Bhai as a fragile ‘Tubelight,’ while neutral viewers struggle to forget Bhai long enough to believe the character.
v: BHAI can carry routine movies with presence... but Tubelight needed Salman to disappear into the character. Naaku మాత్రం BHAI ni marchipoyi Laxman ni nammadam jaragaledu 😄
body:
watched TubeLight……

Salman Khan the BHAI……can earn you hundreds of crores even with medicore routine subjects and depend solely on his Screen Presence like Dabang, Ready & Prem Ratan Dhan Payo!!!!

but that doesnt mean that Salman Khan the ACTOR….cannot earn you even a single crore with Scripts which are offbeat and depend solely on his ACTING capabilities like Tube Light!!!

Bhajarangi was a runaway hit with its strong storyline packed with various emotions and doesnt rely on Bhaijan’s acting talent…..and Salman’s screen presence has just elevated it to Blockbuster!!!

but TubeLight script itself has to rely on Lakshman’s emotions, Bonding and Childishness……thats exactly where Kabir Khan has failed completely in casting Salman. With Salman onboard (TUBE)light was thrown on scripts loopholes rather than putting them in Dark.

with due respect to Salman’s whole hearted efforts to fill the shoes of Lakshman aka TubeLight…….but we cannot imagine Salman trying to replicate Kamal Hasan’s performance at railway station in Sadma’s climax.

Bottom Line : Neither Fans accept Bhai being a Tubelight nor regular audience digest the fact that Tubelight is being played by Bhai!!!!

e: Sarkar 3 suffers mainly because both the genre and Subhash Nagre’s world have become deeply familiar. RGV does not reinvent the formula, so viewers expecting another landmark are bound to be disappointed; still, the film contains all the genre ingredients and felt to me like a filmmaker who had not reached home again, but had at least rediscovered the road back.
v: Old Sarkar magic malli raledu... but Govinda BGM, Nagre aura, weird RGV angles and a few solid lines make this a decent return. Home ki raaledu, road మాత్రం dorikindi 😄
body:
watched #Sarkar3……the major problem with the GodFather genre is the story and charachterizations gets repeatable and predicatable. after the first installment of Sarkar, various filmmakers makers have tried to exploit it and the genre is beaten to death!!

with RGV going back to Sarkar….many of us would have expected him to give a new angle & definition to the genre…..unfortunately he doesnt and thats where i see lot of negative reactions just because the expectations were too high!!!! I would bet the movie (taken as it is) would have become a good hit if RGV was not associated, such is the expectation on him

on that note….Sarkar3 has all the elements that are required for the genre. Powerful & Philosphical Oneliners, Shopisticated Business Men, Corrupted Politicians, Slow Camera Moments, Weird Camera Angles and our own Govinda Govinda Goooovinda!!!!!

RGV did directional justification to the movie, but being the 3rd part of the movie…..ppl are accustomed to Subash Nagre’s Black Dress, White Beard and Silent Killer Looks and the Govinda Govinda BGM, hence as audience we definetly miss the WOW factor which we experienced watching Sarkar for the very first time.

From past few years, RGV has completly lost his golden touch ( in audience perspective) in film making & focusing on social media controversies…..with Sarkar3 though he is not back home, he has definetly found way back!!!

PS : considering RGV’s contribution…..he has worked and focused a lot these years on slow motions, camera angles and different types of camers. I think its time he should try to uncover something new in film making & story telling process which will awe the audience & film makers!!!!

e: Baahubali 2 doubles down on everything Rajamouli does best: emotional payoff, larger-than-life elevations and brilliantly staged action powered by M.M. Keeravani’s score. Anushka’s Devasena and Rana’s Bhallaladeva dominate the concluding chapter, while the story takes centre stage strongly enough to answer anyone who felt the first film’s spectacle overshadowed its narrative.
v: Rajamouli elevations + emotions + Keeravani BGM = full blast 🔥 Rana and Anushka are the real pillars here. Logic pakkana petti experience ni enjoy cheyyandi.
body:
The Conclusion, Rajamouli played to his strengths, aaa elevation scenes gaani aaa emotions gaani _/\_ and with Keeravani deadly BGM its _/\_ _/\_ assalu supporting charachter chesina SubbaRaj ki guda 2 elevation shots petti full impact create chesadu

Anushka (Deva Sena)& Rana (Bhallala Deva) are the pillars of the concluding part…..assalu Rana terrific acting (expressions) mukhyam ga Bahubali ni champinapudu aythe _/\_ _/\_

assalu first part chusi…..2nd part lo Sivagami char terrific ga untundi anukunte, Deva Sena char inka terrific ga chupinchi simple ga Sivagami ni papa pakkaki elli aadukommaaa annaadu 🙂

Title Cards lo speciality chupinchali ante oka Sukumar valle avuthundi anukunaa but Rajamouli proved me wrong…….Fights lo logic ni pakana pedithe Terrific ga tesaadu……RGV Shiva tarvatha Chain ni fight sequence lo superb ga vadindhi indhulo climax fight lonee 🙂

First part chusi Story ni Graphics dominate chesayi anni complaint chesi……Second part lo Graphics ni Story dominate chesindi ani complaint chese konnimandi goppollu evaru aythe unnaro…….meeru elli dubbing cinemalu chusukondi poyi

e: Begum Jaan worked for me through sheer emotional force rather than conventional action. The rustic writing, excellent performances and powerful music create goosebumps without needing elaborate stunt sequences, while Vidya Balan dominates the centre and even Chunky Panday becomes genuinely frightening. Its boldness may limit the family audience, but the impact is undeniable.
v: Chunky Panday scary ga kanipisthe movie something special ani ardham 😂 Bold, raw, terrific performances... and Vidya is absolutely the BEGUM JAAN 🙏
body:
watched #BegumJaan ….. you know that you are watching a Great Movie when even Chunkey Pandey gets a meatier role and man he is full scary as Kabir…

and what a superb movie it is full of bold emotions and rustic dialoges with Top notch BGM and excellent acting from each n every artist….._/\_

You dont need great stunts or action episodes it all takes great dialoges and superb music to create scenes which give goosebumps….

and Man…..if Kangana is called the Queen of Bollywood then Vidya is her Begum Jaan!!!!!!!

Not sure about the comercial success of the movie as the so called family audience may not watch the so called bold content…..but will surely create an impact on the audience.

PS : I havent watched the original bengali version

e: Mister left me wondering how Varun Tej agreed to the film and convinced that Srinu Vaitla had not escaped the formula he was expected to change. Characters and subplots keep arriving without purpose, the second half becomes exhausting and the climax itself seems to multiply — a sprawling commercial mess rather than a coherent entertainer.
v: One ticket konna... THREE movies free ga vachayi 😭😂 Srinu Vaitla multithreading screenplay + three climaxes... 2h40m somehow felt like 10 hours.
body:
Watched #Mister …..
Tag line manam prema ni vethukuntu velthe preme manalni vethukuntu vasthundi but cinema original tag line meeru oka cinema ni chudalani ticket tesukunte vasthey 3 cinemalu mimalni ethukuntu vasthayi _/\_

assalu ee cinema ni Varun Tej ella opukunaado guda artham kavatledhu…..Srinu Vaytla maarademo anukoni cinema chudaniki ellina vaalaki eedu manam chachinaa maradu anee namakam balanga vasthundi

assalu anni char’s endhuku vasthayo theledhu vaalu em cheyali anukunaaro theledhu….aaalatho vaytla babu em cheyisdham anukunaado theledhu….its just rajiv udyogasri padhakam for all telugu char artists

assalu 2nd half lo aa Krishna Devaraya Vamsam episodes Highlight….2 hrs 40 mins movie ee 10 hrs nuncho chusthunaa feeling vasthundi……Climax epudepudda ani aassa ga edhuru chuse valaki 3 climaxes chusi raktha kaaneeree _/\_

naaku thelisi Vaytla ki chinapati nunchi Java Multi Threading Concept ante mozu anukuntaaa andhuke aaadhe format follow ayipothuntaadu cinema after cinema

e: Katamarayudu felt like a storyline that belonged in the 2000s filmed with visual effects from the 1990s. Pawan Kalyan’s screen presence and Ajay’s expressions are almost the only positives I found, while the music, BGM, supporting material and exaggerated performance choices make the entire package feel surprisingly cheap for a star vehicle.
v: Expectations ni basement lo petti vellandi 😄 Story marchipondi, songs appudu eyes + ears close cheyyandi... PK okkade ee cheap-looking package ni somehow carry chesthadu.
body:
ipudosthunaaa out of box cinemalu chusi, ekkuva expect cheyakunda……story gurunchi pedhaga patijchukokundaaa…..Shruthi Hassan unnapudu kallu musukoni……patallu vachinapudu kalla tho paatu chevulu musukogaluguthe….cinema bavuntundi

2000’s lo teyalsina story line ki 1990 CG work tho tesina movie….The only saving grace for the movie is Power star supported by Ajay’s expressions and worst/irritating part is Anup Rubens Music & BGM amplified by Shruthi Hassan’s Over Expressions

Oka Rayudoooo BGM music bit thapaaa music is horrible…..manodiki inko star hero movie music kotali ante atleast 10 years wait cheyalemoo

PK okadini petesukoni……migithaaa Story, Support Cast, Music, Shruthi’s make up anni thegaaa cheapuuuu gaa santhalo konatunnaru _/\_

e: Badrinath Ki Dulhania starts from themes I found worthwhile and realistic, especially dowry and the expectations placed on women. Varun Dhawan does justice to the Jhansi tapori and Alia Bhatt is effortless, but the commercial packaging repeatedly weakens the material until the film sits awkwardly between social drama and mainstream entertainer without fully succeeding as either.
v: Dowry + women independence meeda good point... commercial treatment motham confuse chesindi 😐 Neither strong message movie nor proper entertainer. And title Vaidehi Ka Dulha kada? 😄
body:
#BadrinathkiDulhania : I do generally start speaking about only good points of the movie, but I cannot hold back myself from being LOL of the pathetic reality that the whole plot of movie revolves around Women Empowerment and against the Dowry system and how the Mard Varun becomes a real hero under the guidance of Alia, then why the hell the movie is named Badrinath ki Dulhania Vaidehi Ka Dulha should have been apt title for the movie.

These are the small points which prove that we are still in male dominated industry and the words like women empowerment are just to preach!!! way to go Dharma Productions and KoJo _/\_

Story deals with Dowry and Women Empowerment…..many may feel the movie’s story and screenplay is someting out from the 90’s. But thats what still happens in many places/families in India.

Kudos to Varun Dhawan for choosing this subject. Varun has clearly done justification to the good tapori from Jhansi. It has been a cakewalk for Alia, nothing much to challange the potential of the lill dynamite.

The plot of the movie is excellent but the way it is dealt in complete commercial manner has played a spoil sport. At the end of the day you neither get a feeling of watching a great story oriented movie nor a pakka commercial entertainer.

If you watch the movie for its realistic story line, the way it has been dealt will make you feel pathetic and if you watch it as a pakka commercial film then the story line looks pathetic

e: Nenu Local is one of those films where taking your logical brain into the theatre is actively dangerous. The story and screenplay make little sense, but Trinadha Rao Nakkina designs the hero for maximum entertainment and Nani gives that character 200%, while DSP gets room to try a few different musical ideas. As entertainment, it works almost entirely because of Nani, Nani and Nani.
v: Attitude is Everything kaadu... NANI is everything 😄 Logic theatre bayata switch off chesi vellandi. Story nonsense aina Nani alone makes it proper paisa vasool.
body:
with Tag line Attitude is everything but for this movie its “Nani’s Attitude is the onlything”

How can he act with such an ease……I may be exaggerating but looks like he is going to be the next big thing in tollywood after MegaStar

Not working with a Star was a blessing for DSP as he tried some different tunes unlike his other movies.

Just like Cinema Chupistha Mama, the director has done what he knows the best…..take an illogical story make it entertaining by desugning a typical hero char who can produce a lot of entertainment and Nanni did 200% justification

Story n Screenplay wise it is one of those Sajid Khan movies which you cant dare or dream to take your mind to theaters. Probably they should add a warning along with the regular Cell Switch Off warnings to warn the audience against useing their loggical brain or brain while watching the cinema

Entertainment wise its purely paisa vasool just because of Nani Nani and Nani….

e: Appatlo Okadundevadu tracks the rise and fall of Railway Raju and Imtiaz almost like two destinies moving in opposite rhythms. The direction and editing are terrific, every scene feels relevant, contemporary ideas such as piracy and real-estate change are woven intelligently into the period story, and Sree Vishnu leads a uniformly strong cast in a rare film that stays entertaining without formula tracks.
v: Glad I did NOT miss this one 🙏 Railway Raju vs Imtiaz vs TIME itself... tight screenplay, terrific BGM and hardly one useless scene. Ee cinema deserves more love.
body:
Watched #AppatloOkadundevadu ……. Glad i didnt missed this movie, Its all about Railyway Raju vs Imtiaz vs Time/Destiny and wonderfully describes the Raise, Fall, Raise, Fall & Raise of Railyway Rajus fate against the Fall, Raise, Fall, Raise & Raise of Imtiaz fate!!!!

Direction n Editing are terrific….You cannnot find one scene/shot which is irrelavant to story line. The way director/writer corelates the Switch Hit, Piracy, Kktpally real estate withh current scenarios shows their sheer brilliance. Screenplay is apt for the storyline. BGM is terrific and songs though in sync with story and could have been better. This is one such rare film which shows that you dont need formula nd comedy tracks to keep the audience hooked nd entertained.

Terrific performances by Sri Vishnu, Rohit, Prabhas Seenu, Bhramaji, Rajeev Kanakala & Ajay.

Sri Vishnu proved he is a wonderful actor esp after Pratinidhi….wonder how Tollywood ignored this fine actor, hope he gets superb roles going forward….

Take a bow Rohit for getting back into his experimentation zone and also producing the movie.

e: Shatamanam Bhavati takes an age-old family-and-village template and shows that execution can still make familiar material feel fresh. Beautiful visuals and characters who resemble people we actually know keep the film warm and engaging, even if the songs and BGM could have been stronger. For me, it was simply a perfect family entertainer.
v: Old family storyే... but clean ga, warm ga, mana intlo vallala characters tho chepthe fresh ga feel avvachu ani prove chesindi 😄 LOVED IT TO THE CORE.
body:
Watched #ShatamanamBhavati …… a perfect family entertainer, loved it to the core. You always dont need any exceptional out of box story or screenplay to keep audience engaged, sometimes u can do the magic with age old story and screenplay with a clean and fresh entertainment.

Coming to the story it is a kichidi of all well known family and village backdrop films, but the beautifully captured visuals and entertainment from nearly Real charachters is want keeps you engaged. Except for Prakash Raj, Anupama & Sharwanand all the other chars are pretty much real and can be corelated. BGM and Songs could have been better.

e: Khaidi No. 150 did not need an original story to work for me because I was there for Chiranjeevi’s comeback, and he delivers exactly the reminder fans wanted. His comedy timing, emotional ease, drunk performance, graceful dancing and sheer screen presence dominate everything around him. There may be little else to discuss — but Boss okkadu chaalu 😄
v: Did I go for a fresh story? NO 😂 BOSS comeback kosam vella... comedy, emotion, dance, screen fire అన్నీ intact. BOX-OFFICE AMMA MOGUDU IS BACK!!!!!
body:
watched #Khaidi150…..assalu tamil ollaki adhi oka goppa story anni ella anipinchindho?? Telugu lo same story line based 150 cinemalu chupinchachu 🙂 but wait a minute…..did I watch the movie for a different story or execution?? NO its BOSS comeback movie!!! and yes The Boss who had kick ass comedy timing is back….The Boss who is pitch perfect as drunkurd is back…..The Boss who is at best in emotional scenes is back……The Boss who sets Silver screen on Fire with his graceful steps is back….and YES the BOXOFFICE amma mogudu is BACK with Bang!!!! My 4 year old daughter danced in the theater for the songs and Yes the biggest entertainer of Telugu Film Industry is back

Boss gurunchi thappa cinema lo chepukodaniki emmi ledhu…..but Boss okkadu challu 😛

e: Gautamiputra Satakarni worked for me as a solid period film rather than the oversized cultural event surrounding its release. Krish and Balakrishna put in their best effort, the dialogues are excellent and the direction is focused; considering the budget, schedule and the physical demands on its lead, the result is genuinely impressive even if I would stop short of calling it essential viewing.
v: Telugu pride hype pakkana petti normal historical movie ga chusthe GOOD one 👍 Krish sharp ga handles it, dialogues roar... and honestly Satakarni ga Balayya ne set avthadu.
body: Watched #GPSK…..a good movie with best efforts from Krish n Bala Krishna…..n yes no one could have suited the role better than balaya babu. Will not say its a must watch but definetly a good watch, dont go with all the hype about Telugu jathi gawravam etc…..its just a normal periodic movie with excellent dialoges n perfect direction and who else we have other than balaya babu to mouth those terrific dialoges!!! Considering the limitations budget time and balaya’s age n size its a Fantastic movie

e: Dangal is superbly made cinema, with exceptional casting and visible commitment from every performer and technician. My major reservation is not the filmmaking but the real-life framing: I could not fully celebrate a story that seemed to glorify Mahavir Phogat’s methods more than the daughters who sacrificed so much to fulfil his ambition.
v: FILM ga loved it 🙏 Real-life story ga మాత్రం father ni hero chesi daughters’ sacrifice ni pakkana pettadam naaku digest avvaledu. Great cinema, complicated feeling.
body:
Watched #Dangal…..as a FILM just loved it to the core and each n every artist technician put his 300% which completely shows on the Silver Screen, the casting was pitch perfect

BUT considering that it was a real life story….I hated it to the core, somehow i felt that rather than glorifying the Phogat Sisters who sacrificed everything to fulfill their fathers dream…it tried to glorify a father who without any mercy forced his daughters to achieve his own dreams.

I fully understand that his dream was to get a medal for the nation but that doesnt mean he simply rubs his wish over them….are we making mr.Phogat a hero just because his daughters made the nation proud?? what if the poor girls failed??

If he is hero, then all those parents who force their children to become eng or doctors are also heros….

e: Vangaveeti gave me the RGV craft I expected — haunting BGM, striking visuals, balanced dialogues and unconventional staging — but this time with a story strong enough to match it. What I especially liked is that the film avoids simple hero-villain labels and instead lets circumstance and miscommunication become the real destructive forces, capped by a final line that reminded me why I admire RGV’s storytelling instincts.
v: RGV movie lo camera, lights, BGM, acting usually untayi... STORYే missing avvachu 😄 This time story కూడా undi. Situations ni villain ga cheyyadam lo master still master.
body:
#Vangaveeti : genral ga RGV cinemalo Taking Camera Lights BGM Acting anii awesome untayi….okka story thappa. Essari Story guda undhi!!!

The beauty of RGV’s style is okaaa controversial subject tesukoni……..andhullo evaro okkalu hero inkollu villan annatu kakundaaa, Situations and Miscommunication ni Villan ga chupinchi migitha anni charachters neither hero nor villans anatu chupinchadam. No one can do that better than him!!!

BGM as usual migitha RGV movies laage will haunt you….dialogues again chala balanced gaa impact creat chesedatu unnayi

Cinema ni release kakunda cheyadaniki evaru ayithe godava chesaarooo…vaallaa meedha chala sweet n hot revenge terchukunaadu 😛 u will know it once u watch the movie!!!

Final ga Cinema motham oka ethu….last lo vacheeee dialogue oka ethu, that simply shows how geneius the master is 🙂

e: Dear Zindagi turns a confused, emotionally messy young woman — the kind of person many of us know as a sibling, cousin, friend or colleague — into a warm and recognisable story. Shah Rukh Khan is wonderfully mature and generous, but Alia Bhatt disappears so completely into Kaira that she makes you laugh, pity her, get irritated with her and cry with her, all backed by excellent situational music.
v: What a movie 🙏 SRK super mature ga untadu... but after some time screen meeda Alia kanapadadu, only KAIRA. Their combo is such a lovely treat.
body:
what a movie……Gauri Shinde is bang on Target!!!! If English Vinglish was all about an House Wife, this is all about a young girl (whow we all encounter in our daily life as any of our sibiling, cousin, friend, collegue or girl friend etc) who cant take decisions………

SRK : This year he proved again who is the Badshah of acting in Bollywood…..another auperb performance from him after Fan. I havent seen such a matured and impact performance from him after Chak De & Swadesh!!! n the way he created space for Alia to perform….Man the combination of SRK n Alia was treat to watch!!!

Aaaliaaaaa : the wonder kid of Bhatt shaabh!!! after RGV she is the only one for whom i can have a argument with anyone 🙂 all the way i went to watch Alia in the film….but what i was shocked to see was there was no Aliaa…..its KAIRA!!! she makes you laugh on her, feel pitty for her, get irriated by her, cry with her….for the first time I have seen SRK to come up with extra ordinary performance to match to his costar (after amitabh)!!! while she can do all these kind of Highway, Udtha & Dear Zindagi roles…she is just 23!!!

Music has been really good & situational….esp songs and lyrics were awesome

on end note…..would love to watch RGV & Alia working together soon!!!

e: Sahasam Swasaga Sagipo is a sharply divided experience for me: the romantic first hour was painful because that genre rarely works for me, while the later semi-action stretch suddenly becomes gripping. Naga Chaitanya gives what I felt was his best performance to that point, the BGM is superb and the much-criticised climax actually felt realistic to me.
v: First hour ‘What the F***’... next hour ‘WHAT A F***’ 😂 Romance almost lost me, but shift ayyaka full BANG. Chaitanya best performance till then for me.
body:
awesome transformation from What the F*** to What a F*** …… n the 4 letter wrd starting with F doesnt stands for Film 😛

first 1 hr was horrible!!! (at least from my perapective as I am not a fan of romace genere) but later on its a BANG!!! seen many reviews stating the climax was week but personally i loved it and thought it was more realistic

undoubtedly NagChaitanya’s best performace till date….heroine was apt and so as other chars

BGM was superb…..Music is ok (again i am not a fan of Rahman’s slow n romantic songs) but lyrics is disgusting (always had this feeling for Rahman’s songs starting with Boy’s)

Vellipomake song ayithe literally audience ki chepinatu undhi…vellipomakandi ikada nunchi cinema superb ga untundhi ani 😛

overall good movie for semi-action movie lovers if they can bear the first 1hr….but i feel concept n story were realistic right from word go

e: I had not watched the Malayalam original, so I entered the Telugu Premam without comparison baggage. Naga Chaitanya delivers one of his better performances, Shruti Haasan is effortless, the music and visuals suit the story, and Praveen’s comedy becomes the crucial ingredient that keeps a romance-averse viewer like me happily involved.
v: Pure romance usually naaku nidra teppisthundi 😄 Premam మాత్రం comedy + emotion balance tho keep chesindi. Naa Autograph minus heavy sentiment, plus easy fun.
body:
I havent watched the original version so my thought was not pre-programmed……Need to mention 4 main ppl, NagaChaitanya has tried his best and mostly succedded in giving best performance till date and was stylish in remaining 2 getups.

Praween : to be frank, he has carried the whole movie with his comedy timing n expressions

Srinivas : He played a major role during the last 30 mins of the movie

Shruthi Hassan : she played the char with such an ease

music & bgm are good and suites the plot….the visuals in evvare song were delight to watch

Dialogues were verybgood and loved this one “Prema Dvesham Kopam ivani feelings….manam kavalante feelings peruguthayi vadu anukunte tagipothayi”

To cut it short…..Love/Romantic genere movies have always made me feel bore, but this movie has tried to keep me engaged due to its entertainment, probably would have felt horrible for me if the comedy was missing. Its Naa Autograph minus heavy emotions plus light hearted comedy

e: ISM is unmistakably Puri Jagannadh, built around aggressive one-liners, attitude and a much tighter second half. Kalyan Ram looks completely at ease and gives especially strong work later in the film. I enjoyed the Puri flavour enough to recommend it to his audience, even while feeling increasingly that his writing would benefit from bringing other storytellers into the room.
v: Pure PURI markISM 😄 Dialogue bombs straight MISSILES, second half racy, Kalyan Ram uber-cool. Puri fans ki feast... story మాత్రం vere writer daggara nunchi teesukunte ఇంకా బాగుంటుంది 😂
body:
watched #ISM …… its purely Puri markISM
cinema cinema ki puri dialogues bombs nunchi missiles ga maruthunayi

1. Bhoomi meedha prathodiki mudu putla thindhi kavali….aa thindi pandinche raythu akali gurunchi ee naakoduki akarledhu

2. Desam ni Thellollu entha dhochukunaaro theledhu gaani….Sanka nakinchindi mathram mana laage untu mana chutu thirige eee nalla l**** kodukulle

3. nuvu alla chusthunte, body lo unna billion cells excite ayyi….energy ni oke chota ki pump chesthunaayi

4. I am very good at ducking……reyi porapatuna duck ante baathu anukunavemo boothu raaa erri ****

2nd half is racy and to the point…but its time puri starts taking other writers stories…..

Kalyan Ram is ubercool and has delevired excellent acting specially in 2nd half

worth watch if u like puri mark movies…..migitha vaallu Bhramotsavam ki velli manchi matallu vinandi

e: Mana Oori Ramayanam has a distinctive single-point premise and deliberately avoids loud dialogue or commercial decoration. Prakash Raj and Priyamani are predictably strong, while Prudhvi surprises with a serious, mature performance and Ilaiyaraaja’s music fits the restrained mood. Its slow, subtle approach will not connect with everyone, but the experiment deserves appreciation.
v: Different, mature concept with very quiet emotions. Regular audience ki 2 hoursే 4 hours laga anipinchachu 😄 Different cinema ishtam unte one-time watch worth it.
body:
Different story and concept with undercover emotions!!! PrakashRaj n Priyamani nailed it with performance (which is expected) but a serious matured performance by Pruthvi (30 yrs industry)…….on though its hardly 2 hrs movie, normal audience feel like the movie is running for ages due to its single point and sublime emotions without heavy dialogues, Music by Illeyaraja is good and fits in the bill.
