Though the movie is clean U many may not get connected due to its matured/bold concept. Hatsoff to PrakashRaj for molding such a matured storyline to a clean U movie.

One Time Watch for all those movie lovers who encourage different concept movies.

e: Majnu is deliberately ordinary: a routine romance built almost entirely on Nani’s charm, with a small but effective Raj Tarun cameo. It drags in places and viewers expecting another Nani wonder may be disappointed, but with modest expectations the clean comedy, easy music and much stronger final stretch make it a watchable time-pass film.
v: Simple story, simple screenplay, simple everything 😄 No WOW... thankfully no VAMMOO either. Final 10 mins + Nani make it comfortably timepass.
body:
watched #Majnu ……. a Simple Story with Simple Screenplay wrapped with Simple Music and Simple Comedy!!!! cinema motham ekada gudaa WOW factor undadhu alla anni VAMMOO factor guda undadhu!!! akadakada drag ayinatu untundi but watchable

last 2 mnths nunchi vachinaaa different genere and routinue ooraa mass genere kakunda simple routine story medha kevalam Nani performance n Raj Tarun cameo ni pwtubadi ga peti tesina cinemaa…..if you watch with No expectations you will like it, but ee madhya Nani cinemalaga oo adbuthallu expect chesthe mathram may get dissapointed

Cinema motham oka ethu…last 10 mins oka ethu!!! All that ends good is good ane concept bati chusthe cinema is Timepassable…

to conclude Nani is the Sole and Solo of this Film with a small but effective support from Raj Tarun

e: PINK is an intense, morally clear film that needs no grand production scale because its real production value is conviction. Taapsee Pannu and the other women are terrific, Amitabh Bachchan is powerful, the writing is bold and the music stays perfectly aligned with the tension. It is not entertainment-first cinema; it is a message delivered exactly as forcefully as intended.
v: TERRIFIC movie. TERRIFIC performances. HUGE impact 🙏 Taapsee completely owned it for me... and everything finally comes down to one simple line: NO means NO.
body:
#PINK : Terrific Movie vth Terrific Performances by Tapsee & other 2 lead ladies followed by Amitabh…….in my opinion Tapsee has completely dominated Amitabh!!! How have we wasted her talent in Telugu movies limiting her to glamorus roles 😦

Story n Dialogues : It takes guts and boldness to write such an intense story with dialogues of HUGE Impact!!! take a bow to all the cast n crew…..

Music & BGM : apt & is in perfect sync with the movies intensity

Production Values : though the film doesnt have any major production values as the film is majorly shot in a Court set and a colony but need to specify their MORAL values

DONT WATCH the film if you are expecting any sort of entertainment!!!!

DONT watch the film if you take an independent working women as granted for sex!!!!

DONT WATCH the movie if you think a girl wearing modern dresses or smoking cigerrates or Booze have a QUESTIONABLE CHARACHTER!!!!

and finally…..

DONT WATCH the film if dont understand that NO means NO!!!!

coz u will surely hate the movie and talk bad which will be a disgrace to the whole teams effort…….

Finally Movie Plot, Dialogues, Music, Performances were BANG on to what they wanted to convey!!!!

e: Jyo Achyutananda pulled me in from its playful title cards and kept rewarding me with Srinivas Avasarala’s sharp screenplay and wonderfully witty dialogue. Nara Rohit owns an unusually practical character without demanding artificial justification, Naga Shaurya and Regina fit beautifully, and the emotional second half completes rather than weakens the comedy-heavy opening.
v: Sensible, clean, witty, emotional... chaala nachindi 🙏 Simple story ni Avasarala writing + Rohit/Shaurya/Regina performances another level ki teesukellayi. Second half ఇంకా better.
body:
#JyoAchyutananda : Sensible, Neat, Clean, Witty, Entertaining, Emotional, Engaging…….n the list goes on & on

u will be involved right go…shows directors capabilities with simple Title cards with 90’s super hits playing in background

#SrinivasAvasarala : take a bow for ur intelligence….Story Simple, Screenplay Top Notch (1st half), Dialogues toooooooo good….the way he involved witty dialogues (Nanna ki nuvu trails lo putavu raa Nenu Reals; I thank you from heart of my bottom) into a family entertainer but yet makes everyone to have a hearty laugh shows his Intelligence. Loved the charachterizations espcially of Nara Rohit ( never tried to give justification or reason behind his attitude in the whole movie ) which shows how much realistic the movie is. Yes i say realistic coz me n my brother flirted vth same girl who used to live in our above apartment when I was studying 5, 6th 🙂

#NaraRohit : I was a fan of his movies right from Banam….n happy that he hit bulls eye atleast this time. The way he owned Achyuth charachterization is terrific. He carried the attitude of being a person without much emtional attachment n practical approach is superb and the cheery on cake is he never tried to justify or give proper reasoning 4 his behavior which made me to fall in love with his role…Superb Acting but Rowdy Fellow lo chepinatu Babu koncham boodu ga kaadhu baaaagha laavu ayyadu

#NagaSourya : 2 good for a budding artist….his looks innonce in face and the way he carried emotional scenes are superb

#Regina : she has completely fit into the role of jyo, n the way the.director potrayed her char of being a modern girl with mature thought process she did full justice

Kalyan Raman’s music is soothing with light BGM and melodious Title track….Cinematography is very good n apt.

I have seen lot many reviews complaining about 2nd half, come on u cannot expect a movie to be laugh riot. 2nd half is the core of the movie with emotions taking the front seat and yes its very very very good

e: Janatha Garage did not impress me with originality; I found Koratala Siva leaning heavily on a familiar RGV-style power-system template despite adding an environmental angle. But the performances transform the experience: Mohanlal and especially NTR are formidable, and DSP’s background score gives the second half the force the story itself lacks.
v: Basically Koratala’s Sarkar 😄 Story/execution new ga anipinchaledu... but Mohanlal + NTR POWER PACKED, and DSP BGM theatre nunchi vachaka కూడా head lo tirigindi.
body:
#JanathaGarage : to put it short KortalaShiva’s version of RGV’s Sarkar!!!

though story wise n execution wise nothing new, POWER PACKED performances of MohanLal n NTR!!!!

NTR take a bow….his expressions dialogue delivery are simply EXCELLENT!!! especially the whole 2nd half…watching NTR’s movies have always been least priorty 4 me….Temper (watched 4 puri) NKP (watched 4 sukumar) n this one 4 the combination……but will ensure 2 watch his next movies only 4 him….hope he continues experimentation irrespective of commercial outcomes

#DSP BGM is still haunting me…..my ringtone is going 2 change

n now.coming to shiva….is this the start of downfall of kortalasiva?? RGV vadi vadi vadi padesinaaaa C (bhootulu vadule) story template ni as it is kotesadu….Hero env premikudu ane concept add chesadu but still he uses bike instead of cycle?? or atleast public transport (should have used atleast in 1st half)

coming to main heroine KajalAgarwal and supporting heroines Samantha n Nitya they did their job….

e: Kabali is not the nonstop Rajini-style mass film the gigantic pre-release expectations conditioned many viewers to expect. Going in with zero expectations, I found a good, deliberately slow family story inside a gangster setting, with Rajinikanth showing vulnerability and acting rather than relying only on trademark style, and Radhika Apte giving him formidable company.
v: Hype motham forget chesi chusthe Kabali is actually a slow family drama inside a mafia setup. Rajini gets room to ACT, and Radhika Apte sometimes even dominates him 🙏
body:
watched #Kabali ……. It’s time for the Super Star to take a break & give time for his confused audience to decide in which roles they want to see their ageing star

thanks to all the negative buzzz…..i stepped into the movie with zero expectations and what i saw on the sliver screen was a beautiful family drama with emotions with a backdrop of mafia

yes the movie is sloowwwww, but that is how the majority of the Tamil movies are!!!! and Rajini nailed it (not with his usual style) with his acting, do you guys remember what was the last Rajini’s movie which had scope for him to showcase his acting (esp the way he was desparate 2 meet his wife)?? special mention of Radhika…she totally dominated Rajini in her screen presence

I hear people blaming on the PR team for huge publicity and setting high expectations…..come on, didnt you see how promotions happen for other movies??? n these poor guys just released a Teaser (mind it only a Teaser but not Trailer), there was no major audio release and no interviews from the star…then how can we blame them for over publicity?? Its just each n every one of us wanted to fetch limelight just by associating with the name called Rajini!!!!

so relax and enjoy the acting treat of Rajini daaa……..in short treat to Mass Masala n hard core Rajini fans in first n last 15 mins…..in between a good family story narrated in slow screenplay supported with superb acting from Rajini n Radhika….

e: Gentleman felt wonderfully refreshing after a stretch of exhausting mainstream films. The different concept kept me engaged without a single boring stretch, Mani Sharma’s background score works beautifully and the supporting cast adds value — but the complete meal is Nani, once again proving that the hero-versus-villain label matters far less than the actor inside both possibilities.
v: Simply SUPERB!!!!! Nani acting FULL MEALS 🙏 Different concept, superb BGM, zero boring moments. Hero aa villain aa pakkana petti... NANI oka GOPPA ACTOR.
body: watched #Gentleman……simply SUPERB!!! Nani acting Full Meals, Manisharma BGM superb…….special mention of Srinivas Avasarala n Heorine……personally I didnt had a single bore moment….SGS, Bhramotsavam, Sarrinodu lanti kalaa khandalu chusakaa it was obviously a refreshing movie with differnt concept……Final gaa NANI Hero no Villan’oo kadhu, oka gopaa Actor!!!!

e: Brahmotsavam triggered one of my longest rants because I could find almost nothing to defend beyond the Bala Tripuramani song and Mahesh Babu trying something slightly different there. The screenplay feels shapeless, the huge cast and lavish settings add expense rather than value, familiar emotional beats repeat without impact and the film mistakes family-value speeches for actual storytelling.
v: Movie chusaka fans enduku ‘first watch then talk’ annaro ardham ayyindi 😂 Narakam close-up lo chusaka clarity vachindi. Bala Tripuramani song తప్ప almost everything exhausted me.
body:

illa routine cinemalu tesedapudu Mass Masala namukodam better endhukante B & C centers lo emotions ekuvaaa valaki talk tho sambandham undadhu chusestharanthe, Class ni namukunte illa nee first 2 days collections guda rakundaa naakipothaaruu….Overseas lo advance book chesukunollu refund aduguthunarantaa

e: 24 stunned me because Vikram Kumar takes a complicated time-travel story and communicates it with remarkable clarity. Suriya deserves enormous credit not only for performing it but for backing such an ambitious concept as producer. The CG could be better and the romance trimmed, but those reservations barely matter beside the excitement of seeing mainstream South Indian cinema attempt something this fresh.
v: SHELL SHOCKED!!!!! 🔥 Intha complex time-travel story ni banana peel chesinattu simple ga explain cheyyadam ela? Vikram Kumar + Suriya, take a BOW 🙏
body:
Shell Shocked!!!!just watched 24…..well how can 1 write such a COMPLEX story and how can 1 explain it just like that???? adedho china piladiki aarati pandu valichi petinatu….Take a BOW Vikram n Team!!!!

SURYA it takes GUTS to accept such stories without thinking about logistics and putting ur all hard earned money into it (not like our Tollywood super n Power Stars who think not taking remunaration makes them one of the producers) without thinking about Logistics!!!!

CG could have been better and romance track could have been trimmed…but who cares!!! Basically we are Telugu film audience maaku ilantivani chalaa kothaa….

e: Oopiri balances its emotional core with enough entertainment to avoid becoming a much heavier experience. Nagarjuna nails the role, Karthi’s innocent expressions are a major asset and I loved Prakash Raj’s character. I had no issue with the remake being faithful; the team deserves credit for bringing a good French story naturally to Telugu audiences.
v: GREAT ki just short... VERY NICE మాత్రం pakka 😄 Nag nails it, Karthi is super lovable, emotion + entertainment balance works. Still, somewhere aa small ‘something missing’ feeling undi.
body:
